import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import 'core/models/settings/app_settings.dart';
import 'core/settings.dart';
import 'core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import 'core/ui/dark_theme.dart';
import 'core/ui/light_theme.dart';
import 'features/settings/bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'navigation/router.dart';
import 'provider/bloc.dart';
import 'provider/repository.dart';

class App extends HookConsumerWidget {
  final Color seedColor = const Color(0xFFFFFFFF);

  const App({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final settingsBloc = ref.read(ProviderBloc.settings);
    final notificationsRepository = ref.read(
      ProviderRepository.common.notifications,
    );

    useEffect(() {
      notificationsRepository.registerDevice(initService: true);
      return null;
    }, []);

    return BlocBuilder<SettingsBloc, AppSettingsModel>(
      bloc: settingsBloc,
      builder: (context, settingsState) {
        return MaterialApp.router(
          localizationsDelegates: [
            GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
            GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
            GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
          ],
          supportedLocales: [Locale('en', 'US'), Locale('ru', 'RU')],
          locale: Locale("ru", "RU"),
          themeMode: settingsState.themeMode,
          debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,
          routerConfig: router,
          theme: lightTheme,
          darkTheme: darkTheme,
          builder: (context, child) {
            final applyConstraints =
                MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width > AppUISettings.maxAppWidth;

            return Material(
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
              child: Stack(
                alignment: Alignment.center,
                children: [
                  SafeArea(
                    bottom: applyConstraints,
                    top: applyConstraints,
                    left: applyConstraints,
                    right: applyConstraints,
                    child: Container(
                      margin: EdgeInsets.all(applyConstraints ? 8 : 0),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(
                          applyConstraints ? 10 : 0,
                        ),
                      ),
                      clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
                      child: ConstrainedBox(
                        constraints: BoxConstraints(
                          maxWidth: AppUISettings.maxAppWidth,
                        ),
                        child: child,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/about/version/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';

import 'state.dart';

class AppVersionBloc extends Cubit<AppVersionState> {
  AppVersionBloc() : super(const AppVersionState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    try {
      final packageInfo = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();

      final buildVersion = const String.fromEnvironment(
        "BUILD_VERSION",
        defaultValue: "BUILD_VERSION",
      );

      final buildNumber = const String.fromEnvironment(
        "BUILD_NUMBER",
        defaultValue: "BUILD_NUMBER",
      );

      final buildHash = const String.fromEnvironment(
        "BUILD_HASH",
        defaultValue: "BUILD_HASH",
      );

      DateTime? buildDate = DateTime.tryParse(
        const String.fromEnvironment("BUILD_DATE", defaultValue: ""),
      );

      DateTime? installTime = packageInfo.installTime;

      emit(
        AppVersionState.loaded(
          buildVersion: buildVersion,
          buildNumber: buildNumber,
          buildHash: buildHash.substring(0, 5),
          buildDate: buildDate,
          installDate: installTime,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      emit(
        AppVersionState.loaded(
          buildVersion: "N/A",
          buildNumber: "N/A",
          buildHash: "N/A",
          buildDate: null,
          installDate: null,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}

class AppVersionState with _$AppVersionState {
  const factory AppVersionState.loading() = _Loading;

  const factory AppVersionState.loaded({
    required String buildVersion,
    required String buildNumber,
    required String buildHash,
    DateTime? buildDate,
    DateTime? installDate,
  }) = _Loaded;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/text.dart';

class AppVersionDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final String buildVersion;
  final String buildNumber;
  final String buildHash;
  final DateTime? buildDate;
  final DateTime? installDate;

  const AppVersionDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.buildVersion,

    required this.buildNumber,
    required this.buildHash,
    this.buildDate,
    this.installDate,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
          topLeft: Radius.circular(12),
          topRight: Radius.circular(12),
        ),
      ),
      padding:
          EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24, vertical: 24) +
          EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.viewPaddingOf(context).bottom),
      width: double.infinity,
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          _Item(title: context.t.strings.appVersionTitle, value: buildVersion),
          _Item(title: context.t.strings.buildNumberTitle, value: buildNumber),

          _Item(title: context.t.strings.buildHashTitle, value: buildHash),

          if (buildDate != null)
            _Item(
              title: context.t.strings.buildDateTitle,
              value: DateFormat(
                "dd MMMM yyyy HH:mm",
                LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode,
              ).format(buildDate!),
            ),

          if (installDate != null)
            _Item(
              title: context.t.strings.installDateTitle,
              value: DateFormat(
                "dd MMMM yyyy HH:mm",
                LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode,
              ).format(installDate!),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Item extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;
  final String value;

  const _Item({required this.title, required this.value});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      children: [
        PNText(title, color: context.pNTheme.primaryText),
        PNText(value, color: context.pNTheme.primaryText),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:ui';

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shimmer_effect/shimmer_effect.dart';

import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/text.dart';
import '../../../../provider/bloc.dart';
import '../bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../bloc/state.dart';
import 'dialog.dart';

class AppVersionWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  const AppVersionWidget({super.key});

  Future<void> _showAppVersionDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    String buildVersion,
    String buildNumber,
    String buildHash,
    DateTime? buildDate,
    DateTime? installDate,
  ) => Navigator.of(context).push(
    CupertinoModalPopupRoute(
      barrierColor: const Color(0xFF000000).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
      builder: (_) => BackdropFilter(
        filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 3, sigmaY: 3),
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          children: [
            AppVersionDialog(
              buildVersion: buildVersion,
              buildNumber: buildNumber,
              buildHash: buildHash,
              buildDate: buildDate,
              installDate: installDate,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(DoctorProviderBloc.settings.appVersion);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      ),
      width: double.infinity,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            child: Image(
              image: AssetImage('assets/images/app_icon.png'),
              loadingBuilder: (context, child, loadingProgress) {
                if (loadingProgress == null) {
                  return child; // Image is fully loaded
                }
                return ShimmerEffect(
                  baseColor: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
                  highlightColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    height: 64,
                    width: 64,
                  ),
                );
              },
              height: 64,
              width: 64,
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            child: BlocBuilder<AppVersionBloc, AppVersionState>(
              bloc: bloc,
              builder: (context, state) => state.map(
                loading: (_) => PNText(
                  context.t.strings.loading,
                  color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                ),
                loaded: (data) => CupertinoButton(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
                  onPressed: null,
                  onLongPress: () => _showAppVersionDialog(
                    context,
                    data.buildVersion,
                    data.buildNumber,
                    data.buildHash,
                    data.buildDate,
                    data.installDate,
                  ),
                  child: PNText(
                    context.t.strings.appVersion(version: data.buildVersion),
                    color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/home/counter/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patients/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patients/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PatientsCounterBloc extends Cubit<PatientsCounterState> {
  final PatientsRepository _patientsRepository;

  PatientsCounterBloc(this._patientsRepository)
    : super(PatientsCounterState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    emit(PatientsCounterState.loading());
    final response = await _patientsRepository.getPatientsCount(DateTime.now());

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          PatientsCounterState.loaded(
            totalPatients: data.totalCount,
            goodPatients: data.goodPatients,
            badPatients: data.badPatients,
            veryBadPatients: data.veryBadPatients,
            offlinePatients: data.offlinePatients,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(PatientsCounterState.error());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return (false, null);
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patients/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patients/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class OnlineConsultationsCounterBloc
    extends Cubit<OnlineConsultationsCounterState> {
  final PatientsRepository _patientsRepository;

  OnlineConsultationsCounterBloc(this._patientsRepository)
    : super(OnlineConsultationsCounterState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    emit(OnlineConsultationsCounterState.loading());

    final response = await _patientsRepository.getOnlineConsultationCount();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          OnlineConsultationsCounterState.loaded(
            totalConsultations: data.totalConsultations,
            waitingDistribution: data.waitingDistribution,
            planned: data.planned,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(OnlineConsultationsCounterState.error());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Counter extends StatelessWidget {
  final int totalConsultations;
  final int waitingDistribution;
  final int planned;

  const _Counter({
    required this.totalConsultations,
    required this.waitingDistribution,
    required this.planned,
  });

  Color get _totalConsultationsColor {
    if (totalConsultations < 5) {
      return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
    } else if (totalConsultations < 10) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    } else {
      return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    }
  }

  Color get _waitingDistributionColor {
    if (waitingDistribution < 5) {
      return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
    } else if (waitingDistribution < 10) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    } else {
      return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    }
  }

  Color get _plannedColor {
    if (planned < 5) {
      return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
    } else if (planned < 10) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    } else {
      return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 40,
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
        children: [
          PNText(
            totalConsultations.toString(),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            fontSize: 46,
            height: 22 / 46,
            color: _totalConsultationsColor,
          ),
          SizedBox(width: 16),
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: PNText(
                        context.t.strings.waitingsDistribution,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                      ),
                    ),
                    PNText(
                      waitingDistribution.toString(),
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: _waitingDistributionColor,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Expanded(
                      child: PNText(
                        context.t.strings.planed,
                        fontSize: 14,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                        color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                      ),
                    ),
                    PNText(
                      planned.toString(),
                      fontSize: 14,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      color: _plannedColor,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/home/waiting_chats/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patients/repository.dart';
import "../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patients/response.dart";
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class WaitingChatsCounterBloc extends Cubit<WaitingChatsCounterState> {
  final PatientsRepository _patientsRepository;

  WaitingChatsCounterBloc(this._patientsRepository)
    : super(WaitingChatsCounterState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    emit(WaitingChatsCounterState.loading());

    final response = await _patientsRepository.getWaitingChatsCount();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          WaitingChatsCounterState.loaded(
            waitingChatsCount: data.waitingChatsCount,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(WaitingChatsCounterState.error());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:math';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import 'state.dart';

class PatientActivityBloc extends Cubit<PatientActivityState> {
  PatientActivityBloc() : super(PatientActivityState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(PatientActivityState.loading());
    await Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 1));

    final random = Random(patientId);

    emit(
      PatientActivityState.loaded(
        stepsCount: random.nextInt(5000) + 5000,
        caloriesBurned: random.nextInt(500) + 600,
        sleepHours: random.nextInt(8) + 3,
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/patient/activity/ui/widgets/dash_line.dart ===
part of '../widget.dart';

class _DashLine extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DashLine();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CustomPaint(
      size: Size(1, double.infinity),
      painter: _DashLinePainter(
        color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        axis: Axis.vertical,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashLinePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Color color;
  final Axis axis;

  final dashLength = 2;
  final gap = 2;

  _DashLinePainter({required this.color, required this.axis});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;

    if (axis == Axis.vertical) {
      drawVerticalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }

    if (axis == Axis.horizontal) {
      drawHorizontalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }
  }

  void drawVerticalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.height - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(0, i),
        Offset(0, min((i + dashLength), size.height).toDouble()),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  void drawHorizontalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.width - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(i, 0),
        Offset(min((i + dashLength), size.width).toDouble(), 0),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patient/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/doctor/patient/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PatientCardBloc extends Cubit<PatientCardState> {
  final PatientRepository _patientRepository;

  PatientCardBloc(this._patientRepository) : super(PatientCardState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(PatientCardState.loading());

    final response = await _patientRepository.getPatient(patientId);

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          PatientCardState.loaded(
            name: data.patient.formatName,
            status: data.patient.status,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(PatientCardState.error());
      },
    );
  }
}

class PatientCardWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  static double get height => 264;

  const PatientCardWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(DoctorProviderBloc.patient.card);

    return BlocBuilder<PatientCardBloc, PatientCardState>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => AnimatedSwitcher(

          error: (_) => _Error(),
        ),
      ),

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/patient/condition/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/overview/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/overview/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PatientConditionBloc extends Cubit<PatientConditionState> {
  final PatientOverviewRepository _overviewRepository;

  PatientConditionBloc(this._overviewRepository)
    : super(const PatientConditionState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(const PatientConditionState.loading());

    final response = await _overviewRepository.getCondition(
      DateTime.now(),
      patientId: patientId,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          PatientConditionState.loaded(
            todayScore: data.score,
            comparePercents: data.comparePercents,
            weekScores: data.weekScores,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(PatientConditionState.error());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return (false, null);
      },
    );
  }
}

          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [

class _TopBar extends StatelessWidget {
  const _TopBar();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 35,
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                ),

                ),
              ),
            ],

            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
          ),
        ],
      ),

  }
}

class _TodayScore extends StatelessWidget {
  final int score;
  final int comparePercents;

  const _TodayScore({required this.score, required this.comparePercents});

  Color get _scoreColor => switch (comparePercents.compareTo(0)) {
    1 => PNCommonColors.goodColor,
    -1 => PNCommonColors.badColor,
    0 => PNCommonColors.neutralColor,
    _ => PNCommonColors.neutralColor,
  };

  IconData get _scoreIcon => switch (comparePercents.compareTo(0)) {
    1 => Icons.arrow_upward,
    -1 => Icons.arrow_downward,
    0 => Icons.minimize,
    _ => Icons.minimize,
  };

  String get _compareText => switch (comparePercents.compareTo(0)) {
    1 => t.strings.betterThenYesterday(percent: comparePercents.abs()),
    -1 => t.strings.worseThenYesterday(percent: comparePercents.abs()),
    0 => t.strings.noChanges,
    _ => t.strings.noChanges,
  };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 40,
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          AutoSizeText(
            score.toString(),
            style: PNTextStyle(
              fontSize: 46,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              color: _scoreColor,
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox.square(
            dimension: 40,
            child: Icon(_scoreIcon, size: 25, color: _scoreColor),
          ),
          AutoSizeText(
            _compareText,
            maxLines: 2,
            style: PNTextStyle(
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
              height: 18 / 16,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _WeekChart extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<int> weekScores;

  const _WeekChart({required this.weekScores});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 54,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: List.generate(
                weekScores.length,
                (index) => PNText(
                  weekScores[index].toString(),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.left,
                  fontWeight: index == weekScores.length - 1
                      ? FontWeight.w600
                      : FontWeight.w300,
                  fontSize: 13,
                  color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          Container(
            height: 16,
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
            child: CustomPaint(
              painter: _LineChartPainter(dataPoints: weekScores),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LineChartPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final List<int> dataPoints;
  final double pointRadius = 4.0;
  final double lineWidth = 1.0;
  final Color lineColor = Colors.grey;

  _LineChartPainter({required this.dataPoints});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint linePaint = Paint()
      ..color = lineColor
      ..strokeWidth = lineWidth
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

    final Paint pointPaint = Paint()..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    final double spacing = size.width / (dataPoints.length - 1);
    final double maxValue = dataPoints
        .reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b)
        .toDouble();
    final double minValue = dataPoints
        .reduce((a, b) => a < b ? a : b)
        .toDouble();
    final double verticalScale = size.height / (maxValue - minValue);

    List<Offset> points = [];

    for (int i = 0; i < dataPoints.length; i++) {
      double x = i * spacing;
      double y = size.height - (dataPoints[i] - minValue) * verticalScale;
      points.add(Offset(x, y));
    }

    // Draw the line
    for (int i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
      canvas.drawLine(points[i], points[i + 1], linePaint);
    }

    // Draw the points
    for (int i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      pointPaint.color = _getPointColor(dataPoints[i]);
      canvas.drawCircle(points[i], pointRadius, pointPaint);
    }
  }

  Color _getPointColor(int value) {
    if (value < 65) return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    if (value < 75) return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/overview/repository.dart';

class PatientDisciplineBloc extends Cubit<PatientDisciplineState> {
  final PatientOverviewRepository _overviewRepository;

  PatientDisciplineBloc(this._overviewRepository)
    : super(PatientDisciplineState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(PatientDisciplineState.loading());

    final response = await _overviewRepository.getDiscipline(
      DateTime.now(),
      patientId: patientId,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(PatientDisciplineState.loaded(weekScores: data.weekScores));
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(PatientDisciplineState.error());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return (false, null);
      },
    );
  }
}

class _WeekChart extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<double> weekScores;

  const _WeekChart({required this.weekScores});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 50,
      child: Align(
        alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
          children: List.generate(
            weekScores.length,
            (index) => _Bar(value: weekScores[index], height: 37, width: 12),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Bar extends StatelessWidget {
  final double value;
  final double height;
  final double width;

  const _Bar({required this.value, required this.height, required this.width});

  Color get _barColor {
    if (value < 0.5) {
      return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    }

    if (value < 0.75) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    }

    return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border.all(color: Color(0xFFDFDFDF), width: 0.5),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(1.75),
      ),
      height: height,
      width: width,
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: height * (1 - value)),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/patient/medicines/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/medicine/model.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PatientMedicinesBloc extends Cubit<PatientMedicinesState> {
  PatientMedicinesBloc() : super(PatientMedicinesState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(PatientMedicinesState.loading());
    await Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 1));

    final now = DateTime.now();

    emit(
      PatientMedicinesState.loaded(
        totalMedicinesTakeCount: 4,
        anchorTime: TimeOfDay(hour: now.hour, minute: now.minute),
        untakenMedicines: [
          MedicineModel(
            id: 1,
            name: 'Лизоприлин',
            pillCount: 1,
            mass: 500,
            recommendedTime: 'во время еды',
            isTaken: false,
          ),
          MedicineModel(
            id: 2,
            name: 'Пассифлора',
            pillCount: 2,
            mass: 500,
            recommendedTime: 'после еды',
            isTaken: false,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> updateMedicineTake(String id, bool value) async {
    if (state is! PatientMedicinesStateLoaded) {
      return;
    }

    final data = (state as PatientMedicinesStateLoaded);

    final medicines = List<MedicineModel>.from(data.untakenMedicines);

    final index = medicines.indexWhere(
      (element) => element.id.toString() == id,
    );

    if (index == -1) {
      return;
    }

    medicines[index] = medicines[index].copyWith(isTaken: value);

    emit(
      data.copyWith(
        untakenMedicines: medicines
            .where((element) => !element.isTaken)
            .toList(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Time extends StatelessWidget {
  final TimeOfDay time;

  const _Time({required this.time});

  String get _timeDescription {
    if (time.hour < 7) {
      return t.strings.night;
    }

    if (time.hour < 12) {
      return t.strings.morning;
    }

    if (time.hour < 18) {
      return t.strings.afternoon;
    }

    return t.strings.evening;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(
          '${time.hour}:${time.minute} $_timeDescription',
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          fontSize: 14,
          color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _DashLine extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DashLine();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CustomPaint(
      size: Size(double.infinity, 1),
      painter: _DashLinePainter(
        color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        axis: Axis.horizontal,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashLinePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Color color;
  final Axis axis;

  final dashLength = 2;
  final gap = 2;

  _DashLinePainter({required this.color, required this.axis});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;

    if (axis == Axis.vertical) {
      drawVerticalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }

    if (axis == Axis.horizontal) {
      drawHorizontalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }
  }

  void drawVerticalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.height - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(0, i),
        Offset(0, min((i + dashLength), size.height).toDouble()),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  void drawHorizontalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.width - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(i, 0),
        Offset(min((i + dashLength), size.width).toDouble(), 0),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

class _MedicinesList extends StatelessWidget {
  final PatientMedicinesBloc bloc;
  final List<MedicineModel> medicines;

  const _MedicinesList({required this.bloc, required this.medicines});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (medicines.isEmpty) {
      return ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: 32),
        child: Center(
          child: PNText(
            context.t.strings.allMedicinesTaken,
            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      children: List.generate(
        medicines.length,
        (index) => Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.only(
            bottom: index == medicines.length - 1 ? 0 : 8,
          ),
          child: _Item(
            // onChanged:
            //     (value) => bloc.updateMedicineTake(medicines[index].id, value),
            onChanged: (_) {},
            medicine: medicines[index],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Item extends StatelessWidget {
  final Function(bool value) onChanged;
  final MedicineModel medicine;

  const _Item({required this.onChanged, required this.medicine});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            PNText(
              medicine.name,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              fontSize: 16,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),

            SizedBox(height: 2),
            PNText(
              '${context.t.strings.capsule(n: medicine.pillCount)} / ${medicine.mass} mg',
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
              fontSize: 12,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 2),
            PNText(
              medicine.recommendedTime,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
              fontSize: 12,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        Spacer(),
        _Check(value: medicine.isTaken, onChanged: onChanged),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _Check extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool value;
  final void Function(bool value) onChanged;

  const _Check({required this.value, required this.onChanged});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AnimatedContainer(
      duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border.all(color: PNCommonColors.goodColor, width: 1),
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        color: value
            ? PNCommonColors.goodColor
            : context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
      ),
      width: 32,
      height: 32,
      child: Material(
        color: Colors.transparent,
        shape: CircleBorder(),
        clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
        child: InkWell(
          onTap: () => onChanged(!value),
          highlightColor:
              (value
                      ? context.pNTheme.cardBackground
                      : PNCommonColors.goodColor)
                  .withValues(alpha: 0.4),
          child: Icon(
            Icons.check,
            color: value
                ? context.pNTheme.cardBackground
                : PNCommonColors.goodColor,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/patient/stimulator/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/overview/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/overview/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PatientStimulatorBloc extends Cubit<PatientStimulatorState> {
  final PatientOverviewRepository _overviewRepository;

  PatientStimulatorBloc(this._overviewRepository)
    : super(PatientStimulatorState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(PatientStimulatorState.loading());

    final response = await _overviewRepository.getStimulatorCharge(
      DateTime.now(),
      patientId: patientId,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(PatientStimulatorState.loaded(chargePercent: data.chargePercent));
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(PatientStimulatorState.error());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return (false, null);
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Charge extends StatelessWidget {
  final int chargePercent;

  const _Charge({required this.chargePercent});

  Color get _color {
    final value = chargePercent.clamp(0, 100);

    if (value < 50) {
      return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    }

    if (value < 75) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    }

    return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AutoSizeText(
      '$chargePercent%',
      style: PNTextStyle(
        fontSize: 46,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        color: _color,
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PatientTodayEventsBloc extends Cubit<PatientTodayEventsState> {
  final PatientEventsRepository _eventsRepository;

  PatientTodayEventsBloc(this._eventsRepository)
    : super(const PatientTodayEventsState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int patientId) async {
    emit(const PatientTodayEventsState.loading());

    final response = await _eventsRepository.getDayEvents(
      DateTime.now().roundToDayStart(),
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final events = data.events;

        final totalEvents = events.length;
        final completedEvents = events.where((e) => e.done).length;

        final mandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory)
            .length;

        final completedMandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory && e.done)
            .length;

        final optionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional)
            .length;

        final completedOptionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional && e.done)
            .length;

        final filteredMandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory && !e.done)
            .toList();

        emit(
          PatientTodayEventsState.loaded(
            totalEvents: totalEvents,
            completedEvents: completedEvents,
            totalMandatoryEvents: mandatoryEvents,
            completedMandatoryEvents: completedMandatoryEvents,
            totalOptionalEvents: optionalEvents,
            completedOptionalEvents: completedOptionalEvents,
            previewEvents: filteredMandatoryEvents.take(3).toList(),
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(PatientTodayEventsState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> update(EventModel event, bool newStatus) async {
    if (state is! PatientTodayEventsStateLoaded) return;

    final data = (state as PatientTodayEventsStateLoaded);

    final newCompletedEvents = data.completedEvents + (newStatus ? 1 : -1);

    final newCompletedMandatoryEvents =
        data.completedMandatoryEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => event.taskType == TaskType.mandatory ? 1 : 0,
          false => event.taskType == TaskType.mandatory ? -1 : 0,
        };

    final newCompletedOptionalEvents =
        data.completedOptionalEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => event.taskType == TaskType.optional ? 1 : 0,
          false => event.taskType == TaskType.optional ? -1 : 0,
        };

    final events = data.previewEvents;

    final updateEvents = events
        .map((e) => e.id == event.id ? event.copyWith(done: newStatus) : e)
        .toList();

    emit(
      PatientTodayEventsState.loaded(
        totalEvents: data.totalEvents,
        completedEvents: newCompletedEvents,
        totalMandatoryEvents: data.totalMandatoryEvents,
        completedMandatoryEvents: newCompletedMandatoryEvents,
        totalOptionalEvents: data.totalOptionalEvents,
        completedOptionalEvents: newCompletedOptionalEvents,
        previewEvents: updateEvents,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class PatientTodayEventsState with _$PatientTodayEventsState {

      PatientTodayEventsStateLoading;

    required int completedEvents,
    required int totalEvents,

    required int completedOptionalEvents,
    required int totalOptionalEvents,
    required List<EventModel> previewEvents,
  }) = PatientTodayEventsStateLoaded;
  const factory PatientTodayEventsState.error() = PatientTodayEventsStateError;
}

class PatientEventsWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  static double minHeight = 168;

  const PatientEventsWidget({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(DoctorProviderBloc.patient.todayEvents);

    return BlocBuilder<PatientTodayEventsBloc, PatientTodayEventsState>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        child: state.map(
          loading: (_) => _Loading(),
          loaded: (data) => _Loaded(
            bloc: bloc,
            completedEvents: data.completedEvents,
            totalEvents: data.totalEvents,
            completedMandatoryEvents: data.completedMandatoryEvents,
            totalMandatoryEvents: data.totalMandatoryEvents,
            completedOptionalEvents: data.completedOptionalEvents,
            totalOptionalEvents: data.totalOptionalEvents,
            previewEvents: data.previewEvents,
            onTap: () {},
          ),
          error: (_) => _Error(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashLine extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DashLine();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CustomPaint(
      size: Size(double.infinity, 1),
      painter: _DashLinePainter(
        color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        axis: Axis.horizontal,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashLinePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Color color;
  final Axis axis;

  final dashLength = 2;
  final gap = 2;

  _DashLinePainter({required this.color, required this.axis});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;

    if (axis == Axis.vertical) {
      drawVerticalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }

    if (axis == Axis.horizontal) {
      drawHorizontalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }
  }

  void drawVerticalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.height - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(0, i),
        Offset(0, min((i + dashLength), size.height).toDouble()),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  void drawHorizontalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.width - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(i, 0),
        Offset(min((i + dashLength), size.width).toDouble(), 0),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

class _EventsCounter extends StatelessWidget {
  final int completedEvents;
  final int totalEvents;
  final int completedMandatoryEvents;
  final int totalMandatoryEvents;
  final int completedOptionalEvents;
  final int totalOptionalEvents;

  const _EventsCounter({
    required this.completedEvents,
    required this.totalEvents,
    required this.completedMandatoryEvents,
    required this.totalMandatoryEvents,
    required this.completedOptionalEvents,
    required this.totalOptionalEvents,
  });

  Color get _totalEventsColor {
    if (completedEvents == totalEvents) {
      return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalEvents - completedEvents <= 4) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    }

    return PNCommonColors.badColor;
  }

  Color get _mandatoryEventsColor {
    if (completedMandatoryEvents == totalMandatoryEvents) {
      return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalMandatoryEvents - completedMandatoryEvents <= 4) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    }

    return PNCommonColors.badColor;
  }

  Color get _optionalEventsColor {
    if (completedOptionalEvents == totalOptionalEvents) {
      return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalOptionalEvents - completedOptionalEvents <= 4) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    }

    return PNCommonColors.badColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 44,
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
        children: [
          AutoSizeText(
            "$completedEvents/$totalEvents",
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: PNTextStyle(
              color: _totalEventsColor,
              fontSize: 46,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(width: 12),
          Spacer(),
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
            child: ConstrainedBox(
              constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 156),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        AutoSizeText(
                          "${context.t.strings.mandatory}:",
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Spacer(),
                        AutoSizeText(
                          "$completedMandatoryEvents/$totalMandatoryEvents",
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: _mandatoryEventsColor,
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Row(
                      children: [
                        AutoSizeText(
                          "${context.t.strings.optional}:",
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            fontSize: 14,
                            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                          ),
                        ),

                        Spacer(),
                        AutoSizeText(
                          "$completedOptionalEvents/$totalOptionalEvents",
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: _optionalEventsColor,
                            fontSize: 14,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _ItemsList extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<EventModel> events;
  final void Function(EventModel event, bool newStatus)? onEventStatusChanged;

  const _ItemsList({required this.events, this.onEventStatusChanged});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (events.isEmpty) {
      return ConstrainedBox(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: 32),
        child: Center(
          child: PNText(
            context.t.strings.allTaskCompleted,
            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            fontSize: 14,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: List.generate(events.length, (index) {
        final event = events[index];
        return _Item(
          event: event,
          onTap: (newStatus) => onEventStatusChanged?.call(event, newStatus),
        );
      }),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/features/patients/search/widget.dart ===
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/colors/pn_colors.dart';
import '../../../../../features/ui/text.dart';

class PatientsSearchWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  final String? initialSearchText;

  final void Function(String? search) onSearchUpdate;
  final void Function(String? search) onSearchSubmit;

  const PatientsSearchWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.initialSearchText,
    required this.onSearchUpdate,
    required this.onSearchSubmit,
  });

  @override
  State<PatientsSearchWidget> createState() => _PatientsSearchWidgetState();
}

class _PatientsSearchWidgetState extends State<PatientsSearchWidget> {
  late TextEditingController _controller;
  Timer? _debounce;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialSearchText);
  }

  void _onTextChanged(String text) {
    _debounce?.cancel();

    _debounce = Timer(Duration(milliseconds: 600), () {
      if (_controller.text.isEmpty) {
        widget.onSearchUpdate(null);
        return;
      }
      widget.onSearchUpdate(_controller.text);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CupertinoTextField(
      controller: _controller,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(12)),
      ),
      placeholder: context.t.strings.searchPatient,
      cursorColor: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 12),
      style: PNTextStyle(
        color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
        fontSize: 16,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
      ),
      placeholderStyle: PNTextStyle(
        color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        fontSize: 16,
        fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
      ),
      onChanged: _onTextChanged,
      onSubmitted: (value) {
        if (value.isEmpty) {
          widget.onSearchSubmit(null);
          return;
        }
        widget.onSearchSubmit(value);
      },
      suffix: CupertinoButton(
        padding: EdgeInsets.only(right: 16, left: 8),
        sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
        child: Icon(
          CupertinoIcons.search,
          size: 24,
          color: PNCommonColors.primaryColor,
        ),
        onPressed: () {
          if (_controller.text.isEmpty) {
            widget.onSearchSubmit(null);
            return;
          }
          widget.onSearchSubmit(_controller.text);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _debounce?.cancel();
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

class _Logout extends ConsumerWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  const _Logout({
    this.borderRadius = const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(12)),
  });

  Future<void> _showLogoutDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    VoidCallback onConfirm,
  ) => Navigator.of(context).push(
    CupertinoModalPopupRoute(
      barrierColor: const Color(0xFF000000).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
      builder: (_) => BackdropFilter(
        filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 3, sigmaY: 3),
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          children: [
            PNConfirmDialog(
              title: context.t.strings.areYouSureLogout,
              onConfirm: onConfirm,
              confirmText: context.t.strings.yes,
              cancelText: context.t.strings.no,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tokenRepository = ref.watch(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    return CupertinoButton(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
      sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
      color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
      onPressed: () => _showLogoutDialog(rootNavigatorKey.currentContext!, () {
        tokenRepository.logout();
        PNSnack.show(text: context.t.strings.successfullyLoggedOut);
        AppNavigator.openAuthorizationPage();
      }),
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Container(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(24 * 2)),

        width: double.infinity,
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            PNText(
              context.t.strings.logoutFromAccount,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              fontSize: context.au(14),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: 8),
            Icon(
              Icons.logout_outlined,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              size: context.au(16),
            ),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../navigation/router.dart';
import '../../../utils/router.dart';
import 'routers_name.dart';

final class DoctorNavigator {
  DoctorNavigator._();

  static BuildContext get _context => rootNavigatorKey.currentContext!;

  static void openProfile() {
    // _context.goNamed(DoctorRoutesName.profile.name);
  }

  static void openHome() {
    _context.goNamed(DoctorRoutesName.home.name);
  }

  static void openPatients({String? searchQuery}) {
    _context.goNamed(
      DoctorRoutesName.patients.name,

      queryParameters: {
        if (searchQuery != null) DoctorQueriesName.search: searchQuery,
      },
    );
  }

  static void openPatient(String patientId, {String? searchQuery}) {
    final referral = GoRouter.maybeOf(_context)?.state.fullPathWithQuery;

    _context.pushNamed(
      DoctorRoutesName.patient.name,
      pathParameters: {DoctorPathParamsName.patientId: patientId},
      queryParameters: {
        if (referral != null) DoctorQueriesName.referral: referral,
      },
    );
  }

  static void openAppointment() {
    _context.goNamed(DoctorRoutesName.appointment.name);
  }

  static void openServices() {
    _context.goNamed(DoctorRoutesName.services.name);
  }

  static void openSettings() {
    _context.goNamed(DoctorRoutesName.settings.name);
  }

  static void openAboutApp() =>
      _context.goNamed(DoctorRoutesName.aboutApp.name);
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

GoRoute doctorRouter = GoRoute(
  path: DoctorRoutesName.base,
  name: DoctorRoutesName.base,
  redirect: (context, state) {
    final tokenRepository = ProviderScope.containerOf(
      context,
    ).read<TokenRepository>(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    if (!tokenRepository.haveValidToken()) {
      // PNSnack.show(
      //   text: context.t.strings.pleasLoginToContinue,
      //   type: PNSnackType.error,
      // );
      return RoutesName.auth;
    }

    if (!tokenRepository.canAccessDoctorApp()) {
      // PNSnack.show(
      //   text: context.t.strings.enterDoctorAccount,
      //   type: PNSnackType.error,
      // );
      return RoutesName.auth;
    }

    if (state.fullPath == DoctorRoutesName.base) {
      return "${DoctorRoutesName.base}/${DoctorRoutesName.home.path}";
    }

    return null;
  },
  routes: [
    StatefulShellRoute(
      builder: (context, state, navigationShell) {
        return navigationShell;
      },
      pageBuilder: (context, state, navigationShell) =>
          FadeTransitionPage(key: state.pageKey, child: navigationShell),
      navigatorContainerBuilder: (context, navigationShell, children) =>
          DoctorScaffold(
            state: navigationShell.shellRouteContext.routerState,
            child: AnimatedBranch(
              currentIndex: navigationShell.currentIndex,
              children: children,
            ),
          ),
      branches: [
        StatefulShellBranch(
          routes: [
            GoRoute(
              path: DoctorRoutesName.home.path,
              name: DoctorRoutesName.home.name,
              builder: (context, state) => HomePage(),
              routes: [],
            ),
          ],
        ),
        StatefulShellBranch(
          routes: [
            GoRoute(
              path: DoctorRoutesName.patients.path,
              name: DoctorRoutesName.patients.name,
              builder: (context, state) {
                final searchQuery =
                    state.uri.queryParameters[DoctorQueriesName.search];

                return PatientsPage(searchQuery: searchQuery);
              },
              routes: [],
            ),
          ],
        ),
        StatefulShellBranch(
          routes: [
            GoRoute(
              path: DoctorRoutesName.appointment.path,
              name: DoctorRoutesName.appointment.name,
              builder: (context, state) => AppointmentPage(),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        StatefulShellBranch(
          routes: [
            GoRoute(
              path: DoctorRoutesName.services.path,
              name: DoctorRoutesName.services.name,
              builder: (context, state) => ServicesPage(),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        StatefulShellBranch(
          routes: [
            GoRoute(
              path: DoctorRoutesName.settings.path,
              name: DoctorRoutesName.settings.name,
              builder: (context, state) => SettingsPage(),
              routes: [
                GoRoute(
                  path: DoctorRoutesName.aboutApp.path,
                  name: DoctorRoutesName.aboutApp.name,
                  pageBuilder: (context, state) =>
                      MaterialPage(child: AboutAppPage()),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path:
          "${DoctorRoutesName.patient.path}/:${DoctorPathParamsName.patientId}",
      name: DoctorRoutesName.patient.name,
      redirect: (context, state) {
        final patientIdStr =
            state.pathParameters[DoctorPathParamsName.patientId];

        if (patientIdStr == null) {
          return "${DoctorRoutesName.base}/${DoctorRoutesName.patients.path}";
        }

        final patientId = int.tryParse(patientIdStr);

        if (patientId == null) {
          return "${DoctorRoutesName.base}/${DoctorRoutesName.patients.path}";
        }

        return null;
      },
      pageBuilder: (context, state) {
        final patientIdStr =
            state.pathParameters[DoctorPathParamsName.patientId];
        final referral = state.uri.queryParameters[DoctorQueriesName.referral];

        if (patientIdStr == null) {
          throw Exception("patientId  wasn't provide");
        }

        return MaterialPage(
          child: PatientPage(
            patientId: int.parse(patientIdStr),
            referral: referral,
          ),
        );
      },
    ),
  ],
);

=== FILE: apps/doctor/navigation/widgets/animated_branch.dart ===
import 'package:animations/animations.dart';
import 'package:collection/collection.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AnimatedBranch extends StatefulWidget {
  /// Creates a AnimatedBranchContainer
  const AnimatedBranch({
    super.key,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.children,
  });

  /// The index (in [children]) of the branch Navigator to display.
  final int currentIndex;

  /// The children (branch Navigators) to display in this container.
  final List<Widget> children;

  @override
  State<AnimatedBranch> createState() => _AnimatedBranchState();
}

class _AnimatedBranchState extends State<AnimatedBranch>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  final List<(AnimationController, AnimationController)> _controllers = [];
  @override
  void initState() {
    for (var i = 0; i < widget.children.length; i++) {
      final controller = AnimationController(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
        vsync: this,
      );
      final controller2 = AnimationController(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
        vsync: this,
      );
      if (i == widget.currentIndex) {
        controller.value = 1;
      }
      _controllers.add((controller, controller2));
    }

    super.initState();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(AnimatedBranch oldWidget) {
    switch (widget.currentIndex.compareTo(oldWidget.currentIndex)) {
      case 1:
        _controllers[oldWidget.currentIndex].$2.forward();

        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$2.value = 0;
        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$1.forward(from: 0);

        break;
      case -1:
        _controllers[oldWidget.currentIndex].$1.reverse();

        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$1.value = 1;
        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$2.reverse(from: 1);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // return PageTransitionSwitcher(
    //   transitionBuilder: (child, primaryAnimation, secondaryAnimation) {
    //     return SharedAxisTransition(
    //       animation: primaryAnimation,
    //       secondaryAnimation: secondaryAnimation,
    //       transitionType: SharedAxisTransitionType.horizontal,
    //       fillColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
    //       child: child,
    //     );
    //   },
    //   child: _branchNavigatorWrapper(
    //     widget.currentIndex,
    //     widget.children[widget.currentIndex],
    //   ),
    // );

    return Stack(
      children: widget.children.mapIndexed((int index, Widget navigator) {
        return _branchNavigatorWrapper(
          index,
          RepaintBoundary(
            child: SharedAxisTransition(
              animation: _controllers[index].$1,
              secondaryAnimation: _controllers[index].$2,
              transitionType: SharedAxisTransitionType.horizontal,
              // fillColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
              fillColor: Colors.transparent,
              child: navigator,
            ),
          ),
        );
      }).toList(),
    );
  }

  Widget _branchNavigatorWrapper(int index, Widget navigator) => IgnorePointer(
    ignoring: index != widget.currentIndex,
    child: TickerMode(enabled: index == widget.currentIndex, child: navigator),
  );
}

=== FILE: apps/doctor/navigation/widgets/scaffold.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/navigation.dart';
import '../navigator.dart';
import '../routers_name.dart';

class DoctorScaffold extends StatelessWidget {
  final GoRouterState state;
  final Widget child;

  const DoctorScaffold({super.key, required this.state, required this.child});

  int get _selectedIndex {
    final fullPath = state.fullPath ?? "";

    if (fullPath.contains(DoctorRoutesName.home.path)) return 0;
    if (fullPath.contains(DoctorRoutesName.patients.path)) return 1;

    if (fullPath.contains(DoctorRoutesName.settings.path)) return 2;

    return -1;
  }

  bool get _needNavbar {
    final fullPath = state.fullPath ?? "";

    if (fullPath.endsWith(DoctorRoutesName.home.path)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(DoctorRoutesName.patients.path)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(DoctorRoutesName.appointment.path)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(DoctorRoutesName.services.path)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(DoctorRoutesName.settings.path)) return true;

    return false;
  }

  void _onItemTap(int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        DoctorNavigator.openHome();
        break;
      case 1:
        DoctorNavigator.openPatients();
        break;
      case 2:
        DoctorNavigator.openSettings();
        break;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return PNNavigationScaffold(
      selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
      needNavbar: _needNavbar,
      onItemTap: _onItemTap,
      items: [
        'assets/icons/navbar/home.svg',
        'assets/icons/navbar/chats.svg',
        'assets/icons/navbar/settings.svg',
      ],
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import '../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../core/ui/widgets/cropscroll/listview.dart';
import '../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/primary.dart';
import '../features/home/counter/ui/widget.dart';
import '../features/home/online_consultations/ui/widget.dart';
import '../features/home/waiting_chats/ui/widget.dart';
import '../provider/bloc.dart';

class HomePage extends HookConsumerWidget {
  const HomePage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final t = Translations.of(context);

    final counterBloc = ref.watch(DoctorProviderBloc.home.counter);
    final waitingChatsBloc = ref.watch(DoctorProviderBloc.home.waitingChats);
    final onlineConsultationsBloc = ref.watch(
      DoctorProviderBloc.home.onlineConsultations,
    );

    useEffect(() {
      counterBloc.refresh();
      waitingChatsBloc.refresh();
      onlineConsultationsBloc.refresh();
      return null;
    }, []);

    final horizontalPadding = AppUISettings.horizontalPadding;
    final itemVerticalPadding = AppUISettings.paddingValue;

    // final itemsBorderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius;
    final clipItemsBorderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius;

    return PNPrimaryScaffold(
      title: t.strings.summary.toUpperCase(),
      subtitle: DateFormat(
        "/ d MMMM",
        LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode,
      ).format(DateTime.now()),
      appBarHorizontalPadding: horizontalPadding,
      content: RefreshCropScroll(
        borderRadius: clipItemsBorderRadius,

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/about/version/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:package_info_plus/package_info_plus.dart';

import 'state.dart';

class AppVersionBloc extends Cubit<AppVersionState> {
  AppVersionBloc() : super(const AppVersionState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    try {
      final packageInfo = await PackageInfo.fromPlatform();

      final buildVersion = const String.fromEnvironment(
        "BUILD_VERSION",
        defaultValue: "BUILD_VERSION",
      );

      final buildNumber = const String.fromEnvironment(
        "BUILD_NUMBER",
        defaultValue: "BUILD_NUMBER",
      );

      final buildHash = const String.fromEnvironment(
        "BUILD_HASH",
        defaultValue: "BUILD_HASH",
      );

      DateTime? buildDate = DateTime.tryParse(
        const String.fromEnvironment("BUILD_DATE", defaultValue: ""),
      );

      DateTime? installTime = packageInfo.installTime;

      emit(
        AppVersionState.loaded(
          buildVersion: buildVersion,
          buildNumber: buildNumber,
          buildHash: buildHash == "BUILD_HASH"
              ? "BUILD_HASH"
              : buildHash.substring(0, 5),
          buildDate: buildDate?.toLocal(),
          installDate: installTime,
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      emit(
        AppVersionState.loaded(
          buildVersion: "N/A",
          buildNumber: "N/A",
          buildHash: "N/A",
          buildDate: null,
          installDate: null,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}

class AppVersionDialog extends StatelessWidget {
  final String buildVersion;
  final String buildNumber;
  final String buildHash;
  final DateTime? buildDate;
  final DateTime? installDate;

  const AppVersionDialog({
    super.key,
    required this.buildVersion,

    required this.buildNumber,
    required this.buildHash,
    this.buildDate,
    this.installDate,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

      children: [

class AppVersionWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  const AppVersionWidget({super.key});

  Future<void> _showAppVersionDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    String buildVersion,
    String buildNumber,
    String buildHash,
    DateTime? buildDate,
    DateTime? installDate,
  ) {
    return PNBottomSheet.show(
      content: PNBottomSheetBaseCard(
        header: context.t.strings.aboutBuild.capitalize(),
        content: AppVersionDialog(
          buildVersion: buildVersion,
          buildNumber: buildNumber,
          buildHash: buildHash,
          buildDate: buildDate,
          installDate: installDate,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.settings.appVersion);

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      ),
      width: double.infinity,
      child: Column(
        children: [
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            child: Image(
              image: AssetImage('assets/images/app_icon.png'),
              loadingBuilder: (context, child, loadingProgress) {
                if (loadingProgress == null) {
                  return child; // Image is fully loaded
                }
                return ShimmerEffect(
                  baseColor: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
                  highlightColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
                  child: Container(
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    height: 64,
                    width: 64,
                  ),
                );
              },
              height: 64,
              width: 64,
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            child: BlocBuilder<AppVersionBloc, AppVersionState>(
              bloc: bloc,
              builder: (context, state) => state.map(
                loading: (_) => PNText(
                  context.t.strings.loading,
                  color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                  fontSize: context.au(14),
                ),
                loaded: (data) => CupertinoButton(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
                  onPressed: null,
                  onLongPress: () => _showAppVersionDialog(
                    context,
                    data.buildVersion,
                    data.buildNumber,
                    data.buildHash,
                    data.buildDate,
                    data.installDate,
                  ),
                  child: PNText(
                    context.t.strings.appVersion(version: data.buildVersion),
                    color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                    fontSize: context.au(14),
                    textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/chat/header/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/chat/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/chat/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class ChatHeaderBloc extends Cubit<ChatHeaderState> {
  final ChatRepository _chatRepository;

  ChatHeaderBloc(this._chatRepository) : super(ChatHeaderState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(String chatId) async {
    emit(ChatHeaderState.loading());

    final response = await _chatRepository.getChatInfo(chatId);

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          ChatHeaderState.loaded(name: data.chat.name, chatId: data.chat.id),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(ChatHeaderState.error());
      },
    );
  }
}

class ChatHeaderWidget extends ConsumerWidget {
  static double height = 44;

  final String? referral;

  const ChatHeaderWidget({super.key, this.referral});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.chat.header);
    // final chatLisBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.chatsList);

    return BlocBuilder<ChatHeaderBloc, ChatHeaderState>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        child: state.map(
          loading: (_) => _Loading(),
          loaded: (data) => _Loaded(
            title: data.name,
            onBackTap: () {
              // chatLisBloc.refresh();

              if (referral == null) {
                PatientNavigator.openChats();
                return;
              }

              context.go(referral!);
            },
            onInfoTap: () {},
          ),
          error: (_) => _Error(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/chat/input/states/loaded.dart ===
part of '../widget.dart';

class _Loaded extends StatefulWidget {
  final String chatId;
  final ChatRepository chatRepository;

  const _Loaded({required this.chatId, required this.chatRepository});

  @override
  State<_Loaded> createState() => _LoadedState();
}

class _LoadedState extends State<_Loaded> {
  final TextEditingController _controller = TextEditingController();

  Future<void> _sendMessage(
    String value,
    String chatId,
    ChatRepository chatRepository,
  ) async {
    if (value.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    _controller.clear();

    value = value.trim();

    chatRepository.sendMessage(chatId, value);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground),
      height: context.au(ChatInputWidget.height),
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          _IconButton(
            icon: Icon(
              Icons.add,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
              size: context.au(24),
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(12),
              bottomLeft: Radius.circular(12),
            ),
            onTap: () {},
            height: ChatInputWidget.height,
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: _InputField(
              controller: _controller,
              onSubmitted: (value) =>
                  _sendMessage(value, widget.chatId, widget.chatRepository),
            ),
          ),
          _IconButton(
            icon: Icon(
              Icons.send,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
              size: context.au(24),
            ),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(12),
              bottomLeft: Radius.circular(12),
            ),
            onTap: () => _sendMessage(
              _controller.text,
              widget.chatId,
              widget.chatRepository,
            ),
            height: ChatInputWidget.height,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _IconButton extends StatelessWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  final Widget icon;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final double height;

  const _IconButton({
    required this.icon,
    required this.borderRadius,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.height,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CupertinoButton(
      onPressed: onTap,
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
      color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Container(
        height: height,
        width: height,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(borderRadius: borderRadius),
        alignment: Alignment.center,
        child: icon,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _InputField extends StatelessWidget {
  final TextEditingController controller;
  final void Function(String value) onSubmitted;

  const _InputField({required this.controller, required this.onSubmitted});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
      ),
      height: context.au(32),
      child: TextField(
        controller: controller,
        onSubmitted: onSubmitted,
        cursorHeight: context.au(14),

        style: PNTextStyle(
          color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
          fontSize: context.au(14),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
        ),
        scrollPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        textAlignVertical: TextAlignVertical.center,

        decoration: InputDecoration(
          constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: context.au(32)),

          // contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 9),
          contentPadding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 12, right: 12, bottom: 14),
          border: InputBorder.none, // Removes default underline
          hintText: context.t.strings.enterMessageHint,

          hintStyle: PNTextStyle(
            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            fontSize: context.au(14),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
