=== FILE: apps/patient/features/chat/messages/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/chat/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/chat/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class MessagesListBloc extends Cubit<MessagesListState> {
  final ChatRepository _chatRepository;

  MessagesListBloc(this._chatRepository) : super(MessagesListState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(String chatId) async {
    emit(MessagesListState.loading());

    final response = await _chatRepository.getChatMessagesStream(chatId);

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          MessagesListState.loaded(
            chatId: data.chatId,
            messageStream: data.stream,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(MessagesListState.error());
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/chats/chats_list/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/chat/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/chat/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class ChatsListBloc extends Cubit<ChatsListState> {
  final ChatRepository _chatRepository;

  ChatsListBloc(this._chatRepository) : super(ChatsListState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    if (state is ChatsListStateLoaded) {
      final chats = (state as ChatsListStateLoaded).chats;
      emit(ChatsListState.loading(loadingChatsCount: chats.length));
    } else {
      emit(ChatsListState.loading());
    }

    final response = await _chatRepository.getAllChats();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(ChatsListState.loaded(chats: data.chats));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(ChatsListState.error());
      },
    );
  }
}

class ChatsListState with _$ChatsListState {
  const factory ChatsListState.loading({@Default(5) int loadingChatsCount}) =

class _ChatItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final ChatModel chat;
  final void Function(String chatId) onTap;

  const _ChatItem({required this.chat, required this.onTap});

  String get _timeDescription {
    if (chat.lastMessageTime == null) {
      return "";
    }

    if (chat.lastMessageTime!.isSameDay(DateTime.now())) {
      return DateFormat("hh:mm").format(chat.lastMessageTime!);
    }

    return DateFormat("dd.mm hh:mm").format(chat.lastMessageTime!);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CupertinoButton(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
      onPressed: () => onTap(chat.id),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        width: double.infinity,
        constraints: BoxConstraints(
          minHeight: context.au(ChatsListWidget.itemHeight),
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Row(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            CircleAvatar(
              radius: context.au(20, 1, 1.2),
              backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
              child: Icon(Icons.person, color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: PNText(
                          chat.name,
                          fontSize: context.au(16),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (chat.lastMessageTime != null) SizedBox(width: 8),
                      if (chat.lastMessageTime != null)
                        PNText(
                          _timeDescription,
                          fontSize: context.au(16),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: chat.lastMessage == null
                            ? Container()
                            : PNText(
                                chat.lastMessage!,
                                fontSize: context.au(16),
                                fontWeight: chat.unreadMessages == 0
                                    ? FontWeight.w300
                                    : FontWeight.w500,
                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                color: chat.unreadMessages == 0
                                    ? context.pNTheme.secondaryText
                                    : context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                              ),
                      ),
                      if (chat.unreadMessages != 0) SizedBox(width: 8),
                      if (chat.unreadMessages != 0)
                        Container(
                          decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(72),
                            color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
                          ),
                          height: context.au(24),
                          alignment: Alignment.center,
                          child: ConstrainedBox(
                            constraints: BoxConstraints(
                              minWidth: context.au(24),
                            ),
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: context.au(8),
                              ),
                              child: Center(
                                child: PNText(
                                  chat.unreadMessages.toString(),
                                  fontSize: context.au(16),
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                                  color: context.pNTheme.onPrimaryControl,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';

class DateSelectorWeekTypeWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  static const double height = 44;

  final DateTime initialWeekAnchor;
  final DateTime initialSelectedDate;
  final void Function(DateTime date) onSelectedDateChanged;
  final void Function(DateTime weekAnchor) onWeekChanged;

  const DateSelectorWeekTypeWidget({
    super.key,
    required this.initialWeekAnchor,
    required this.initialSelectedDate,
    required this.onSelectedDateChanged,
    required this.onWeekChanged,
  });

  @override
  State<DateSelectorWeekTypeWidget> createState() =>
      _DateSelectorWeekTypeWidgetState();
}

class _DateSelectorWeekTypeWidgetState
    extends State<DateSelectorWeekTypeWidget> {
  late DateTime initialWeekAnchor;
  late DateTime selectedDate;

  PageController pageController = PageController();
  int currentPage = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    selectedDate = widget.initialSelectedDate;
    initialWeekAnchor = widget.initialWeekAnchor
        .roundToFirstDayOfWeek()
        .roundToDayStart();

    currentPage =
        selectedDate.difference(initialWeekAnchor).inDays.abs() ~/ 7 + 1;

    pageController = PageController(initialPage: currentPage);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return SizedBox(
      width: double.infinity,
      height: DateSelectorWeekTypeWidget.height,
      child: Row(
        children: [
          CupertinoButton(
            onPressed: () {
              pageController.nextPage(
                duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                curve: Curves.easeInOut,
              );
              currentPage++;

              final newWeekAnchor = initialWeekAnchor.subtract(
                Duration(days: currentPage * 7),
              );
              widget.onWeekChanged(newWeekAnchor);

              setState(() {});
            },
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
            child: SvgPicture.asset(
              'assets/icons/back2.svg',
              colorFilter: ColorFilter.mode(
                context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
                BlendMode.srcIn,
              ),
              width: context.au(24),
              height: context.au(24),
            ),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: PageView.builder(
              reverse: true,
              itemCount: 54,
              controller: pageController,
              onPageChanged: (newPage) {
                currentPage = newPage;

                final newWeekAnchor = initialWeekAnchor.subtract(
                  Duration(days: currentPage * 7),
                );
                widget.onWeekChanged(newWeekAnchor);

                setState(() {});
              },
              itemBuilder: (context, index) => _WeekDates(
                onDateTap: (date) {
                  selectedDate = date;
                  setState(() {});
                  widget.onSelectedDateChanged(date);
                },
                weekAnchor: initialWeekAnchor.subtract(
                  Duration(days: index * 7),
                ),
                selectedDate: selectedDate,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          CupertinoButton(
            onPressed: currentPage == 0
                ? null
                : () {
                    pageController.previousPage(
                      duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                      curve: Curves.easeInOut,
                    );

                    currentPage--;

                    final newWeekAnchor = initialWeekAnchor.subtract(
                      Duration(days: currentPage * 7),
                    );
                    widget.onWeekChanged(newWeekAnchor);
                    setState(() {});
                  },
            padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
            child: RotatedBox(
              quarterTurns: -2,
              child: SvgPicture.asset(
                'assets/icons/back2.svg',
                colorFilter: ColorFilter.mode(
                  context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
                  BlendMode.srcIn,
                ),
                width: context.au(24),
                height: context.au(24),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/discipline/date_picker/widget.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';

import '../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../features/ui/drop_down.dart';
import '../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../../../navigation/path_params/discipline.dart';

class DisciplineDatePicker extends HookWidget {
  final DisciplineGroupType groupType;
  final DateTime date;
  final void Function(DisciplineGroupType groupType)? onGroupTypeChanged;
  final void Function(DateTime dateTime)? onDateChanged;

  const DisciplineDatePicker({
    super.key,
    required this.groupType,
    required this.date,
    this.onGroupTypeChanged,
    this.onDateChanged,
  });

  List<(DateTime, DateTime)> _generateWeeks(DateTime begin, DateTime end) {
    DateTime iter = begin.roundToFirstDayOfWeek();

    final List<(DateTime, DateTime)> weeks = [];
    end = end.roundToLastDayOfWeek();

    while (true) {
      weeks.add((iter.roundToFirstDayOfWeek(), iter.roundToLastDayOfWeek()));

      iter = iter.add(Duration(days: 7));

      if (iter.isAfter(end)) {
        break;
      }
    }

    return weeks;
  }

  List<DateTime> _generateMonths(DateTime begin, DateTime end) {
    DateTime iter = begin.roundToFirstDayOfMonth();

    final List<DateTime> months = [];
    end = end.roundToLastDayOfMonth();

    while (true) {
      months.add(iter.roundToFirstDayOfMonth());

      iter = iter.addMonths(1);

      if (iter.isAfter(end)) {
        break;
      }
    }

    return months;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // final t = Translations.of(context);

    final now = DateTime.now();

    final weeks = _generateWeeks(AppSettings.minDate, now);
    final months = _generateMonths(AppSettings.minDate, now);
    final years = List.generate(
      1 + now.year - AppSettings.minDate.year,
      (index) => DateTime(AppSettings.minDate.year + index),
    );

    final selectedWeek = useMemoized(() {
      for (int i = 0; i < weeks.length; i++) {
        if (date.isBetween(weeks[i].$1, weeks[i].$2)) {
          return i;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }, [date]);

    final selectedMonth = useMemoized(() {
      for (int i = 0; i < months.length; i++) {
        if (date.isSameMonth(months[i])) {
          return i;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }, [date]);

    final selectedYear = useMemoized(() {
      for (int i = 0; i < years.length; i++) {
        if (date.isSameYear(years[i])) {
          return i;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }, [date]);

    return Column(
      children: [
        PNDropDown(
          onChanged: (index) {
            if (index == null) {
              return;
            }

            onGroupTypeChanged?.call(DisciplineGroupType.values[index]);
          },
          selectedIndex: groupType.index,
          options: DisciplineGroupType.values.map((e) => e.name).toList(),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.smallPaddingValue),
        PNDropDown(
          onChanged: (int? optionIndex) {
            if (optionIndex == null) {
              return;
            }

            onDateChanged?.call(switch (groupType) {
              DisciplineGroupType.week => weeks[optionIndex].$1,
              DisciplineGroupType.month => months[optionIndex],
              DisciplineGroupType.year => years[optionIndex],
            });
          },
          selectedIndex: switch (groupType) {
            DisciplineGroupType.week => selectedWeek,
            DisciplineGroupType.month => selectedMonth,
            DisciplineGroupType.year => selectedYear,
          },
          options: switch (groupType) {
            DisciplineGroupType.week =>
              weeks
                  .map(
                    (e) =>
                        "${PNDateFormatter(e.$1, format: "dd MMMM${e.$1.isSameYear(now) ? "" : " yyyy"}")} - ${PNDateFormatter(e.$2, format: "dd MMMM${e.$2.isSameYear(now) ? "" : " yyyy"}")}",
                  )
                  .toList(),
            DisciplineGroupType.month =>
              months
                  .map(
                    (e) => PNDateFormatter(
                      e,
                      format: "LLLL ${e.isSameYear(now) ? "" : " yyyy"}",
                    ).toString(),
                  )
                  .toList(),
            DisciplineGroupType.year =>
              years
                  .map((e) => PNDateFormatter(e, format: "yyyy").toString())
                  .toList(),
          },
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/discipline/pass_events/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/response.dart';
import '../../../../navigation/path_params/discipline.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class DisciplinePassEventsBloc extends Cubit<DisciplinePassEventsState> {
  final DisciplineRepository _disciplineRepository;

  DisciplinePassEventsBloc(this._disciplineRepository)
    : super(DisciplinePassEventsState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh({
    required DisciplineGroupType groupType,
    required DateTime date,
    Future<GetDisciplineResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    emit(DisciplinePassEventsState.loading());

    final response =
        await (cacheRequest ??
            _disciplineRepository.getDiscipline(
              date: date,
              groupType: groupType,
            ));

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        if (data.bestDate == null || data.worstDate == null) {
          emit(DisciplinePassEventsState.notEnoughData());
          return;
        }

        emit(
          DisciplinePassEventsState.loaded(
            passed: data.skippedCount,
            total: data.doneCount + data.lateCount + data.lateCount,
            passReasons: data.passReasons,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(DisciplinePassEventsState.error());
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;
  final int passed;
  final int total;

  final List<(String, int)> passReasons;

  const _Loaded({
    this.borderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius,
    this.passed = 40,
    this.total = 100,
    this.passReasons = const [],
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = context.pNTheme;
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final passedValue = (passed / total).clamp(0, 1);
    final passedPercent = (passedValue * 100).toInt();

    return PNCard(
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
          PNText(
            strings.passEvents,
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            height: 1,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.smallPaddingValue),
          PNText(
            "${strings.eventsCount(n: passed)} ($passedPercent%)",
            fontSize: context.au(18),
            height: 1,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            color: theme.badColor,
          ),
          if (passReasons.isNotEmpty)
            SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          if (passReasons.isNotEmpty)
            PNText(
              strings.passReasons,
              fontSize: context.au(16),
              height: 1,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            ),
          if (passReasons.isNotEmpty)
            SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.smallPaddingValue),
          if (passReasons.isNotEmpty)
            ...List.generate(
              passReasons.length,
              (index) => _Item(value: passReasons[index]),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Item extends StatelessWidget {
  final (String, int) value;

  const _Item({required this.value});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: PNText(
            value.$1,
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            height: 22 / 16,
          ),
        ),
        PNText(
          value.$2.toString(),
          fontSize: 16,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          height: 22 / 16,
          color: theme.badColor,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/discipline/statistics/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/response.dart';
import '../../../../navigation/path_params/discipline.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class DisciplineStatisticsBloc extends Cubit<DisciplineStatisticsState> {
  final DisciplineRepository _disciplineRepository;

  DisciplineStatisticsBloc(this._disciplineRepository)
    : super(DisciplineStatisticsState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh({
    required DisciplineGroupType groupType,
    required DateTime date,
    Future<GetDisciplineResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    final placeholderGroupType = state.mapOrNull(
      week: (_) => DisciplineGroupType.week,
      month: (_) => DisciplineGroupType.month,
      year: (_) => DisciplineGroupType.year,
    );

    emit(
      DisciplineStatisticsState.loading(
        placeholderGroupType: placeholderGroupType,
      ),
    );

    final response =
        await (cacheRequest ??
            _disciplineRepository.getDiscipline(
              date: date,
              groupType: groupType,
            ));

    final error = response.mapOrNull(error: (data) => data.error);

    if (error != null) {
      emit(DisciplineStatisticsState.error());
      return;
    }

    final (bestDate, worstDate, groups, notEnoughData) = response.map(
      success: (data) =>
          (data.bestDate, data.worstDate, data.groups, data.notEnoughData),
      error: (data) => (null, null, <(DateTime, List<double>)>[], false),
    );

    if (notEnoughData) {
      emit(DisciplineStatisticsState.notEnoughData());
      return;
    }

    if (bestDate == null || worstDate == null || groups.isEmpty) {
      emit(DisciplineStatisticsState.error());
      return;
    }

    switch (groupType) {
      case DisciplineGroupType.week:
        emit(
          DisciplineStatisticsState.week(
            statistics: groups,
            bestWeekDayIndex: bestDate.weekday,
            worstWeekDayIndex: worstDate.weekday,
          ),
        );
        break;
      case DisciplineGroupType.month:
        emit(
          DisciplineStatisticsState.month(
            statistics: groups
                .map((e) => ((e.$1, e.$1.add(Duration(days: 7 - 1))), e.$2))
                .toList(),
            bestWeek: (bestDate, bestDate),
            worstWeek: (worstDate, worstDate),
          ),
        );
        break;
      case DisciplineGroupType.year:
        emit(
          DisciplineStatisticsState.year(
            statistics: groups,
            bestMonthIndex: bestDate.month,
            worstMonthIndex: worstDate.month,
          ),
        );
        break;
    }
  }
}

part of '../widget.dart';

class _Month extends StatelessWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  final List<((DateTime, DateTime), List<double>)>? statistics;
  final (DateTime, DateTime)? bestWeek;
  final (DateTime, DateTime)? worstWeek;

  const _Month({
    this.borderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius,
    this.statistics,
    this.bestWeek,
    this.worstWeek,
  });

  List<((DateTime, DateTime), List<double>)> get _defaultStatistics {
    final weekStart1 = DateTime.now().today().roundToFirstDayOfWeek();
    final weekStart2 = weekStart1
        .add(Duration(days: 7))
        .roundToFirstDayOfWeek();
    final weekStart3 = weekStart2
        .add(Duration(days: 7))
        .roundToFirstDayOfWeek();
    final weekStart4 = weekStart3
        .add(Duration(days: 7))
        .roundToFirstDayOfWeek();

    return [
      ((weekStart1, weekStart1.roundToLastDayOfWeek()), [0.3, 0.4, 0.3]),
      ((weekStart2, weekStart2.roundToLastDayOfWeek()), [0.2, 0.5, 0.3]),
      ((weekStart3, weekStart3.roundToLastDayOfWeek()), [0.1, 0.6, 0.3]),
      ((weekStart4, weekStart4.roundToLastDayOfWeek()), [0.4, 0.3, 0.3]),
    ];
  }

  (DateTime, DateTime) get _defaultBestWeek {
    final weekStart = DateTime.now().roundToFirstDayOfWeek();

    return (weekStart, weekStart.roundToLastDayOfWeek());
  }

  (DateTime, DateTime) get _defaultWorstWeek {
    final weekStart = DateTime.now().roundToFirstDayOfWeek().add(
      Duration(days: 7),
    );

    return (weekStart, weekStart.roundToLastDayOfWeek());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    final values = statistics ?? _defaultStatistics;
    final bestWeekValue = bestWeek ?? _defaultBestWeek;
    final worstWeekValue = worstWeek ?? _defaultWorstWeek;

    final weekNameStyle = PNTextStyle(
      color: theme.primaryText,
      fontSize: context.au(12),
      height: 1,
      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
    );

    final weekNames = values
        .map(
          (e) =>
              "${PNDateFormatter(e.$1.$1, format: "dd.MM")} - ${PNDateFormatter(e.$1.$2, format: "dd.MM")}",
        )
        .toList();

    // TODO: fix text size calculator
    final weekNamesWidths = weekNames
        .map(
          (e) =>
              TextSizeCalculator.calculateAdaptive(e, weekNameStyle).$1.width *
              1.1,
        )
        .toList();

    return PNCard(
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: _Layout(
        title: strings.statisticsBy.week,
        content: Column(
          spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
          children: List.generate(
            values.length,
            (index) => _MonthItem(
              value: (weekNames[index], values[index].$2),
              weekNameStyle: weekNameStyle,
              weekNamesWidth: weekNamesWidths.max,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        best: (
          strings.bestPeriod.week,
          "${PNDateFormatter(bestWeekValue.$1, format: "dd MMMM")} - ${PNDateFormatter(bestWeekValue.$2, format: "dd MMMM")}",
        ),
        worst: (
          strings.badPeriod.week,
          "${PNDateFormatter(worstWeekValue.$1, format: "dd MMMM")} - ${PNDateFormatter(worstWeekValue.$2, format: "dd MMMM")}",
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _MonthItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final (String, List<double>) value;
  final TextStyle weekNameStyle;
  final double weekNamesWidth;

  const _MonthItem({
    required this.value,
    required this.weekNameStyle,
    required this.weekNamesWidth,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        SizedBox(
          width: weekNamesWidth,
          child: Text(value.$1, style: weekNameStyle),
        ),
        SizedBox(width: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
        Expanded(child: ProgressBar(stages: value.$2)),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _Week extends StatelessWidget {

  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  final List<(DateTime, List<double>)>? statistics;
  final int bestWeekDayIndex;
  final int worstWeekDayIndex;

  final double progressBarHeight;

  const _Week({
    this.borderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius,
    this.statistics,
    this.bestWeekDayIndex = 5,
    this.worstWeekDayIndex = 1,
    // ignore: unused_element_parameter
    this.progressBarHeight = 196,
  });

  List<(DateTime, List<double>)> get _defaultStatistics {
    final today = DateTime.now().today();

    return [
      (today, [0.3, 0.4, 0.3]),
      (today.add(Duration(days: 1)), [0.2, 0.5, 0.3]),
      (today.add(Duration(days: 2)), [0.1, 0.6, 0.3]),
      (today.add(Duration(days: 3)), [0.4, 0.3, 0.3]),
      (today.add(Duration(days: 4)), [0.25, 0.25, 0.5]),
      (today.add(Duration(days: 5)), [0.15, 0.35, 0.5]),
      (today.add(Duration(days: 6)), [0.6, 0.2, 0.2]),
    ];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final values = statistics ?? _defaultStatistics;

    final weekStart = DateTime.now().roundToFirstDayOfWeek();

    return PNCard(
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: _Layout(
        title: strings.statisticsBy.day,
        content: SizedBox(
          height: progressBarHeight,
          child: Row(
            spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: List.generate(
              values.length,
              (index) => _WeekItem(value: values[index]),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        best: (
          strings.bestPeriod.day,
          PNDateFormatter(
            weekStart.add(Duration(days: bestWeekDayIndex - 1)),
            format: "EEEE",
          ),
        ),
        worst: (
          strings.badPeriod.day,
          PNDateFormatter(
            weekStart.add(Duration(days: worstWeekDayIndex - 1)),
            format: "EEEE",
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Layout extends StatelessWidget {
  final String title;

  final Widget? content;

  final (String, String)? best;
  final (String, String)? worst;

  const _Layout({
    this.title = "",
    this.content = const SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
    this.best = ("", ""),
    this.worst = ("", ""),
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(
          title,
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          height: 22 / 16,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
        if (content != null) content!,
        if (best != null) SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
        if (best != null)
          PNText(
            best!.$1,
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),
        if (best != null)
          PNText(
            best!.$2,
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            color: theme.goodColor,
          ),
        if (worst != null) SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),

        if (worst != null)
          PNText(
            worst!.$1,
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
          ),

        if (worst != null)

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/response.dart';
import '../../../../navigation/path_params/discipline.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class DisciplineSummaryBloc extends Cubit<DisciplineSummaryState> {
  final DisciplineRepository _disciplineRepository;

  DisciplineSummaryBloc(this._disciplineRepository)
    : super(DisciplineSummaryState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh({
    required DisciplineGroupType groupType,
    required DateTime date,
    Future<GetDisciplineResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    emit(DisciplineSummaryState.loading());

    final response =
        await (cacheRequest ??
            _disciplineRepository.getDiscipline(
              date: date,
              groupType: groupType,
            ));

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        if (data.notEnoughData) {
          emit(DisciplineSummaryState.notEnoughData());
          return;
        }

        emit(
          DisciplineSummaryState.loaded(
            completed: data.doneCount,
            total: data.doneCount + data.lateCount + data.skippedCount,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(DisciplineSummaryState.error());
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/drugs/counter/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/drugs/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/drugs/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class DrugsCounterBloc extends Cubit<DrugsCounterState> {
  final PatientDrugsRepository _drugsRepository;

  DrugsCounterBloc(this._drugsRepository) : super(DrugsCounterState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(
    DateTime date, {
    Future<DrugsItemsResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    emit(DrugsCounterState.loading());

    final response = await (cacheRequest ?? _drugsRepository.getDayDrugs(date));

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final events = data.drugs;

        final totalDrugs = events.length;
        final takenDrugs = events.where((e) => e.$1.done).length;

        emit(
          DrugsCounterState.loaded(
            takenDrugs: takenDrugs,
            totalDrugs: totalDrugs,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(DrugsCounterState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> updateCounter(EventModel event, bool newStatus) async {
    if (state is! DrugsCounterStateLoaded) return;

    final data = (state as DrugsCounterStateLoaded);

    emit(
      DrugsCounterState.loaded(
        takenDrugs: data.takenDrugs + (newStatus ? 1 : -1),
        totalDrugs: data.totalDrugs,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _EventsCounter extends StatelessWidget {
  final int takenDrugs;
  final int totalDrugs;

  const _EventsCounter({required this.takenDrugs, required this.totalDrugs});

  Color _totalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (takenDrugs == totalDrugs) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (takenDrugs - totalDrugs <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(44)),
      // height: context.au(44),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          PNText(
            context.t.strings.totalMedicines,

            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
          ),
          AutoSizeText(
            "$takenDrugs/$totalDrugs",

            // textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: PNTextStyle(
              color: _totalEventsColor(context),
              fontSize: context.au(46),
              height: 1,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class DrugsCurrentWeekWidget extends StatelessWidget {

  const DrugsCurrentWeekWidget({super.key, required this.weekAnchor});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final weekStart = weekAnchor.roundToFirstDayOfWeek();
    final weekEnd = weekStart.roundToLastDayOfWeek();

    final locale = LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode;

    return Align(
      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,

        duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),

                "${DateFormat.d(locale).format(weekStart)} - ${DateFormat.MMMMd(locale).format(weekEnd)}",
                key: ValueKey(weekAnchor),
                fontSize: context.au(20),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              );
            }

            return PNText(
              "${DateFormat.MMMMd(locale).format(weekStart)} - ${DateFormat.MMMMd(locale).format(weekEnd)}",
              key: ValueKey(weekAnchor),
              fontSize: context.au(20),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/drugs/items/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/event/data/drug_info/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/drugs/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/drugs/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class DrugsItemsBloc extends Cubit<DrugsItemsState> {
  final PatientDrugsRepository _drugsRepository;

  DrugsItemsBloc(this._drugsRepository) : super(DrugsItemsState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(
    DateTime date, {
    Future<DrugsItemsResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    emit(DrugsItemsState.loading());

    final response = await (cacheRequest ?? _drugsRepository.getDayDrugs(date));

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final drugs = data.drugs;

        emit(DrugsItemsState.loaded(date: date, drugs: drugs));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(DrugsItemsState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> toggleEvent(int id, bool newStatus) async {
    if (state is! DrugsItemsStateLoaded) return;

    final data = (state as DrugsItemsStateLoaded);

    final drugs = List<(EventModel, MedicineInfoModel)>.from(data.drugs);

    final index = drugs.indexWhere((e) => e.$1.id == id);

    if (index == -1) {
      return;
    }

    final event = drugs[index].$1;
    final drug = drugs[index].$2;

    drugs[index] = (
      event.copyWith(
        done: newStatus,
        // TODO: implement
        // canChange: newStatus != EventStatus.done,
      ),
      drug,
    );

    emit(DrugsItemsState.loaded(date: data.date, drugs: drugs));
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatefulWidget {
  final DrugsItemsBloc bloc;

  final String title;
  final DateTime date;
  final List<(EventModel, MedicineInfoModel)> events;

  final void Function(EventModel event, bool newStatus)? onEventStatusChanged;

  const _Loaded({
    required this.bloc,
    required this.title,
    required this.date,
    required this.events,
    this.onEventStatusChanged,
  });

  @override
  State<_Loaded> createState() => _LoadedState();
}

class _LoadedState extends State<_Loaded> {
  late List<(EventModel, MedicineInfoModel)> uncompletedEvents;
  late List<(EventModel, MedicineInfoModel)> completedEvents;

  bool showCompletedEvents = false;
  bool canChangeExpansion = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    canChangeExpansion = widget.date.isSameDay(DateTime.now());

    showCompletedEvents = canChangeExpansion ? false : true;

    uncompletedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => !e.$1.done).toList();

    completedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => e.$1.done).toList();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(
        minHeight: context.au(DrugsItemsWidget.minHeight),
        minWidth: double.infinity,
      ),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            PNText(
              widget.title,
              fontSize: context.au(16),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 16 - 4),
            AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              child: uncompletedEvents.isEmpty && !showCompletedEvents
                  ? RichText(
                      text: TextSpan(
                        children: [
                          TextSpan(
                            text:
                                '${completedEvents.length}/${completedEvents.length} ',
                            style: PNTextStyle(
                              color: context.pNTheme.goodColor,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                              fontSize: 16,
                              height: 21.6 / 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                          TextSpan(
                            text:
                                context.t.strings.completedWithExclamationMark,
                            style: PNTextStyle(
                              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                              fontSize: 16,
                              height: 21.6 / 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                        style: PNTextStyle(
                          color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          fontSize: 16,
                          height: 21.6 / 16,
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : SizedBox(),
            ),

            AnimatedSize(
              duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
                  if (widget.events.isEmpty)
                    SizedBox(
                      height: DrugsItemsWidget.minHeight - 32,
                      child: Center(
                        child: PNText(
                          context.t.strings.noEvents,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                          color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                  ...List.generate(
                    uncompletedEvents.length,
                    (index) => DrugItemWidget(
                      medicine: uncompletedEvents[index].$1,
                      drugInfo: uncompletedEvents[index].$2,
                      onTap: (newStatus) {
                        final event = uncompletedEvents[index];

                        widget.bloc.toggleEvent(event.$1.id, newStatus);
                        widget.onEventStatusChanged?.call(event.$1, newStatus);
                      },
                    ),
                  ),

                  if (showCompletedEvents)
                    ...List.generate(
                      completedEvents.length,
                      (index) => DrugItemWidget(
                        medicine: completedEvents[index].$1,
                        drugInfo: completedEvents[index].$2,
                        onTap: (newStatus) {
                          final event = completedEvents[index];

                          widget.bloc.toggleEvent(event.$1.id, newStatus);
                          widget.onEventStatusChanged?.call(
                            event.$1,
                            newStatus,
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),

            if (completedEvents.isNotEmpty && canChangeExpansion)
              CupertinoButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  showCompletedEvents = !showCompletedEvents;
                  setState(() {});
                },
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
                child: PNText(
                  showCompletedEvents
                      ? context.t.strings.hideTakenMedicines
                      : context.t.strings.showTakenMedicines,
                  fontSize: context.au(16),
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _Loaded oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    uncompletedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => !e.$1.done).toList();
    completedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => e.$1.done).toList();
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/event/loader/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/event/data/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/event/repository.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class EventLoaderBloc extends Cubit<EventLoaderState> {
  final EventRepository _eventRepository;

  EventLoaderBloc(this._eventRepository) : super(EventLoaderState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int eventId, {EventModel? preloadEvent}) async {
    emit(EventLoaderState.loading());

    final response = await _eventRepository.getEvent(eventId: eventId);

    final (event, error) = response.map(
      success: (value) => (value.event, null),
      error: (data) => (null, data.message),
    );

    if (event == null || error != null) {
      emit(EventLoaderState.error());
      return;
    }

    switch (event.eventType) {
      case EventType.drug:
        break;
      case EventType.form:
        final data = event.data?.mapOrNull(
          test: (data) => (data.data, data.result),
        );

        if (data == null) {
          emit(EventLoaderState.error());
          break;
        }

        final (testData, result) = data;

        emit(
          EventLoaderState.form(event: event, data: testData, result: result),
        );
        break;
      case EventType.test:
        final data = event.data?.mapOrNull(
          test: (data) => (data.data, data.result),
        );

        if (data == null) {
          emit(EventLoaderState.error());
          break;
        }

        final (testData, result) = data;

        emit(
          EventLoaderState.test(event: event, data: testData, result: result),
        );
        break;
      case EventType.video:
        emit(EventLoaderState.video(event: event));
        break;
      case EventType.audio:
        emit(EventLoaderState.audio(event: event));
        break;
      case EventType.photo:
        emit(EventLoaderState.photo(event: event));
        break;
      case EventType.file:
        break;
      case EventType.task:
        break;
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart';

import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/ai/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/ai/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/event/photo/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';

part 'state.dart';

class PhotoFormBloc extends Cubit<PhotoFormState> {
  final AIRepository _aiRepository;

  PhotoFormBloc(this._aiRepository) : super(PhotoFormState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int eventId, EventModel event) async {
    emit(PhotoFormState.file(begin: DateTime.now(), event: event));
  }

  Future<void> uploadFile(XFile file, {DateTime? endTime}) async {
    try {
      if (state is! _File) {
        return;
      }

      final data = state as _File;

      final event = data.event;
      final begin = data.begin;
      final end = endTime ?? DateTime.now();

      final extension = file.name.split('.').last.toLowerCase();

      final response = await _aiRepository.getUploadLink(
        event.id,
        extension,
        end.difference(begin),
      );

      final (link, guid) = response.when(
        success: (link, guid) => (link, guid),
        error: (_) => (null, null),
      );

      if (link == null || guid == null) {
        final error = response.when(
          success: (_, _) => '',
          error: (error) => error,
        );

        PNSnack.show(text: error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return;
      }

      final renamedFile = XFile.fromData(
        await file.readAsBytes(),
        name: "$guid.$extension",
      );

      final _ = await _uploadImageBytes(await renamedFile.readAsBytes(), link);

      final toggleResponse = await _aiRepository.toggleAITask(guid);

      final error = toggleResponse.mapOrNull(error: (data) => data.message);

      if (error != null) {
        PNSnack.show(text: error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return;
      }

      emit(
        PhotoFormState.result(
          total: end.difference(begin),
          date: DateTime.now(),
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.serverError, type: PNSnackType.error);
    }
  }

  Future<bool> _uploadImageBytes(Uint8List imageBytes, String url) async {
    final response = await http.put(
      Uri.parse(url),
      body: imageBytes,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'image/png', // or the correct mime type
      },
    );
    return response.statusCode == 200;
  }
}

class _File extends HookWidget {
  final EventModel event;

  final Future<void> Function(XFile file, {DateTime? endTime})? uploadFile;

  const _File({required this.event, this.uploadFile});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final endTime = useState<DateTime?>(null);
    final file = useState<XFile?>(null);
    final isLoading = useState<bool>(false);

    return ScrollLayoutWithBottomButton(
      content: Column(
        children: [
          _FilePicker(
            event: event,
            onFilePickBegin: () {
              endTime.value = DateTime.now();
            },
            onFilePicked: (newFile) {
              file.value = newFile;
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      buttonText: strings.sendResult,
      isButtonDisable: file.value == null,
      isButtonLoading: isLoading.value,
      onButtonPressed: () async {
        if (file.value == null) {
          return;
        }

        isLoading.value = true;

        await uploadFile?.call(file.value!, endTime: endTime.value);

        isLoading.value = false;
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/event/photo/ui/widgets/file_picker.dart ===
part of '../widget.dart';

class _FilePicker extends HookWidget {
  final EventModel event;

  final VoidCallback? onFilePickBegin;
  final void Function(XFile file)? onFilePicked;

  const _FilePicker({
    required this.event,
    this.onFilePickBegin,
    this.onFilePicked,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = Translations.of(context);

    final isLoading = useState<bool>(false);
    final previewBytes = useState<Uint8List?>(null);
    final hasFile = useState<bool>(false);

    final pickImageFile = useCallback(() async {
      if (isLoading.value) return null;
      isLoading.value = true;

      try {
        final ImagePicker picker = ImagePicker();
        final XFile? image = await picker.pickImage(
          source: ImageSource.gallery,
        );

        if (image == null) return null;

        final convertedFile = await MediaConvertor.convertToPngFile(image);

        if (convertedFile == null) {
          isLoading.value = false;
          return null;
        }

        final bytes = await convertedFile.readAsBytes();
        previewBytes.value = bytes;
        hasFile.value = true;

        return image;
      } catch (e) {
        // TODO: handel error
      } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
      }
    }, [isLoading, previewBytes, hasFile]);

    final pickVideoFile = useCallback(() async {
      if (isLoading.value) return null;
      isLoading.value = true;

      try {
        final ImagePicker picker = ImagePicker();
        final XFile? video = await picker.pickVideo(
          source: ImageSource.gallery,
        );

        if (video == null) return null;

        final bytes = await video.readAsBytes();
        previewBytes.value = bytes;
        hasFile.value = true;

        return video;
      } catch (e) {
        // TODO: handel error
      } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
      }
    }, [isLoading, previewBytes, hasFile]);

    final pickAudioFile = useCallback(() async {
      if (isLoading.value) return null;
      isLoading.value = true;

      try {
        final FilePickerResult? result = await FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(
          type: FileType.audio,
        );

        if (result == null || result.files.isEmpty) return null;

        final file = result.files.first;
        final xFile = XFile(file.path!);

        // For audio, no preview bytes
        previewBytes.value = null;
        hasFile.value = true;

        return xFile;
      } catch (e) {
        // TODO: handel error
      } finally {
        isLoading.value = false;
      }
    }, [isLoading, previewBytes, hasFile]);

    final pickFile = switch (event.eventType) {
      EventType.photo => pickImageFile,
      EventType.video => pickVideoFile,
      EventType.audio => pickAudioFile,
      _ => () {
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.serverError);
      },
    };

    final displayText = hasFile.value
        ? switch (event.eventType) {
            EventType.photo => t.strings.photoSelected,
            EventType.video => t.strings.videoSelected,
            EventType.audio => t.strings.audioSelected,
            _ => t.strings.fileSelected,
          }
        : switch (event.eventType) {
            EventType.photo => t.strings.pickPhoto,
            EventType.video => t.strings.pickVideo,
            EventType.audio => t.strings.pickAudio,
            _ => t.strings.pickFile,
          };

    return CupertinoButton(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      onPressed: () async {
        onFilePickBegin?.call();
        final file = await pickFile();

        if (file == null) {
          return;
        }

        onFilePicked?.call(file);
      },
      child: PNCard(
        padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        child: AspectRatio(
          aspectRatio: 1,
          child: isLoading.value
              ? const CupertinoActivityIndicator()
              : previewBytes.value != null
              ? Image.memory(previewBytes.value!, fit: BoxFit.cover)
              : Center(child: PNText(displayText)),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../../../core/models/event/data/test_info/answer.dart';
import '../../../../../../../core/models/event/data/test_info/result.dart';
import '../../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/response.dart';

part '../../../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/event/test/result/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class EventTestResultBloc extends Cubit<EventTestResultState> {
  final PatientEventsRepository _eventsRepository;

  EventTestResultBloc(this._eventsRepository)
    : super(EventTestResultState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh({
    required int eventId,
    required List<EventQuestionAnswerModel> answers,
  }) async {
    final response = await _eventsRepository.toggleTestEvent(
      eventId,
      answers: answers,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          EventTestResultState.loaded(
            score: data.score,
            maxScore: data.maxScore,
            result: data.result,
            date: DateTime.now(),
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(EventTestResultState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> setResult(EventTestResultModel result) async {
    emit(
      EventTestResultState.loaded(
        score: result.score,
        maxScore: result.maxScore,
        date: result.date,
        result: result.result,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {

  final int? maxScore;
  final String? result;
  final DateTime? date;
  final VoidCallback? onComplete;

  const _Loaded({
    this.score,
    this.maxScore,
    this.result,
    this.date,
    this.onComplete,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final showScore =
        score != 0 && maxScore != 0 && score != null && maxScore != null;

    return ScrollLayoutWithBottomButton(
      content: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
        children: [
          PNText(
            context.t.strings.results.toUpperCase(),
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            height: 22 / 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
            color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
          ),
          if (showScore) _Item(header: strings.score, text: "$score/$maxScore"),
          if (result != null) _Item(header: strings.mark, text: result!),
          if (date != null)
            _Item(
              header: strings.date,
              text: PNDateFormatter(date!, format: "dd MMMM yyy"),
            ),
        ],
      ),
      onButtonPressed: onComplete,
      buttonText: strings.complete,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class _NestedQuestion extends StatelessWidget {
  final EventQuestionDataModel question;
  final ValueChanged<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>> onAnswers;
  final int? baseIndex;
  final int? subIndex;

  const _NestedQuestion({
    required this.question,
    required this.onAnswers,
    this.baseIndex,
    this.subIndex,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return _InlineQuestion(
      question: question,
      onAnswers: onAnswers,
      baseIndex: baseIndex,
      subIndex: subIndex,
    );
  }
}

class _InlineQuestion extends HookWidget {
  final EventQuestionDataModel question;
  final ValueChanged<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>> onAnswers;
  final int? baseIndex;
  final int? subIndex;

  const _InlineQuestion({
    required this.question,
    required this.onAnswers,
    this.baseIndex,
    this.subIndex,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final answer = useState<EventQuestionAnswerModel?>(null);
    final nestedAnswers = useState<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>([]);

    void emit() {
      final list = <EventQuestionAnswerModel>[];
      if (answer.value != null) list.add(answer.value!);
      if (nestedAnswers.value.isNotEmpty) list.addAll(nestedAnswers.value);
      onAnswers(list);
    }

    final prefix = (baseIndex != null && subIndex != null)
        ? '${baseIndex!}.${subIndex!} '
        : '';

    return question.map(
      text: (data) => _Text(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        insideHint: data.insideHint,
        onChange: (value) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.text(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
          );
          emit();
        },
      ),
      number: (data) => _Number(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        insideHint: data.insideHint,
        onChange: (value) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.number(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
          );
          emit();
        },
      ),
      time: (data) => _Time(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        insideHint: data.insideHint,
        value: null,
        onChange: (value) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.time(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
          );
          emit();
        },
      ),
      date: (data) => _Date(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        insideHint: data.insideHint,
        value: null,
        onChange: (value) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.date(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
          );
          emit();
        },
      ),
      dateTime: (data) => _DateTime(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        insideHint: data.insideHint,
        value: null,
        onChange: (value) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.dateTime(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
          );
          emit();
        },
      ),
      file: (data) => _File(),
      select: (data) => _Select(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        options: data.options,
        onChanged: (values) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.select(
            questionId: question.id,
            values: values,
          );
          emit();
        },
        onNestedAnswersChanged: (ans) {
          nestedAnswers.value = ans;
          emit();
        },
      ),
      radio: (data) => _Radio(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        options: data.options,
        onChange: (value) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.radio(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
          );
          emit();
        },
        onNestedAnswersChanged: (ans) {
          nestedAnswers.value = ans;
          emit();
        },
      ),
      radioOrText: (data) => _RadioOrText(
        text: prefix.isEmpty ? data.text : '$prefix${data.text}',
        options: data.options,
        insideHint: data.insideHint,
        onChange: (value, textValue) {
          answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.radioOrText(
            questionId: question.id,
            value: value,
            textValue: textValue,
          );
          emit();
        },
        onNestedAnswersChanged: (ans) {
          nestedAnswers.value = ans;
          emit();
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

class EventQuestionWidget extends HookWidget {
  final bool isLastPage;
  final VoidCallback? onPrevStep;
  final void Function(List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>)? onNextStep;

  final int questionIndex;
  final EventQuestionDataModel question;

  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;

  const EventQuestionWidget({
    super.key,
    this.isLastPage = false,
    this.onPrevStep,
    this.onNextStep,
    required this.questionIndex,
    required this.question,
    required this.contentPadding,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    final stages = [question];

    final answer = useState<EventQuestionAnswerModel?>(null);
    final nestedAnswers = useState<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>([]);

    return Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsets.only(
        left: contentPadding.left,
        right: contentPadding.right,
      ),
      child: CustomScrollView(
        shrinkWrap: true,
        primary: false,
        slivers: [
          SliverToBoxAdapter(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                SizedBox(height: contentPadding.top),
                ...List.generate(
                  stages.length,
                  (index) => stages[index].map(
                    text: (data) => _Text(
                      text: data.text,
                      insideHint: data.insideHint,
                      onChange: (value) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.text(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    number: (data) => _Number(
                      text: data.text,
                      insideHint: data.insideHint,
                      onChange: (value) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.number(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    time: (data) => _Time(
                      text: data.text,
                      insideHint: data.insideHint,
                      value: answer.value?.mapOrNull(
                        time: (value) => value.value,
                      ),
                      onChange: (value) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.time(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    date: (data) => _Date(
                      text: data.text,
                      insideHint: data.insideHint,
                      value: answer.value?.mapOrNull(
                        date: (value) => value.value,
                      ),
                      onChange: (value) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.date(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    dateTime: (data) => _DateTime(
                      text: data.text,
                      insideHint: data.insideHint,
                      value: answer.value?.mapOrNull(
                        dateTime: (value) => value.value,
                      ),
                      onChange: (value) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.dateTime(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                    file: (data) => _File(),
                    select: (data) => _Select(
                      text: data.text,
                      options: data.options,
                      baseIndex: questionIndex + 1,
                      onChanged: (values) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.select(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          values: values,
                        );
                      },
                      onNestedAnswersChanged: (ans) {
                        nestedAnswers.value = ans;
                      },
                    ),
                    radio: (data) => _Radio(
                      text: data.text,
                      options: data.options,
                      baseIndex: questionIndex + 1,
                      onChange: (value) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.radio(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                        );
                      },
                      onNestedAnswersChanged: (ans) {
                        nestedAnswers.value = ans;
                      },
                    ),

                    radioOrText: (data) => _RadioOrText(
                      text: data.text,
                      options: data.options,
                      insideHint: data.insideHint,
                      baseIndex: questionIndex + 1,
                      onChange: (value, textValue) {
                        answer.value = EventQuestionAnswerModel.radioOrText(
                          questionId: stages[index].id,
                          value: value,
                          textValue: textValue,
                        );
                      },
                      onNestedAnswersChanged: (ans) {
                        nestedAnswers.value = ans;
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          SliverFillRemaining(
            hasScrollBody: false,
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
                if (onPrevStep != null)
                  PNOutlineButton(
                    title: strings.previousStep,
                    onPressed: onPrevStep,
                  ),
                if (onPrevStep != null)
                  SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
                PNButton(
                  title: isLastPage ? strings.sendResult : strings.goNext,

                  isDisabled: answer.value == null,
                  onPressed: () {
                    if (answer.value != null) {
                      final aggregated = <EventQuestionAnswerModel>[
                        answer.value!,
                      ];
                      if (nestedAnswers.value.isNotEmpty) {
                        aggregated.addAll(nestedAnswers.value);
                      }
                      onNextStep?.call(aggregated);
                    }
                  },
                ),
                SizedBox(height: contentPadding.bottom),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/event/test/stage/widgets/radio.dart ===

class _Radio extends HookWidget {
  final String text;
  final List<(int id, String text, List<EventQuestionDataModel> nested)>
  options;
  final ValueChanged<int>? onChange;
  final ValueChanged<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>? onNestedAnswersChanged;
  final int? baseIndex;

  const _Radio({
    required this.text,
    required this.options,
    this.onChange,
    this.onNestedAnswersChanged,
    this.baseIndex,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final selectedOption = useState<int?>(null);
    final nestedAnswers = useState<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>([]);
    final selectedNestedQuestions = useState<List<EventQuestionDataModel>>([]);

    return Column(
      spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(text, fontSize: context.au(16), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
        ...List.generate(options.length, (index) {
          final (optionId, optionText, nested) = options[index];
          return PNRadioTextButton(
            isSelected: selectedOption.value == optionId,
            onChanged: (value) {
              if (selectedOption.value == optionId) {
                selectedOption.value = null;
                selectedNestedQuestions.value = [];
                nestedAnswers.value = [];
                onNestedAnswersChanged?.call(nestedAnswers.value);
                return;
              }

              selectedOption.value = optionId;
              selectedNestedQuestions.value = nested;
              onChange?.call(optionId);
            },
            text: optionText,
          );
        }),
        ...selectedNestedQuestions.value.asMap().entries.map(
          (entry) => _NestedQuestion(
            question: entry.value,
            baseIndex: baseIndex,
            subIndex: entry.key + 1,
            onAnswers: (ans) {
              nestedAnswers.value = ans;
              onNestedAnswersChanged?.call(nestedAnswers.value);
            },
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _RadioOrText extends HookWidget {
  final String text;
  final List<(int id, String text, List<EventQuestionDataModel> nested)>
  options;
  final String? insideHint;

  final void Function(int? optionValue, String? textValue)? onChange;
  final ValueChanged<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>? onNestedAnswersChanged;
  final int? baseIndex;

  const _RadioOrText({
    required this.text,
    required this.options,
    this.insideHint,
    this.onChange,
    this.onNestedAnswersChanged,
    this.baseIndex,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final selectedOption = useState<int?>(null);
    final textController = useTextEditingController();

    useEffect(() {
      void onTextChanged() {
        onChange?.call(selectedOption.value, textController.text);
      }

      textController.addListener(onTextChanged);
      return () => textController.removeListener(onTextChanged);
    }, [textController]);

    return Column(
      spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
      children: [
        _Radio(
          text: text,
          options: options,
          baseIndex: baseIndex,
          onChange: (value) => onChange?.call(value, null),
          onNestedAnswersChanged: onNestedAnswersChanged,
        ),
        PNTextField(
          insideHint: insideHint,
          onChange: (value) => onChange?.call(null, value),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

part of '../widget.dart';

class _Select extends HookWidget {
  final String text;
  final List<(int id, String text, List<EventQuestionDataModel> nested)>
  options;

  final ValueChanged<List<int>>? onChanged;
  final ValueChanged<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>? onNestedAnswersChanged;
  final int? baseIndex;

  const _Select({
    required this.text,
    required this.options,
    this.onChanged,
    this.onNestedAnswersChanged,
    this.baseIndex,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final selectedOptions = useState<List<int>>([]);
    final nestedAnswersByOption =
        useState<Map<int, List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>>({});
    final selectedNestedQuestions =
        useState<Map<int, List<EventQuestionDataModel>>>({});

    return Column(
      spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(text, fontSize: context.au(16), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
        ...List.generate(options.length, (index) {
          final (optionId, optionText, nested) = options[index];
          final isSelected = selectedOptions.value.contains(optionId);
          return PNRadioTextButton(
            isSelected: isSelected,
            onChanged: (value) {
              final tempOptions = List<int>.from(selectedOptions.value);

              if (tempOptions.contains(optionId)) {
                tempOptions.remove(optionId);
                selectedOptions.value = tempOptions;
                selectedNestedQuestions.value.remove(optionId);
                nestedAnswersByOption.value.remove(optionId);
                onNestedAnswersChanged?.call(
                  nestedAnswersByOption.value.values.expand((e) => e).toList(),
                );
                return;
              }

              tempOptions.add(optionId);
              selectedOptions.value = tempOptions;
              selectedNestedQuestions.value = {
                ...selectedNestedQuestions.value,
                optionId: nested,
              };

              onChanged?.call(selectedOptions.value);
            },
            text: optionText,
          );
        }),
        ...selectedNestedQuestions.value.entries.expand(
          (entry) => entry.value.asMap().entries.map(
            (sub) => _NestedQuestion(
              question: sub.value,
              baseIndex: baseIndex,
              subIndex: sub.key + 1,
              onAnswers: (ans) {
                nestedAnswersByOption.value = {
                  ...nestedAnswersByOption.value,
                  entry.key: ans,
                };
                onNestedAnswersChanged?.call(
                  nestedAnswersByOption.value.values.expand((e) => e).toList(),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

part 'state.dart';
part '../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/event_add/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';

class EventAddFromCatalogBloc extends Cubit<EventAddFromCatalogState> {
  final EventRepository _eventRepository;

  EventAddFromCatalogBloc(this._eventRepository)
    : super(EventAddFromCatalogState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    emit(EventAddFromCatalogState.loading());
    final response = await _eventRepository.getEventBaseList();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          EventAddFromCatalogState.loaded(eventBaseList: data.eventBaseList),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(EventAddFromCatalogState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> addEvent({
    required EventBaseModel eventBase,
    required DateTime beginDate,
    required DateTime endDate,
    required EventOftenModel often,
    required List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays,
  }) async {
    final response = await _eventRepository.addEventByBaseEvent(
      eventBase: eventBase,
      beginDate: beginDate,
      endDate: endDate,
      often: often,
      timeOfDays: timeOfDays,
    );

    return response.map(
      success: (data) {
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:collection/collection.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';

import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/event/often.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/eventbase/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/widgets/event_duration_picker/widget.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/widgets/event_info/widget.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/widgets/layout/bottom_button.dart';
import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';

class EventAddFromCatalogEventBasePreview extends HookWidget {
  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;
  final EventBaseModel eventBase;

  final VoidCallback? onBack;
  final VoidCallback? onClose;
  final Future<bool> Function({
    required EventBaseModel eventBase,
    required DateTime beginDate,
    required DateTime endDate,
    required EventOftenModel often,
    required List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays,
  })?
  addEvent;

  const EventAddFromCatalogEventBasePreview({
    super.key,
    this.contentPadding = AppUISettings.padding,
    required this.eventBase,
    this.onBack,
    this.onClose,
    this.addEvent,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final begin = useState(DateTime.now().roundToDayStart());
    final end = useState(
      DateTime.now().roundToDayStart().add(Duration(days: 1)),
    );
    final often = useState(EventOftenModel.day());
    final timeOfDayList = useState([DateTime.now().getTimeOfDayOnly()]);

    final eventAdding = useState(false);

    return ScrollLayoutWithBottomButton(
      contentPadding: contentPadding,
      content: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
        children: [
          EventInfoWidget.fromEventBase(
            eventBase,
            padding: AppUISettings.zeroPadding,
          ),
          // TODO: fix timeOfDayList scroll padding
          EventDurationPickerWidget(
            padding: AppUISettings.zeroPadding,
            beginDate: begin.value,
            onBeginChange: (value) => begin.value = value,
            endDate: end.value,
            onEndChange: (value) => end.value = value,
            often: often.value,
            onOftenChange: (value) => often.value = value,
            timeOfDayList: timeOfDayList.value,
            onTimeOfDayChange: (value) {
              timeOfDayList.value = value.sorted();
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      buttonText: strings.addEvent,
      isButtonLoading: eventAdding.value,
      onButtonPressed: () async {
        eventAdding.value = true;

        final addingResult = await addEvent?.call(
          eventBase: eventBase,
          beginDate: begin.value,
          endDate: end.value,
          often: often.value,
          timeOfDays: timeOfDayList.value,
        );

        eventAdding.value = false;

        if (addingResult == true) {
          onClose?.call();
        }
      },
    );
  }
}
