import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/drug_info/dosage.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/drug_info/form.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/drug_info/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/often.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/event/repository.dart';

import '../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../modules/duration/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../modules/main_info/bloc/bloc.dart';

part '../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/event_create/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class CreateEventBloc extends Cubit<CreateEventState> {
  final EventRepository _eventRespoitory;

  final CreateEventMainInfoBloc _mainInfoBloc;
  final CreateEventDurationBloc _durationBloc;

  CreateEventBloc(this._eventRespoitory, this._mainInfoBloc, this._durationBloc)
    : super(CreateEventState());

  Future<bool> add() async {
    final name = state.name;
    final eventType = state.eventType;
    final description = state.description;
    final beginDate = state.beginDate;
    final endDate = state.endDate;
    final often = state.often;
    final timeOfDays = state.timeOfDays;
    final drugInfo = state.drugInfo;

    final validate = await Future.wait([
      _mainInfoBloc.validate(name, eventType, description),
      _durationBloc.validate(
        beginDate: beginDate,
        endDate: endDate,
        timeOfDays: timeOfDays,
        often: often,
      ),
    ]);

    if (validate.any((e) => e == false) || !state.canCreateEvent) {
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _eventRespoitory.addEvent(
      name: name!,
      description: description,
      eventType: eventType,
      beginDate: beginDate!,
      endDate: endDate!,
      often: often!,
      timeOfDays: timeOfDays,
      drugInfo: drugInfo,
    );

    return response.when(
      success: () {
        return true;
      },
      error: (message) {
        PNSnack.show(text: message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    emit(
      CreateEventState(
        drugInfo: MedicineInfoModel(
          form: DrugForm.capsule,
          dosage: 0,
          dosageType: DrugDosageType.mg,
        ),
      ),
    );
    _mainInfoBloc.clear();
    _durationBloc.clear();
  }

  void setName(String name) {
    emit(state.copyWith(name: name));
  }

  void setEventType(EventType eventType) {
    emit(state.copyWith(eventType: eventType));
  }

  void setDescription(String description) {
    emit(state.copyWith(description: description));
  }

  void setDrugInfo(MedicineInfoModel drugInfo) {
    emit(state.copyWith(drugInfo: drugInfo));
  }

  void setBeginDate(DateTime beginDate) {
    emit(state.copyWith(beginDate: beginDate));
  }

  void setEndDate(DateTime endDate) {
    emit(state.copyWith(endDate: endDate));
  }

  void setOften(EventOftenModel often) {
    emit(state.copyWith(often: often));
  }

  void setTimeOfDays(List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays) {
    emit(state.copyWith(timeOfDays: timeOfDays));
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/event_create/bloc/state.dart ===
part of 'bloc.dart';

@freezed
abstract class CreateEventState with _$CreateEventState {
  const CreateEventState._();

  const factory CreateEventState({
    String? name,
    @Default(EventType.drug) EventType eventType,
    String? description,
    DateTime? beginDate,
    DateTime? endDate,
    @Default(EventOftenModel.day()) EventOftenModel? often,
    @Default(<TimeOfDay>[]) List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays,
    MedicineInfoModel? drugInfo,
  }) = _CreateEventState;

  bool get canCreateEvent {
    if (name == null || beginDate == null || endDate == null) {
      return false;
    }

    if (timeOfDays.isEmpty) {
      return false;
    }

    if (eventType == EventType.drug) {
      return drugInfo != null;
    }

    return true;
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/event_create/modules/duration/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../../core/models/event/often.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class CreateEventDurationBloc extends Cubit<CreateEventDurationState> {
  CreateEventDurationBloc() : super(CreateEventDurationState.loaded());

  Future<bool> validate({
    DateTime? beginDate,
    DateTime? endDate,
    List<TimeOfDay>? timeOfDays,
    EventOftenModel? often,
  }) async {
    emit(CreateEventDurationState.loading());

    final beginDateError = beginDate == null ? t.strings.fillField : null;
    final endDateError = endDate == null ? t.strings.fillField : null;
    final timeOfDayError = timeOfDays == null || timeOfDays.isEmpty
        ? t.strings.fillField
        : null;
    final oftenError = often == null ? t.strings.fillField : null;

    if (beginDateError != null ||
        endDateError != null ||
        timeOfDayError != null ||
        oftenError != null) {
      emit(
        CreateEventDurationState.error(
          beginDateError: beginDateError,
          endDateError: endDateError,
          timeOfDayError: timeOfDayError,
          oftenError: oftenError,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }

    if (often!.maybeMap(
      orElse: () => false,
      xDays: (xDays) => xDays.days == null || xDays.days! < 1,
      weekDays: (weekDays) => weekDays.days.isEmpty,
    )) {
      emit(CreateEventDurationState.error(oftenError: oftenError));
      return false;
    }

    emit(CreateEventDurationState.loaded());
    return true;
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    emit(CreateEventDurationState.loaded());
  }
}

class _HowOftenPicker extends StatefulWidget {
  final String? errorText;
  final void Function(EventOftenModel model) onChanged;

  const _HowOftenPicker({this.errorText, required this.onChanged});

  @override
  State<_HowOftenPicker> createState() => _HowOftenPickerState();

class _HowOftenPickerState extends State<_HowOftenPicker> {
  EventOftenModel _ofter = EventOftenModel.day();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(
          context.t.strings.howOften,
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        PNDropDown(
          selectedIndex: _ofter.map(
            day: (_) => 0,
            month: (_) => 1,
            xDays: (_) => 2,
            weekDays: (_) => 3,
          ),
          onChanged: (index) {
            _ofter = switch (index) {
              0 => EventOftenModel.day(),
              1 => EventOftenModel.month(),
              2 => EventOftenModel.xDays(),
              3 => EventOftenModel.weekDays(),
              _ => _ofter,
            };
            setState(() {});
            widget.onChanged(_ofter);
          },
          options: [
            context.t.strings.honOftenUnits.day,
            context.t.strings.honOftenUnits.month,
            context.t.strings.honOftenUnits.xDay,
            context.t.strings.honOftenUnits.weekDays,
          ],
        ),
        AnimatedSize(
          duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          child: _ofter.map(
            day: (_) => SizedBox(width: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width),
            month: (_) => SizedBox(width: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width),
            xDays: (_) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
              child: PNTextField(
                insideHint: "x",
                onChange: (value) {
                  _ofter = EventOftenModel.xDays(
                    days: int.tryParse(value) ?? 0,
                  );
                  setState(() {});
                  widget.onChanged(_ofter);
                },
              ),
            ),
            weekDays: (data) => Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
              child: _WeekDayPicker(
                selectedDays: data.days,
                onChanged: (days) {
                  _ofter = EventOftenModel.weekDays(days: days);
                  setState(() {});
                  widget.onChanged(_ofter);
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        AnimatedSize(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
          child: widget.errorText == null
              ? SizedBox(width: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width)
              : Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                  child: Text(
                    widget.errorText!,
                    style: PNTextStyle(
                      fontSize: context.au(14),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      color: context.pNTheme.error,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _WeekDayPicker extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<int> selectedDays;
  final void Function(List<int> days) onChanged;

  const _WeekDayPicker({required this.selectedDays, required this.onChanged});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    DateTime weekStart = DateTime.now().roundToFirstDayOfWeek();

    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
      children: List.generate(7, (index) {
        final date = weekStart.add(Duration(days: index));

        return _DateItem(
          onTap: () {
            final newSelectedDays = List<int>.from(selectedDays);

            if (newSelectedDays.contains(date.weekday)) {
              newSelectedDays.remove(date.weekday);
            } else {
              newSelectedDays.add(date.weekday);
            }

            onChanged(newSelectedDays);
          },
          date: date,
          isSelected: selectedDays.contains(date.weekday),
        );
      }),
    );
  }
}

class _DateItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final DateTime date;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final bool isSelected;

  const _DateItem({
    required this.date,
    required this.onTap,
    this.isSelected = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CupertinoButton(
      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
      onPressed: onTap,
      sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        width: 40,
        height: 44,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: isSelected
              ? context.pNTheme.primaryControl
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            PNText(
              DateFormat.E(
                LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode,
              ).format(date),
              color: isSelected
                  ? context.pNTheme.onPrimaryControl
                  : context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              fontSize: context.au(14),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w300,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _WhenTimesWidget extends StatefulWidget {

  final String? errorText;

  const _WhenTimesWidget({
    required this.padding,

    this.errorText,
  });

  @override
  State<_WhenTimesWidget> createState() => _WhenTimesWidgetState();
}

class _WhenTimesWidgetState extends State<_WhenTimesWidget> {
  List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays = [];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: widget.padding,
          child: PNText(
            context.t.strings.whenTime,
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
            color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
          ),
        ),

        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: widget.padding,
          scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
          primary: false,
          child: Row(
            children: [
              ...timeOfDays.map(
                (e) => Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
                  child: _TimeItem(
                    time: e,
                    onDelete: () {
                      timeOfDays.remove(e);
                      widget.onTimeOfDaysChanged(timeOfDays);
                      setState(() {});
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              _AddButton(
                onTimeAdded: (time) {
                  timeOfDays.add(time);
                  widget.onTimeOfDaysChanged(timeOfDays);
                  setState(() {});
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        AnimatedSize(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
          child: widget.errorText == null
              ? SizedBox(width: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width)
              : Padding(
                  padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 4) + widget.padding,
                  child: Text(
                    widget.errorText!,
                    style: PNTextStyle(
                      fontSize: context.au(14),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                      color: context.pNTheme.error,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/event_create/modules/main_info/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class CreateEventMainInfoBloc extends Cubit<CreateEventMainInfoState> {
  CreateEventMainInfoBloc() : super(CreateEventMainInfoState.loaded());

  Future<bool> validate(
    String? name,
    EventType? eventType,
    String? description,
  ) async {
    emit(CreateEventMainInfoState.loading());

    final nameError = name == null || name.isEmpty ? t.strings.fillField : null;

    final eventTypeError = eventType == null ? t.strings.fillField : null;

    if (nameError != null || eventTypeError != null) {
      emit(
        CreateEventMainInfoState.error(
          nameError: nameError,
          eventTypeError: eventTypeError,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    emit(CreateEventMainInfoState.loaded());
  }
}

class _DataForm extends StatelessWidget {

  final EdgeInsets padding;

  });

      child: switch (type) {

class _DrugInfo extends StatefulWidget {
  final void Function(MedicineInfoModel drugInfo) onDrugInfoChanged;

  const _DrugInfo({required this.onDrugInfoChanged});

  @override
  State<_DrugInfo> createState() => _DrugInfoState();
}

class _DrugInfoState extends State<_DrugInfo> {
  DrugForm drugForm = DrugForm.capsule;
  int dosage = 0;
  DrugDosageType dosageType = DrugDosageType.mg;

  final TextEditingController _dosageController = TextEditingController(
    text: '0',
  );

  void _updateDrugInfo() {
    final drugInfo = MedicineInfoModel(
      form: drugForm,
      dosage: dosage,
      dosageType: dosageType,
    );

    // Call the callback to update the drug info
    widget.onDrugInfoChanged(drugInfo);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        PNDropDown(
          hint: context.t.strings.drugForm,
          isRequired: true,
          onChanged: (index) {
            if (index == null) return;

            final newDrugForm = DrugForm.values.elementAtOrNull(index);

            if (newDrugForm == null) return;

            drugForm = newDrugForm;
            setState(() {});

            _updateDrugInfo();
          },
          selectedIndex: drugForm.index,
          options: [
            context.t.strings.drugForms.capsule,
            context.t.strings.drugForms.tablet,
            context.t.strings.drugForms.liquid,
            context.t.strings.drugForms.local,
            context.t.strings.drugForms.injection,
            context.t.strings.drugForms.other,
          ],
        ),
        SizedBox(height: 8),

        Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: PNTextField(
                hint: context.t.strings.dosage,
                isRequired: true,
                controller: _dosageController,
                onChange: (value) {
                  dosage = int.tryParse(value) ?? dosage;
                  setState(() {});

                  _updateDrugInfo();
                },
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
              ),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: PNDropDown(
                hint: context.t.strings.dosageType,
                isRequired: true,
                selectedIndex: dosageType.index,
                onChanged: (index) {
                  if (index == null) return;

                  final newDosageType = DrugDosageType.values.elementAtOrNull(
                    index,
                  );

                  if (newDosageType == null) return;

                  dosageType = newDosageType;
                  setState(() {});

                  _updateDrugInfo();
                },
                options: [
                  context.t.strings.dosageUnits.mg,
                  context.t.strings.dosageUnits.ml,
                  context.t.strings.dosageUnits.unit,
                  context.t.strings.dosageUnits.other,
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

Widget PNEventScheduleLoadedBuilder(

  final strings = context.t.strings;

  final totalEvents = data.length;
  final completedEvents = data.where((e) => e.done).length;

  final mandatoryEvents = data
      .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory)
      .toList();

  final completedMandatoryEvents = data
      .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory && e.done)
      .length;

  final optionalEvents = data
      .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional)
      .toList();

  final completedOptionalEvents = data
      .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional && e.done)
      .length;

  return RefreshCropScroll(
    onRefresh: () async => onRefresh(),
    margin: margin,
    contentPadding: contentPadding,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
      top: Radius.circular(AppUISettings.paddingValue),
    ),
    children: [
      ScheduleEventsCounter(
        totalEvents: totalEvents,
        completedEvents: completedEvents,
        totalMandatoryEvents: mandatoryEvents.length,
        completedMandatoryEvents: completedMandatoryEvents,
        totalOptionalEvents: optionalEvents.length,
        completedOptionalEvents: completedOptionalEvents,
      ),
      SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
      ScheduleEventsItems(
        title: strings.mandatoryEvents,
        date: date,
        events: mandatoryEvents,
        onEventTap: onEventTap,
      ),
      SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
      ScheduleEventsItems(
        title: strings.optionalEvents,
        date: date,
        events: optionalEvents,
        onEventTap: onEventTap,
      ),
    ],
  );
}

class _EventsCounter extends StatelessWidget {
  final int completedEvents;
  final int totalEvents;
  final int completedMandatoryEvents;
  final int totalMandatoryEvents;
  final int completedOptionalEvents;
  final int totalOptionalEvents;

  const _EventsCounter({
    required this.completedEvents,
    required this.totalEvents,
    required this.completedMandatoryEvents,
    required this.totalMandatoryEvents,
    required this.completedOptionalEvents,
    required this.totalOptionalEvents,
  });

  Color _totalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedEvents == totalEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalEvents - completedEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  Color _mandatoryEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedMandatoryEvents == totalMandatoryEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalMandatoryEvents - completedMandatoryEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  Color _optionalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedOptionalEvents == totalOptionalEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalOptionalEvents - completedOptionalEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final showTotalEvent = totalEvents != 0 || completedEvents != 0;

    final showMandatoryEvent =
        completedMandatoryEvents != 0 || totalMandatoryEvents != 0;

    final showOptionalEvents =
        completedOptionalEvents != 0 || totalOptionalEvents != 0;

    return Container(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(44)),
      // height: context.au(44),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
            child: AutoSizeText(
              showTotalEvent ? "$completedEvents/$totalEvents" : "-/-",
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: PNTextStyle(
                color: showTotalEvent
                    ? _totalEventsColor(context)
                    : context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                fontSize: context.au(46),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Flexible(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: context.au(156)),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: PNText(
                            "${context.t.strings.mandatory}:",

                            fontSize: context.au(14),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        PNText(
                          showMandatoryEvent
                              ? "$completedMandatoryEvents/$totalMandatoryEvents"
                              : "-/-",

                          color: showMandatoryEvent
                              ? _mandatoryEventsColor(context)
                              : null,
                          fontSize: context.au(14),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: PNText(
                            "${context.t.strings.optional}:",

                            fontSize: context.au(14),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        PNText(
                          showOptionalEvents
                              ? "$completedOptionalEvents/$totalOptionalEvents"
                              : "-/-",
                          color: showOptionalEvents
                              ? _optionalEventsColor(context)
                              : null,
                          fontSize: context.au(14),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class ScheduleEventsItems extends HookWidget {
  static double minHeight = 112;

  final String title;
  final DateTime? date;
  final List<EventModel> events;
  final void Function(int eventId, EventModel event)? onEventTap;

  const ScheduleEventsItems({
    super.key,
    this.title = "",
    this.date,
    this.events = const <EventModel>[],
    this.onEventTap,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final uncompletedEvents = useState<List<EventModel>>([]);
    final completedEvents = useState<List<EventModel>>([]);
    final showCompletedEvents = useState<bool>(false);
    final canChangeExpansion = useState<bool>(true);

    useEffect(() {
      canChangeExpansion.value = date?.isSameDay(DateTime.now()) ?? false;
      showCompletedEvents.value = canChangeExpansion.value ? false : true;
      uncompletedEvents.value = events.where((e) => !e.done).toList();
      completedEvents.value = events.where((e) => e.done).toList();
      return null;
    }, []);

    useEffect(() {
      uncompletedEvents.value = events.where((e) => !e.done).toList();
      completedEvents.value = events.where((e) => e.done).toList();
      return null;
    }, [events]);

    return PNCard(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(
        minHeight: context.au(ScheduleEventsItems.minHeight),
        minWidth: double.infinity,
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          PNText(title, fontSize: context.au(16), fontWeight: FontWeight.w600),
          SizedBox(height: 16 - 4),
          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            child:
                events.isNotEmpty &&
                    uncompletedEvents.value.isEmpty &&
                    !showCompletedEvents.value
                ? RichText(
                    text: TextSpan(
                      children: [
                        TextSpan(
                          text:
                              '${completedEvents.value.length}/${completedEvents.value.length} ',
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: context.pNTheme.goodColor,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            fontSize: 16,
                            height: 21.6 / 16,
                          ),
                        ),
                        TextSpan(
                          text: context.t.strings.completedWithExclamationMark,
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                            fontSize: 16,
                            height: 21.6 / 16,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                      style: PNTextStyle(
                        color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                        fontSize: 16,
                        height: 21.6 / 16,
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : SizedBox(),
          ),
          AnimatedSize(
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
                if (events.isEmpty)
                  SizedBox(
                    height: EventsItemsWidget.minHeight - 32,
                    child: Center(
                      child: PNText(
                        context.t.strings.noEvents,
                        fontSize: context.au(14),
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                        color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                _EventsByTime(
                  events: uncompletedEvents.value,
                  onEventTap: onEventTap,
                ),

                if (showCompletedEvents.value)
                  ...List.generate(
                    completedEvents.value.length,
                    (index) => EventCardWidget(
                      event: completedEvents.value[index],
                      onTap: onEventTap == null
                          ? null
                          : (id) => onEventTap?.call(
                              id,
                              completedEvents.value[index],
                            ),
                    ),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          if (completedEvents.value.isNotEmpty && canChangeExpansion.value)
            CupertinoButton(
              onPressed: () {
                showCompletedEvents.value = !showCompletedEvents.value;
              },
              padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
              sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
              child: PNText(
                showCompletedEvents.value
                    ? context.t.strings.hideCompletedEvents
                    : context.t.strings.showCompletedEvents,
                fontSize: context.au(16),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
              ),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _EventsByTime extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<EventModel> events;
  final void Function(int eventId, EventModel event)? onEventTap;

  const _EventsByTime({required this.events, this.onEventTap});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final splitByTime = List.generate(
      24,
      (index) => events
          .where(
            (e) =>
                e.date?.getTimeOfDayOnly().isBetween(
                  TimeOfDay(hour: index, minute: 0),
                  TimeOfDay(hour: index, minute: 59),
                ) ??
                false,
          )
          .toList(),
    );

    final otherTime = events.where((e) => e.date == null).toList();

    return Column(
      children: [
        ...List.generate(splitByTime.length, (index) {
          final items = splitByTime[index];

          if (items.isEmpty) {
            return SizedBox.shrink();
          }

          return Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              PNText(
                "$index:00",
                fontSize: context.au(14),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
              ),
              SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue, child: DashLine()),
              ...List.generate(items.length, (index) {
                final item = items[index];
                return EventCardWidget(
                  event: item,
                  onTap: onEventTap == null
                      ? null
                      : (id) => onEventTap?.call(id, item),
                );
              }),
            ],
          );
        }),
        if (otherTime.isNotEmpty)
          Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              PNText(
                context.t.strings.otherTime,
                fontSize: context.au(14),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
              ),
              SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue, child: DashLine()),
              ...List.generate(otherTime.length, (index) {
                final item = otherTime[index];
                return EventCardWidget(
                  event: item,
                  onTap: onEventTap == null
                      ? null
                      : (id) => onEventTap?.call(id, item),
                );
              }),
            ],
          ),
      ],
      // children: List.generate(events.length, (index) {
      //   final item = events[index];
      //   return EventCardWidget(
      //     event: item,
      //     onTap: onEventTap == null ? null : (id) => onEventTap?.call(id, item),
      //   );
      // }),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/events/counter/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class EventsCounterBloc extends Cubit<EventsCounterState> {
  final PatientEventsRepository _eventsRepository;

  EventsCounterBloc(this._eventsRepository)
    : super(EventsCounterState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(
    DateTime date, {
    Future<EventsItemsResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    emit(EventsCounterState.loading());

    final response =
        await (cacheRequest ?? _eventsRepository.getDayEvents(date));

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final events = data.events;

        final totalEvents = events.length;
        final completedEvents = events.where((e) => e.done).length;

        final mandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory)
            .length;

        final completedMandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory && e.done)
            .length;

        final optionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional)
            .length;

        final completedOptionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional && e.done)
            .length;

        emit(
          EventsCounterState.loaded(
            totalEvents: totalEvents,
            completedEvents: completedEvents,
            totalMandatoryEvents: mandatoryEvents,
            completedMandatoryEvents: completedMandatoryEvents,
            totalOptionalEvents: optionalEvents,
            completedOptionalEvents: completedOptionalEvents,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(EventsCounterState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> updateCounter(EventModel event, bool newStatus) async {
    if (state is! EventsCounterStateLoaded) return;

    final data = (state as EventsCounterStateLoaded);

    final newCompletedEvents =
        data.completedEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => 1,
          false => -1,
        };

    final newCompletedMandatoryEvents =
        data.completedMandatoryEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => event.taskType == TaskType.mandatory ? 1 : 0,
          false => event.taskType == TaskType.mandatory ? -1 : 0,
        };

    final newCompletedOptionalEvents =
        data.completedOptionalEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => event.taskType == TaskType.optional ? 1 : 0,
          false => event.taskType == TaskType.optional ? -1 : 0,
        };

    emit(
      EventsCounterState.loaded(
        totalEvents: data.totalEvents,
        completedEvents: newCompletedEvents,
        totalMandatoryEvents: data.totalMandatoryEvents,
        completedMandatoryEvents: newCompletedMandatoryEvents,
        totalOptionalEvents: data.totalOptionalEvents,
        completedOptionalEvents: newCompletedOptionalEvents,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final bool hideIfNoAllEvents;

  final int completedEvents;
  final int totalEvents;
  final int completedMandatoryEvents;
  final int totalMandatoryEvents;
  final int completedOptionalEvents;
  final int totalOptionalEvents;

  const _Loaded({
    required this.hideIfNoAllEvents,
    required this.completedEvents,
    required this.totalEvents,
    required this.completedMandatoryEvents,
    required this.totalMandatoryEvents,
    required this.completedOptionalEvents,
    required this.totalOptionalEvents,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (totalEvents == 0 && hideIfNoAllEvents) {
      return SizedBox(width: double.infinity);
    }

    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(
        minHeight: context.au(EventsCounterWidget.height),
        minWidth: double.infinity,
      ),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),

        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: _EventsCounter(
          completedEvents: completedEvents,
          totalEvents: totalEvents,
          completedMandatoryEvents: completedMandatoryEvents,
          totalMandatoryEvents: totalMandatoryEvents,
          completedOptionalEvents: completedOptionalEvents,
          totalOptionalEvents: totalOptionalEvents,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _EventsCounter extends StatelessWidget {
  final int completedEvents;
  final int totalEvents;
  final int completedMandatoryEvents;
  final int totalMandatoryEvents;
  final int completedOptionalEvents;
  final int totalOptionalEvents;

  const _EventsCounter({
    required this.completedEvents,
    required this.totalEvents,
    required this.completedMandatoryEvents,
    required this.totalMandatoryEvents,
    required this.completedOptionalEvents,
    required this.totalOptionalEvents,
  });

  Color _totalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedEvents == totalEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalEvents - completedEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  Color _mandatoryEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedMandatoryEvents == totalMandatoryEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalMandatoryEvents - completedMandatoryEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  Color _optionalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedOptionalEvents == totalOptionalEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalOptionalEvents - completedOptionalEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final showMandatoryEvent =
        completedMandatoryEvents != 0 || totalMandatoryEvents != 0;

    final showOptionalEvents =
        completedOptionalEvents != 0 || totalOptionalEvents != 0;

    return Container(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(44)),
      // height: context.au(44),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
            child: AutoSizeText(
              "$completedEvents/$totalEvents",
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: PNTextStyle(
                color: _totalEventsColor(context),
                fontSize: context.au(46),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Flexible(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: context.au(156)),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: PNText(
                            "${context.t.strings.mandatory}:",

                            fontSize: context.au(14),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        PNText(
                          showMandatoryEvent
                              ? "$completedMandatoryEvents/$totalMandatoryEvents"
                              : "-/-",

                          color: showMandatoryEvent
                              ? _mandatoryEventsColor(context)
                              : null,
                          fontSize: context.au(14),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: PNText(
                            "${context.t.strings.optional}:",

                            fontSize: context.au(14),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        PNText(
                          showOptionalEvents
                              ? "$completedOptionalEvents/$totalOptionalEvents"
                              : "-/-",
                          color: showOptionalEvents
                              ? _optionalEventsColor(context)
                              : null,
                          fontSize: context.au(14),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';

class CurrentWeekWidget extends StatelessWidget {
  final DateTime weekAnchor;

  const CurrentWeekWidget({super.key, required this.weekAnchor});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final weekStart = weekAnchor.roundToFirstDayOfWeek();
    final weekEnd = weekStart.roundToLastDayOfWeek();

    final locale = LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode;

    return Align(
      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
      child: AnimatedSwitcher(
        duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
        child: Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            if (weekStart.isSameMonth(weekEnd)) {
              return PNText(
                "${DateFormat.d(locale).format(weekStart)} - ${DateFormat.MMMMd(locale).format(weekEnd)}",
                key: ValueKey(weekAnchor),
                fontSize: context.au(20),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              );
            }

            return PNText(
              "${DateFormat.MMMMd(locale).format(weekStart)} - ${DateFormat.MMMMd(locale).format(weekEnd)}",
              key: ValueKey(weekAnchor),
              fontSize: context.au(20),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/events/items/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/response.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class EventsItemsBloc extends Cubit<EventsItemsState> {
  final PatientEventsRepository _eventsRepository;

  EventsItemsBloc(this._eventsRepository) : super(EventsItemsState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(
    DateTime date, {
    Future<EventsItemsResponse>? cacheRequest,
  }) async {
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    emit(EventsItemsState.loading());

    final response =
        await (cacheRequest ?? _eventsRepository.getDayEvents(date));

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final events = data.events;

        final mandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory)
            .toList();

        final optionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional)
            .toList();

        emit(
          EventsItemsState.loaded(
            date: date,
            mandatoryEvents: mandatoryEvents,
            optionalEvents: optionalEvents,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(EventsItemsState.error());
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> toggleEvent(int id, bool newStatus) async {
    if (state is! EventsItemsStateLoaded) return;

    final data = (state as EventsItemsStateLoaded);

    final mandatoryEvents = data.mandatoryEvents
        .map(
          (e) => e.copyWith(
            done: newStatus,
            // TODO: implement
            // canChange: e.id == id ? newStatus != EventStatus.done : e.canChange,
          ),
        )
        .toList();

    final optionalEvents = data.optionalEvents
        .map(
          (e) => e.copyWith(
            done: newStatus,
            // TODO: implement
            // canChange: e.id == id ? newStatus != EventStatus.done : e.canChange,
          ),
        )
        .toList();

    emit(
      EventsItemsState.loaded(
        date: data.date,
        mandatoryEvents: mandatoryEvents,
        optionalEvents: optionalEvents,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatefulWidget {
  final bool hide;

  final EventsItemsBloc bloc;

  final String title;
  final DateTime date;
  final List<EventModel> events;

  final void Function(EventModel event, bool newStatus)? onEventStatusChanged;

  final void Function(EventModel event)? onEventClose;

  const _Loaded({
    required this.hide,
    required this.bloc,
    required this.title,
    required this.date,
    required this.events,
    this.onEventStatusChanged,
    this.onEventClose,
  });

  @override
  State<_Loaded> createState() => _LoadedState();
}

class _LoadedState extends State<_Loaded> {
  late List<EventModel> uncompletedEvents;
  late List<EventModel> completedEvents;

  bool showCompletedEvents = false;
  bool canChangeExpansion = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    canChangeExpansion = widget.date.isSameDay(DateTime.now());

    showCompletedEvents = canChangeExpansion ? false : true;

    uncompletedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => !e.done).toList();
    completedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => e.done).toList();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (widget.hide) {
      return SizedBox(width: double.infinity);
    }

    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(
        minHeight: context.au(EventsItemsWidget.minHeight),
        minWidth: double.infinity,
      ),
      child: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        ),
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            PNText(
              widget.title,
              fontSize: context.au(16),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 16 - 4),
            AnimatedSwitcher(
              duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              child:
                  widget.events.isNotEmpty &&
                      uncompletedEvents.isEmpty &&
                      !showCompletedEvents
                  ? RichText(
                      text: TextSpan(
                        children: [
                          TextSpan(
                            text:
                                '${completedEvents.length}/${completedEvents.length} ',
                            style: PNTextStyle(
                              color: context.pNTheme.goodColor,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                              fontSize: 16,
                              height: 21.6 / 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                          TextSpan(
                            text:
                                context.t.strings.completedWithExclamationMark,
                            style: PNTextStyle(
                              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                              fontSize: 16,
                              height: 21.6 / 16,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                        style: PNTextStyle(
                          color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                          fontSize: 16,
                          height: 21.6 / 16,
                        ),
                      ),
                    )
                  : SizedBox(),
            ),
            AnimatedSize(
              duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  SizedBox(width: double.infinity),
                  if (widget.events.isEmpty)
                    SizedBox(
                      height: EventsItemsWidget.minHeight - 32,
                      child: Center(
                        child: PNText(
                          context.t.strings.noEvents,
                          fontSize: 14,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                          color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ...List.generate(
                    uncompletedEvents.length,
                    (index) => EventCardWidget(
                      event: uncompletedEvents[index],
                      onTap: (id) {
                        PatientNavigator.openEvent(id).then(
                          (_) => widget.onEventClose?.call(
                            uncompletedEvents[index],
                          ),
                        );
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (showCompletedEvents)
                    ...List.generate(
                      completedEvents.length,
                      (index) => EventCardWidget(
                        event: completedEvents[index],
                        onTap: (id) {
                          // PatientNavigator.openEvent(id);
                          // final event = completedEvents[index];

                          // widget.bloc.toggleEvent(event.id, !event.done);
                          // widget.onEventStatusChanged?.call(event, !event.done);
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            if (completedEvents.isNotEmpty && canChangeExpansion)
              CupertinoButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  showCompletedEvents = !showCompletedEvents;
                  setState(() {});
                },
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
                child: PNText(
                  showCompletedEvents
                      ? context.t.strings.hideCompletedEvents
                      : context.t.strings.showCompletedEvents,
                  fontSize: context.au(16),
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
                ),
              ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(covariant _Loaded oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);

    uncompletedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => !e.done).toList();
    completedEvents = widget.events.where((e) => e.done).toList();
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/events_ebr_list/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../core/models/eventbase_instance/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/eventbase_instance/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/events_ebr_list/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class EventsEbrListBloc extends Cubit<EventsEbrListState> {
  final EventBaseInstanceRepository _baseInstanceRepository;

  EventsEbrListBloc(this._baseInstanceRepository)
    : super(EventsEbrListState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    final response = await _baseInstanceRepository.getEventBaseInstanceList();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final filteredEventsBase = data.data
            .where((e) => e.creatorId == e.consumerId)
            .where((e) => e.end.isAfter(DateTime.now()))
            .toList();
        emit(EventsEbrListState.loaded(eventBaseList: filteredEventsBase));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(EventsEbrListState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> removeEventBasesByIds(List<int> ids) async {
    final response = await _baseInstanceRepository.deleteEventBaseInstance(ids);

    response.mapOrNull(
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(EventsEbrListState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }
}

part of '../widget.dart';

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<int> removedEventBaseIdList;
  final List<EventBaseInstanceModel> eventBaseList;
  final void Function(int eventBaseId)? onRemove;

  const _Loaded({
    this.removedEventBaseIdList = const <int>[],
    required this.eventBaseList,
    this.onRemove,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final filteredEvents = eventBaseList
        .where((e) => !removedEventBaseIdList.contains(e.id))
        .toList();

    if (filteredEvents.isEmpty) {
      return Center(child: PNText(strings.noEventToRemove));
    }

    return Column(
      spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
      children: List.generate(
        filteredEvents.length,
        (index) => _Item(
          model: filteredEvents[index],
          onRemoveTap: () => onRemove?.call(filteredEvents[index].id),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Item extends StatelessWidget {
  final EventBaseInstanceModel model;
  final VoidCallback? onRemoveTap;

  const _Item({required this.model, this.onRemoveTap});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              PNText(
                "${model.eventType.nameWithContext(context)}: ${model.name}",
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              ),
              SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.smallPaddingValue),
              PNText(
                "${PNDateFormatter(model.start, format: "dd MMMM yyyy")} — ${PNDateFormatter(model.end, format: "dd MMMM yyyy")}",
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        CupertinoButton(
          padding: AppUISettings.zeroPadding,
          onPressed: onRemoveTap,
          child: Icon(
            CupertinoIcons.clear,
            size: 24,
            color: context.pNTheme.badColor,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/ui/widgets/switcher/widget.dart';
import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/eventbase_instance/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/widgets/activity_indicator/widget.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/widgets/button/button.dart';
import '../../../../../features/ui/text.dart';
import '../../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../bloc/bloc.dart';

part 'states/loaded.dart';
part 'states/loading.dart';
part 'states/error.dart';

class EventsEbrListWidget extends HookWidget {
  final EventsEbrListBloc bloc;

  const EventsEbrListWidget({super.key, required this.bloc});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final removing = useState<bool>(false);
    final removedEventBaseIdList = useState<List<int>>([]);

    return BlocBuilder<EventsEbrListBloc, EventsEbrListState>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => Column(
        children: [
          PNStateSwitcher(
            child: state.map(
              loading: (data) => _Loading(),
              loaded: (data) => ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 256),
                child: SingleChildScrollView(
                  child: _Loaded(
                    removedEventBaseIdList: removedEventBaseIdList.value,
                    eventBaseList: data.eventBaseList,
                    onRemove: (eventBaseId) {
                      final newValue = List<int>.from(
                        removedEventBaseIdList.value,
                      );
                      newValue.add(eventBaseId);

                      removedEventBaseIdList.value = newValue;
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              error: (data) => _Error(message: data.message),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          PNButton(
            title: strings.saveChanges,
            onPressed: () async {
              removing.value = true;
              await bloc.removeEventBasesByIds(removedEventBaseIdList.value);
              removing.value = false;

              if (context.mounted && context.canPop()) {
                Navigator.of(context).pop(true);
              }
            },
            isLoading: removing.value,
            isDisabled: state.maybeWhen(
              loaded: (eventBaseList) => removedEventBaseIdList.value.isEmpty,
              orElse: () => true,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashLine extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DashLine();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CustomPaint(
      size: Size(1, double.infinity),
      painter: _DashLinePainter(
        color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        axis: Axis.vertical,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _DashLinePainter extends CustomPainter {
  final Color color;
  final Axis axis;

  final dashLength = 2;
  final gap = 2;

  _DashLinePainter({required this.color, required this.axis});

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final paint = Paint()
      ..color = color
      ..strokeWidth = 1
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;

    if (axis == Axis.vertical) {
      drawVerticalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }

    if (axis == Axis.horizontal) {
      drawHorizontalLine(canvas, paint, size);
    }
  }

  void drawVerticalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.height - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(0, i),
        Offset(0, min((i + dashLength), size.height).toDouble()),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  void drawHorizontalLine(Canvas canvas, Paint paint, Size size) {
    for (double i = 1; i < size.width - 1; i += dashLength + gap) {
      canvas.drawLine(
        Offset(i, 0),
        Offset(min((i + dashLength), size.width).toDouble(), 0),
        paint,
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

class _Charge extends StatelessWidget {
  final int chargePercent;

  const _Charge({required this.chargePercent});

  Color get _color {
    final value = chargePercent.clamp(0, 100);

    if (value < 50) {
      return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    }

    if (value < 75) {
      return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    }

    return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AutoSizeText(
      '$chargePercent%',
      style: PNTextStyle(
        fontSize: context.au(46),

        fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        color: _color,
        height: 1,
      ),
      maxLines: 1,
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;

  final double itemVerticalSpacing;
  final EdgeInsets margin;
  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;
  final List<ClientModel> relatives;
  final List<ClientModel> experts;
  final String? clinic;

  const _Loaded({
    this.onRefresh,
    this.itemVerticalSpacing = AppUISettings.paddingValue,
    this.margin = AppUISettings.padding,
    this.contentPadding = AppUISettings.padding,
    this.relatives = const [],
    this.experts = const [],
    this.clinic,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    return RefreshCropScroll(
      onRefresh: onRefresh,
      margin: margin,
      contentPadding: contentPadding,
      children: [
        PNText(
          strings.relative.toUpperCase(),
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: itemVerticalSpacing),
        if (relatives.isEmpty) PNCard.error(strings.notSpecified),
        Column(
          spacing: itemVerticalSpacing,
          children: List.generate(relatives.length, (index) {
            final item = relatives[index];
            return _Item(
              avatarId: item.avatarResourceId,
              name: item.formattedName,
              phoneNumber: item.phone,
            );
          }),
        ),

        SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.largePaddingValue),
        PNText(
          strings.leadingSpecialist.toUpperCase(),
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: itemVerticalSpacing),
        if (experts.isEmpty) PNCard.error(strings.notAssigned),
        Column(
          spacing: itemVerticalSpacing,
          children: List.generate(experts.length, (index) {
            final item = experts[index];
            return _Item(
              avatarId: item.avatarResourceId,
              name: item.formattedName,
              phoneNumber: item.phone,
            );
          }),
        ),

        SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.largePaddingValue),
        PNText(
          strings.leadingClinic.toUpperCase(),
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: itemVerticalSpacing),
        if (clinic == null) PNCard.error(strings.notAssigned),
        if (clinic != null) _Item(name: clinic!),
      ],
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/medical_card/treatment_plan/ui/states/loaded.dart ===
part of '../widget.dart';

class _Loaded extends HookWidget {
  final VoidCallback? onRefresh;

  final double itemVerticalSpacing;
  final EdgeInsets margin;
  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;

  final List<
    (DateTime begin, DateTime end, List<EventBaseInstanceModel> events)
  >
  stages;

  const _Loaded({
    this.onRefresh,
    this.itemVerticalSpacing = AppUISettings.paddingValue,
    this.margin = AppUISettings.padding,
    this.contentPadding = AppUISettings.padding,
    this.stages = const [],
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final now = DateTime.now();

    final initialSelectedStage = useMemoized(() {
      for (int i = 0; i < stages.length; i++) {
        final item = stages[i];
        if (now.isBetween(item.$1, item.$2)) {
          return i;
        }
      }

      if (stages.isEmpty) {
        return null;
      }

      return stages.length - 1;
    }, stages);

    final selectedStage = useState<int?>(initialSelectedStage);

    final items = useMemoized(
      () => stages.map((e) => e.$3.sortedBy((e) => e.eventType.index)).toList(),
      stages,
    );

    return RefreshCropScroll(
      onRefresh: onRefresh,
      margin: margin,
      contentPadding: contentPadding,
      children: [
        if (stages.isEmpty) PNCard.error(strings.notAssigned),
        if (stages.isNotEmpty)
          PNDropDown(
            onChanged: (index) {
              selectedStage.value = index;
            },
            selectedIndex: selectedStage.value,
            options: List.generate(stages.length, (index) {
              final item = stages[index];

              return "${PNDateFormatter(item.$1, format: "dd MMMM${now.isSameYear(item.$1) ? "" : " yyyy"}")}-${PNDateFormatter(item.$2, format: "dd MMMM${now.isSameYear(item.$2) ? "" : " yyyy"}")}";
            }),
          ),
        if (selectedStage.value != null)
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.largePaddingValue),
        if (selectedStage.value != null)
          _Items(
            header: strings.events,
            events: items[selectedStage.value!]
                .where((e) => e.eventType != EventType.drug)
                .toList(),
          ),
        if (selectedStage.value != null)
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.largePaddingValue),
        if (selectedStage.value != null)
          _Items(
            header: strings.medicines,
            events: items[selectedStage.value!]
                .where((e) => e.eventType == EventType.drug)
                .toList(),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

part of '../widget.dart';

class _Items extends StatelessWidget {
  final String header;
  final List<EventBaseInstanceModel> events;

  const _Items({required this.header, this.events = const []});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    // Группируем events по EventOftenModel
    final groupedEvents = <EventOftenModel, List<EventBaseInstanceModel>>{};
    for (final event in events) {
      groupedEvents.putIfAbsent(event.often, () => []).add(event);
    }

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(
          header.toUpperCase(),
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
        if (events.isEmpty) PNCard.error(strings.notAssigned),
        if (events.isNotEmpty)
          PNCard(
            child: Column(
              spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
              children: groupedEvents.entries.map((entry) {
                final often = entry.key;
                final eventsInGroup = entry.value;

                return Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    PNText(
                      _getOftenDisplayName(often, context),
                      fontSize: context.au(14),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                      color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                    ),
                    SizedBox(
                      height: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
                      child: DashLine(),
                    ),
                    Column(
                      children: eventsInGroup.map((item) {
                        return switch (item.eventType) {
                          _ => _EventItem(item: item),
                        };
                      }).toList(),
                    ),
                  ],
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  String _getOftenDisplayName(EventOftenModel often, BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    return often.when(
      day: () => strings.everyday,
      month: () => strings.everymonth,
      xDays: (days) => strings.everyNDays(n: days ?? 1),
      weekDays: (days) => strings.byWeekDays,
    );
  }
}

class _EventItem extends StatelessWidget {
  final EventBaseInstanceModel item;

  const _EventItem({required this.item});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        PNText(
          "${item.eventType.nameWithContext(context)}: ${item.name}",
          fontSize: context.au(14),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/medicines/builders/loaded.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/drug_info/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/widgets/cropscroll/listview.dart';
import 'widgets/items.dart';

// ignore: non_constant_identifier_names
Widget PNMedicinesScheduleLoadedBuilder(
  BuildContext context,

  List<(EventModel, MedicineInfoModel)> data,
  List<int> loadingIds,
  DateTime date,
  DateTime selectedDate, {
  EdgeInsets margin = AppUISettings.zeroPadding,
  EdgeInsets contentPadding = AppUISettings.padding,
  void Function(int eventId, EventModel event)? onMedicinesTap,
  required VoidCallback onRefresh,
}) {
  final strings = context.t.strings;

  final morningMedicines = data.where((medicine) {
    final eventTime = medicine.$1.date;
    if (eventTime == null) return false;
    final hour = eventTime.hour;
    return hour <= 9; // 0:00 - 9:00
  }).toList();

  final dinnerMedicines = data.where((medicine) {
    final eventTime = medicine.$1.date;
    if (eventTime == null) return false;
    final hour = eventTime.hour;
    return hour > 9 && hour <= 12; // 9:01 - 12:00
  }).toList();

  final supperMedicines = data.where((medicine) {
    final eventTime = medicine.$1.date;
    if (eventTime == null) return false;
    final hour = eventTime.hour;
    return hour > 12 && hour < 18; // 12:01 - 18:00
  }).toList();

  final otherTimeMedicines = data.where((medicine) {
    final eventTime = medicine.$1.date;
    if (eventTime == null) return false;
    final hour = eventTime.hour;
    return hour >= 18;
  }).toList();

  return RefreshCropScroll(
    onRefresh: () async => onRefresh(),
    margin: margin,
    contentPadding: contentPadding,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
      top: Radius.circular(AppUISettings.paddingValue),
    ),
    children: [
      ScheduleMedicinesEventsItems(
        title: strings.breakfast,
        titleTime: TimeOfDay(hour: 9, minute: 0),
        date: date,
        medicines: morningMedicines,
        loadingIds: loadingIds,
        onMedicinesTap: onMedicinesTap,
      ),

      SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
      ScheduleMedicinesEventsItems(
        title: strings.dinner,
        titleTime: TimeOfDay(hour: 12, minute: 0),
        date: date,
        medicines: dinnerMedicines,
        loadingIds: loadingIds,
        onMedicinesTap: onMedicinesTap,
      ),

      SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
      ScheduleMedicinesEventsItems(
        title: strings.supper,
        titleTime: TimeOfDay(hour: 18, minute: 0),
        date: date,
        medicines: supperMedicines,
        loadingIds: loadingIds,
        onMedicinesTap: onMedicinesTap,
      ),

      SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
      if (otherTimeMedicines.isNotEmpty)
        ScheduleMedicinesEventsItems(
          title: strings.otherTime,

          date: date,
          medicines: otherTimeMedicines,
          loadingIds: loadingIds,
          onMedicinesTap: onMedicinesTap,
        ),
    ],
  );
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/notifications_list/controller.dart ===
import 'dart:async';

import '../../../../core/repositories/common/notifications/repository.dart';

final class NotificationsMarkController {
  final Set<int> _alreadyMarkedIds = {};
  final Set<int> _markingIds = {};
  final Set<int> _readyToMarkIds = {};
  late final Timer _timer;

  final NotificationsRepository _notificationsRepository;

  NotificationsMarkController(this._notificationsRepository) {
    _timer = Timer.periodic(
      Duration(milliseconds: 1800),
      (_) => _markNotifications(),
    );
  }

  // For debugging
  bool get isTimerActive => _timer.isActive;

  Future<void> addNotificationMark(int id) async {
    if (_alreadyMarkedIds.contains(id)) { 
      return;
    }

    if (_markingIds.contains(id)) {
      return;
    }

    _readyToMarkIds.add(id);
  }

  Future<void> _markNotifications() async {
    final idsToMark = _readyToMarkIds.difference(_alreadyMarkedIds);

    if (idsToMark.isEmpty) {
      return;
    }

    _markingIds.addAll(idsToMark);

    final response = await _notificationsRepository.markAsRead(
      idsToMark.toList(),
    );

    response.map(
      success: (_) {
        _alreadyMarkedIds.addAll(idsToMark);
      },
      error: (error) {},
    );
    _markingIds.clear();
  }

  Future<void> dispose() async {
    _timer.cancel();
    _markNotifications();
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/profile/data/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/client/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/profile/data/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class ProfileDataBloc extends Cubit<ProfileDataState> {
  final ClientRepository _clientRepository;

  ProfileDataBloc(this._clientRepository) : super(ProfileDataState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh({ClientModel? preloadData}) async {
    emit(ProfileDataState.loading());

    final response = await _clientRepository.getClientData();

    if (preloadData != null) {
      emit(ProfileDataState.loaded(data: preloadData));
      return;
    }

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(ProfileDataState.loaded(data: data.data));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(ProfileDataState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final ClientModel model;
  final void Function(ClientModel preloadData)? onEditTap;
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  const _Loaded({
    this.model = const ClientModel(
      id: -1,
      role: ClientRole.patient,
      firstName: '',
      lastName: '',
      email: '',
      cityName: '',
    ),
    this.borderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius,
    this.onEditTap,
  });

  int? _calculateAge(DateTime? birthDate) {
    if (birthDate == null) {
      return null;
    }

    final age = DateTime.now().difference(birthDate).inDays ~/ 365;

    return age;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    final age = _calculateAge(model.birthDate);

    return PNCard(
      constraints: BoxConstraints.tightFor(width: double.infinity),
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          AvatarWidget(
            resourceId: model.avatarResourceId,
            backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
            size: 128,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          PNText(
            [
              model.lastName,
              model.firstName,
              if (model.additionalName != null) model.additionalName,
            ].join(" "),
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          ),
          PNText(
            [
              if (age != null) strings.yearsOld(n: age),
              if (model.cityName != null) model.cityName,
            ].join(", "),
            fontSize: context.au(14),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
          ),
          if (model.phone != null)
            PNText(
              model.phone!,
              fontSize: context.au(14),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
            ),

          PNText(
            model.email,
            fontSize: context.au(14),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
          ),

          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          CupertinoButton(
            onPressed: () => onEditTap?.call(model),
            padding: AppUISettings.zeroPadding,
            sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
            child: PNText(
              strings.editData,
              fontSize: context.au(16),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: theme.primaryControl,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
