=== FILE: apps/patient/features/profile/edit/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/client/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../../../.gen/apps/patient/features/profile/edit/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class ProfileEditBloc extends Cubit<ProfileEditState> {
  final ClientRepository _clientRepository;

  ProfileEditBloc(this._clientRepository) : super(ProfileEditState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh({ClientModel? preloadData}) async {
    emit(ProfileEditState.loading());

    if (preloadData != null) {
      emit(ProfileEditState.loaded(data: preloadData));
      return;
    }

    final response = await _clientRepository.getClientData();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(ProfileEditState.loaded(data: data.data));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(ProfileEditState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> update(ClientModel newModel) async {
    if (state is! _Loaded) {
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _clientRepository.updateClientData(newModel);

    return response.map(
      success: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.dataSuccessfullyUpdate);
        emit(ProfileEditState.loaded(data: newModel));
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/profile/edit/ui/states/loaded.dart ===
part of '../widget.dart';

class _Loaded extends HookWidget {
  final ClientModel data;
  final Future<bool> Function(ClientModel newModel)? update;
  final VoidCallback? onEditEmailTap;
  final ValueChanged<ClientModel>? onProfileEdit;
  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;

  const _Loaded({
    required this.data,
    this.update,
    this.onEditEmailTap,
    this.onProfileEdit,
    this.contentPadding = AppUISettings.padding,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final formKey = useMemoized(() => GlobalKey<FormState>());

    final lastName = useState(data.lastName);
    final firstName = useState(data.firstName);
    final additionalName = useState(data.additionalName);
    final phone = useState(data.phone);
    final email = useState(data.email);

    final wasChanged = useMemoized(
      () =>
          lastName.value != data.lastName ||
          firstName.value != data.firstName ||
          additionalName.value != data.additionalName ||
          phone.value != data.phone ||
          email.value != data.email,
      [
        lastName.value,
        firstName.value,
        additionalName.value,
        phone.value,
        email.value,
      ],
    );

    final isUpdating = useState<bool>(false);

    return ScrollLayoutWithBottomButton(
      contentPadding: contentPadding,
      content: Form(
        key: formKey,
        child: Column(
          spacing: AppUISettings.largePaddingValue,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            _Form(
              header: strings.mainInfo.toUpperCase(),
              items: [
                _FromItem(
                  hint: strings.lastName,
                  initialValue: lastName.value,
                  onChange: (value) => lastName.value = value,
                  placeholder: strings.lastNameHint,
                  formatters: [
                    FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(
                      RegExp(r'[\u0400-\u04FFa-zA-Z\s\-]'),
                    ),
                    LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(50),
                  ],
                  validator: (value) => value == data.lastName
                      ? null
                      : NameValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
                ),
                _FromItem(
                  hint: strings.firstName,
                  initialValue: firstName.value,
                  onChange: (value) => firstName.value = value,
                  placeholder: strings.firstNameHint,
                  formatters: [
                    FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(
                      RegExp(r'[\u0400-\u04FFa-zA-Z\s\-]'),
                    ),
                    LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(50),
                  ],
                  validator: (value) => value == data.firstName
                      ? null
                      : NameValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
                ),
                _FromItem(
                  hint: strings.additionalName,
                  initialValue: additionalName.value,
                  onChange: (value) => additionalName.value = value,
                  placeholder: strings.additionalNameHint,
                  formatters: [
                    FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(
                      RegExp(r'[\u0400-\u04FFa-zA-Z\s\-]'),
                    ),
                    LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(50),
                  ],
                  validator: (value) => value == (data.additionalName ?? "")
                      ? null
                      : NameValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            _Form(
              header: strings.contactInfo.toUpperCase(),
              items: [
                _FromItem(
                  hint: strings.phone,
                  initialValue: phone.value,
                  onChange: (value) => phone.value = value,
                  placeholder: AppSettings.phonePlaceholder,
                  formatters: [
                    FilteringTextInputFormatter.allow(
                      RegExp(r'[\d\+\-\(\)\s]'),
                    ),
                    LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(18),
                  ],
                  validator: (value) => value == (data.phone ?? "")
                      ? null
                      : PhoneValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
                ),
                _FromItem(
                  hint: strings.email,
                  initialValue: email.value,
                  action: (strings.editEmail, onEditEmailTap),
                  onChange: (value) => email.value = value,
                  placeholder: AppSettings.emailPlaceholder,
                  formatters: [],
                  validator: (value) => value == data.email
                      ? null
                      : EmailValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
                  isReadOnly: true,
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
      isButtonLoading: isUpdating.value,
      onButtonPressed: () async {
        final isValid = formKey.currentState?.validate();

        if (isValid != true) {
          return;
        }

        isUpdating.value = true;

        final newModel = data.copyWith(
          lastName: lastName.value,
          firstName: firstName.value,
          additionalName: additionalName.value,
          phone: phone.value,
        );

        final response = await update?.call(newModel);

        if (response == true) {
          onProfileEdit?.call(newModel);
        }

        isUpdating.value = false;
      },
      buttonText: strings.saveChanges,
      isButtonDisable: !wasChanged,
    );
  }
}

final class _FromItem {
  final String? hint;
  final String? initialValue;
  final (String, VoidCallback?)? action;
  final String? placeholder;
  final ValueChanged<String>? onChange;
  final FormFieldValidator<String?>? validator;
  final List<TextInputFormatter> formatters;
  final bool isReadOnly;

  _FromItem({
    this.hint,
    this.initialValue,
    this.action,
    this.placeholder,
    this.onChange,
    this.validator,
    this.formatters = const [],
    this.isReadOnly = false,
  });
}

class _Form extends StatelessWidget {
  final String header;

  final List<_FromItem> items;

  const _Form({required this.header, this.items = const []});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,

      children: [
        PNText(
          header.toUpperCase(),
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
        ),
        ...List.generate(items.length, (index) {
          final item = items[index];

          return Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              PNTextField2(
                hint: item.hint,
                initialValue: item.initialValue,
                placeholder: item.placeholder,
                onChange: item.onChange,
                validator: item.validator,
                formatters: item.formatters,
                isReadOnly: item.isReadOnly,
              ),
              if (item.action != null)
                CupertinoButton(
                  padding: AppUISettings.zeroPadding,
                  onPressed: item.action?.$2,
                  child: PNText(
                    item.action!.$1,
                    fontSize: context.au(16),
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          );
        }),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class ProfileEditEmailEditBloc extends Cubit<ProfileEditEmailEditState> {
  final ChangeEmailRepository _repository;

  ProfileEditEmailEditBloc(this._repository)
    : super(const ProfileEditEmailEditState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    emit(ProfileEditEmailEditState.newPassword());
  }

  Future<void> checkEmail(String newEmail, String password) async {
    // emit(ProfileEditEmailEditState.loading());

    final response = await _repository.checkEmail(
      newEmail: newEmail,
      password: password,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          ProfileEditEmailEditState.code(
            newEmail: newEmail,
            password: password,
          ),
        );
      },

      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.error(text: data.error);
        // emit(ProfileEditEmailEditState.newPassword(error: data.error));
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> updateEmail(
    String newEmail,
    String password,
    String code,
  ) async {
    // emit(ProfileEditEmailEditState.loading());

    final response = await _repository.updateEmail(
      newEmail: newEmail,
      password: password,
      code: code,
    );

      success: (data) {
        // emit(
        //   ProfileEditEmailEditState.code(
        //     newEmail: newEmail,
        //     password: password,
        //   ),

        return true;

        // emit(
        //   ProfileEditEmailEditState.code(
        //     newEmail: newEmail,

        //     error: data.error,

        return false;

class _Code extends StatefulHookWidget {
  final ProfileEditEmailEditBloc bloc;

  final void Function(String email)? onEmailUpdate;

  final String email;
  final String password;
  final String? error;

  const _Code({
    required this.bloc,
    this.onEmailUpdate,
    required this.email,
    required this.password,
    this.error,
  });

  @override
  State<_Code> createState() => _LoadedState();
}

class _LoadedState extends State<_Code> {
  String _pin = "";
  bool _isLoading = false;
  final TextEditingController _codeController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        SizedBox(height: 16),
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
          child: RichText(
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            text: TextSpan(
              style: PNTextStyle(
                color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                fontSize: context.au(16),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              ),
              children: <TextSpan>[
                context.t.strings.codeWasSendToEmail(
                  email: TextSpan(
                    text: widget.email,
                    style: PNTextStyle(
                      color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                      fontSize: context.au(16),
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(height: 16),
        PNPinField(
          autofocus: true,
          onChanged: (value) {
            _pin = value;
            setState(() {});
          },
          controller: _codeController,
        ),
        SizedBox(height: 16),
        PNButton(
          title: t.strings.confirm,
          isDisabled: _pin.length < 4,
          isLoading: _isLoading,
          onPressed: () async {
            if (_pin.length < 4) return;

            setState(() {
              _isLoading = true;
            });

            final isConfirmed = await widget.bloc.updateEmail(
              widget.email,
              widget.password,
              _pin,
            );

            widget.onEmailUpdate?.call(widget.email);

            if (context.mounted) {
              setState(() {
                _isLoading = false;
              });
            }

            if (isConfirmed && context.mounted) {
              Navigator.of(context).maybePop();
            }
          },
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _NewPassword extends StatefulWidget {
  final ProfileEditEmailEditBloc bloc;
  final String? error;

  const _NewPassword({required this.bloc, this.error});

  @override
  State<_NewPassword> createState() => __NewPasswordState();
}

class __NewPasswordState extends State<_NewPassword> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();

  final _newEmailController = TextEditingController();
  final _passwordController = TextEditingController();

  bool _isEmailChecking = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = Translations.of(context);

    return Form(
      key: _formKey,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          PNTextField2(
            hint: context.t.strings.newEmail,
            controller: _newEmailController,
            isRequired: true,
            backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
            autofillHints: [AutofillHints.email],
            keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
            validator: (value) {
              if (!value.isEmail) {
                return t.strings.invalidEmail;
              }

              return null;
            },
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          PNTextField2(
            hint: context.t.strings.password.capitalize(),
            controller: _passwordController,
            isRequired: true,
            isObscure: true,
            autofillHints: [AutofillHints.password],
            keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
            textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
            backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
          ),
          if (widget.error != null) SizedBox(height: 16),
          if (widget.error != null)
            PNText(
              widget.error!,
              fontSize: 16,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              color: context.pNTheme.error,
            ),
          SizedBox(height: 24),
          PNButton(
            title: context.t.strings.confirm,
            isLoading: _isEmailChecking,
            onPressed: () async {
              setState(() {
                _isEmailChecking = true;
              });
              if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
                return;
              }

              await widget.bloc.checkEmail(
                _newEmailController.text,
                _passwordController.text,
              );

              if (context.mounted) {
                setState(() {
                  _isEmailChecking = false;
                });
              }
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

              duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              reverseDuration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
              transitionBuilder: (Widget child, Animation<double> animation) {
                return FadeTransition(opacity: animation, child: child);
              },
              child: state.map(
                loading: (state) => KeyedSubtree(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('loading_email_confirm'),
                  child: _Loading(),
                ),
                newPassword: (value) => KeyedSubtree(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('new_password_email_confirm'),
                  child: _NewPassword(bloc: bloc, error: value.error),
                ),
                code: (value) => KeyedSubtree(
                  key: ValueKey<String>('code_email_confirm_${value.newEmail}'),
                  child: _Code(
                    email: value.newEmail,
                    bloc: bloc,
                    onEmailUpdate: onEmailUpdate,
                    password: value.password,
                    error: value.error,
                  ),
                ),
                error: (state) => KeyedSubtree(
                  key: const ValueKey<String>('error_email_confirm'),
                  child: _Error(),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          SizedBox(height: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom),
          SizedBox(height: MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/profile/password_edit/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/change_password/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

class ProfilePasswordEditBloc {
  final ChangePasswordRepository _changePasswordRepository;

  ProfilePasswordEditBloc(this._changePasswordRepository);

  Future<bool> changePassword(String oldPassword, String newPassword) async {
    final response = await _changePasswordRepository.changePassword(
      oldPassword,
      newPassword,
    );

    return response.map(
      success: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.passwordChanged);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.error(text: data.message);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/features/profile/password_edit/ui/widget.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';

import '../../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/bottomsheet/widgets/base.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/components/text_field/widget.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/validators/validators.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/ui/widgets/button/button.dart';
import '../bloc/bloc.dart';

class ProfilePasswordEditWidget extends HookWidget {
  final ProfilePasswordEditBloc bloc;

  const ProfilePasswordEditWidget({super.key, required this.bloc});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    final formKey = useMemoized(() => GlobalKey<FormState>());

    final passwordChanging = useState<bool>(false);
    final oldPasswordController = useTextEditingController();
    final newPasswordController = useTextEditingController();
    final repeatPasswordController = useTextEditingController();

    final validateRepeatPassword = useCallback<String? Function(String?)>((
      String? value,
    ) {
      if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
        return strings.passwordValidationErrors.empty;
      }
      if (value != newPasswordController.text) {
        return strings.passwordValidationErrors.passwordsDoNotMatch;
      }
      return null;
    }, []);

    final onSavePressed = useCallback(() async {
      if (formKey.currentState?.validate() != true) {
        return;
      }

      passwordChanging.value = true;

      final result = await bloc.changePassword(
        oldPasswordController.text,
        newPasswordController.text,
      );

      passwordChanging.value = false;

      if (result && context.mounted) {
        Navigator.of(context).maybePop();
      }
    }, []);

    return PNBottomSheetBaseCard(
      header: strings.changePassword,
      content: Form(
        key: formKey,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          primary: false,
          child: Column(
            spacing: AppUISettings.paddingValue,
            children: [
              PNTextField2(
                controller: oldPasswordController,
                hint: strings.oldPassword,
                backgroundColor: theme.cardBackground,
                isObscure: true,
                isRequired: true,
                isReadOnly: passwordChanging.value,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
                autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.password],
                validator: (value) =>
                    PasswordValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
              ),

              PNTextField2(
                controller: newPasswordController,
                hint: strings.newPassword,
                backgroundColor: theme.cardBackground,
                isObscure: true,
                isRequired: true,
                isReadOnly: passwordChanging.value,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
                autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.newPassword],
                validator: (value) =>
                    PasswordValidator.validateWithMessage(value, context),
              ),
              PNTextField2(
                controller: repeatPasswordController,
                hint: strings.repeatPassword,
                backgroundColor: theme.cardBackground,
                isObscure: true,
                isRequired: true,
                isReadOnly: passwordChanging.value,
                keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
                autofillHints: const [AutofillHints.newPassword],
                validator: validateRepeatPassword,
              ),
              PNButton(
                title: strings.saveChanges,
                isLoading: passwordChanging.value,
                onPressed: onSavePressed,
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

part of '../widgets.dart';

class _Logout extends ConsumerWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  const _Logout({
    this.borderRadius = const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(12)),
  });

  Future<void> _showLogoutDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    VoidCallback onConfirm,
  ) => Navigator.of(context).push(
    CupertinoModalPopupRoute(
      barrierColor: const Color(0xFF000000).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
      builder: (_) => BackdropFilter(
        filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 3, sigmaY: 3),
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          children: [
            PNConfirmDialog(
              title: context.t.strings.areYouSureLogout,
              onConfirm: onConfirm,
              confirmText: context.t.strings.yes,
              cancelText: context.t.strings.no,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tokenRepository = ref.watch(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    return PNOutlineButton(
      title: context.t.strings.logoutFromAccount,
      onPressed: () => _showLogoutDialog(rootNavigatorKey.currentContext!, () {
        tokenRepository.logout();
        PNSnack.show(text: context.t.strings.successfullyLoggedOut);
        AppNavigator.openAuthorizationPage();
      }),
    );

  }
}

class PatientSettingsAction extends ConsumerWidget {
  const PatientSettingsAction({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tokenRepository = ref.watch(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    final canSwitchApp =
        tokenRepository.currentUserType == UserType.administrator;

    return Column(
      children: [
        if (canSwitchApp)
          _SwitchApp(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(12),
              topRight: Radius.circular(12),
            ),
          ),
        _Logout(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
            topLeft: canSwitchApp ? Radius.zero : Radius.circular(12),
            topRight: canSwitchApp ? Radius.zero : Radius.circular(12),
            bottomLeft: Radius.circular(12),
            bottomRight: Radius.circular(12),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../core/models/eventbase/model.dart';

import '../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'path_params/discipline.dart';
import 'routes_name.dart';

final class PatientNavigator {
  PatientNavigator._();

  static BuildContext get _context => rootNavigatorKey.currentContext!;

  static void openProfile() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.profile);

  static void openHome() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.home);

  static void openNotifications() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.notifications.name);

  static void openMedicalCard() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.medicalCard.name);

  static void openConstants() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.constants.name);

  static void openTreatmentPlan() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.treatmentPlan.name);

  static void openCondition() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.condition);

  static void openEvents() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.events);

  static Future<void> openEvent(int eventId) {
    final referral = GoRouter.maybeOf(_context)?.state.fullPath;
    return _context.pushNamed<void>(
      PatientRoutesName.event.name,
      pathParameters: {PatientPathParamsName.eventId: eventId.toString()},
      queryParameters: {
        if (referral != null) PatientQueryParamsName.referral: referral,
      },
    );
  }

  static void openCreateEvent() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.createEvents.name);

  static Future<void> openAddEvent({
    String? currentStage = "eventType",
    EventType? eventType,
    EventBaseModel? eventBase,
  }) => _context.pushNamed(
    PatientRoutesName.addEvents.name,
    queryParameters: {
      PatientPathParamsName.currentStage: currentStage,
      if (eventType != null) PatientPathParamsName.eventType: eventType.apiName,
    },
    extra: eventBase,
  );

  static void openCreateDrugs() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.createMedicines.name);

  static void openDiscipline({
    DisciplineGroupType groupType = DisciplineGroupType.week,
    DateTime? date,
  }) => _context.goNamed(
    PatientRoutesName.discipline.name,
    pathParameters: {
      PatientPathParamsName.disciplineGroupType: groupType.toString(),
    },
    queryParameters: {
      PatientQueryParamsName.date: PNDateFormatter(date ?? DateTime.now()),
    },
  );

  static void openStimulator() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.stimulator);

  static void openMedicines() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.medicines);

  static void openActivity() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.activity);

  static void openChats() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.chats);

  static void openChat(String chatId) {
    final referral = GoRouter.maybeOf(_context)?.state.fullPath;
    _context.pushNamed(
      PatientRoutesName.chat,
      pathParameters: {PatientPathParamsName.chatId: chatId},
      queryParameters: {
        if (referral != null) PatientQueryParamsName.referral: referral,
      },
    );
  }

  static void openAppointment() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.appointment);

  static void openServices() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.services);

  static void openProfileEdit({ClientModel? preloadData}) =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.profileEdit.name, extra: preloadData);

  static void openSettings() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.settings);

  static void openSecurity() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.security.name);

  static void openAboutApp() => _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.aboutApp);

  static void openAppearance() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.appearance.name);

  static void openNotificationSettings() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.notificationsSettings.name);

  static void openChangelog() =>
      _context.goNamed(PatientRoutesName.changelog.name);
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/navigation/path_params/discipline.dart ===
import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';

enum DisciplineGroupType {
  week,
  month,
  year;

  static DisciplineGroupType? fromString(String? value) => switch (value) {
    "week" => week,
    "month" => month,
    "year" => year,
    _ => null,
  };

  String get name => switch (this) {
    week => t.strings.week,
    month => t.strings.month,
    year => t.strings.year,
  };

  @override
  String toString() => switch (this) {
    week => "week",
    month => "month",
    year => "year",
  };
}

import 'routes/services.dart';
import 'routes_name.dart';
import 'widgets/scaffold.dart';

final patientNavigationKey = GlobalKey<StatefulNavigationShellState>();

GoRoute patientRouter = GoRoute(
  path: PatientRoutesName.base,
  name: PatientRoutesName.base,
  redirect: (context, state) {
    final tokenRepository = ProviderScope.containerOf(
      context,
    ).read<TokenRepository>(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    final pinCodeRepository = ProviderScope.containerOf(
      context,
    ).read<PinCodeRepository>(ProviderRepository.common.pinCode);

    if (!tokenRepository.haveValidToken()) {
      // PNSnack.show(
      //   context: context,
      //   text: context.t.strings.pleasLoginToContinue,
      //   type: PNSnackType.error,
      // );
      return RoutesName.auth;
    }

    if (!tokenRepository.canAccessPatientApp()) {
      // PNSnack.show(
      //   context: context,
      //   text: context.t.strings.enterPatientAccount,
      //   type: PNSnackType.error,
      // );
      return RoutesName.auth;
    }

    if (pinCodeRepository.haveBiometricAuthentication() != true) {
      return RoutesName.pinCodeInput.path;
    }

    if (state.fullPath == PatientRoutesName.base) {
      return "${PatientRoutesName.base}/${PatientRoutesName.home}";
    }

    return null;
  },
  routes: [
    ShellRoute(
      // builder: (context, state, child) {
      //   return PatientNavigationScaffold(state: state, child: child);
      // },
      pageBuilder: (context, state, child) => FadeTransitionPage(
        child: PatientNavigationScaffold(state: state, child: child),
      ),
      routes: [
        homeRoutes,
        medicalCardRoutes,
        chatsRoutes,
        appointmentRoutes,
        servicesRoutes,
        // settingsRoutes,
        profileRoutes,
      ],
    ),
    chatRoutes,
    eventRoutes,
  ],
);

  redirect: (context, state) {
    final chatId = state.pathParameters[PatientPathParamsName.chatId];

    if (chatId == null) {
      return "${PatientRoutesName.base}/${PatientRoutesName.chats}";
    }

    return null;
  },
  pageBuilder: (context, state) {
    final chatId = state.pathParameters[PatientPathParamsName.chatId];
    final referral = state.uri.queryParameters[PatientQueryParamsName.referral];

    if (chatId == null) {
      throw Exception("ChatId wasn't provide");
    }

    return MaterialPage(
      child: ChatPage(chatId: chatId, referral: referral),
    );
  },
);

final homeRoutes = GoRoute(

  name: PatientRoutesName.home,

      FadeTransitionPage(key: state.pageKey, child: HomePage()),
  routes: [
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.notifications.path,
      name: PatientRoutesName.notifications.name,
      builder: (context, state) => NotificationsPage(),
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.condition,
      name: PatientRoutesName.condition,
      builder: (context, state) => ConditionPage(),
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.events,
      name: PatientRoutesName.events,
      builder: (context, state) => EventsPage(),
      routes: [
        GoRoute(
          path: PatientRoutesName.createEvents.path,
          name: PatientRoutesName.createEvents.name,
          pageBuilder: (context, state) =>
              MaterialPage(fullscreenDialog: true, child: CreateEventPage()),
        ),
        GoRoute(
          path: PatientRoutesName.addEvents.path,
          name: PatientRoutesName.addEvents.name,
          builder: (context, state) {
            final currentStageStr =
                state.uri.queryParameters[PatientPathParamsName.currentStage];
            final eventTypeStr =
                state.uri.queryParameters[PatientPathParamsName.eventType];

            return AddEventFromCatalogPage(
              currentStageValue: currentStageStr,
              selectedTypeValue: eventTypeStr == null
                  ? null
                  : EventType.fromApiName(eventTypeStr),
              selectedEventBaseValue: state.extra as EventBaseModel?,
            );
          },
          // pageBuilder: (context, state) => MaterialPage(
          //   fullscreenDialog: true,
          //   child: AddEventFromCatalogPage(),
          // ),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.discipline.path,
      redirect: (context, state) {
        final groupTypeStr =
            state.pathParameters[PatientPathParamsName.disciplineGroupType];

        final dateStr = state.uri.queryParameters[PatientQueryParamsName.date];

        if (groupTypeStr == null || dateStr == null) {
          return "${PatientRoutesName.base}/${PatientRoutesName.home}";
        }

        return null;
      },
      routes: [
        GoRoute(
          path: ":${PatientPathParamsName.disciplineGroupType}",
          name: PatientRoutesName.discipline.name,
          redirect: (context, state) {
            final redirect =
                "${PatientRoutesName.base}/${PatientRoutesName.home}";

            final groupTypeStr =
                state.pathParameters[PatientPathParamsName.disciplineGroupType];

            final groupType = DisciplineGroupType.fromString(groupTypeStr);

            if (groupType == null) {
              return redirect;
            }

            final dateStr =
                state.uri.queryParameters[PatientQueryParamsName.date];

            if (dateStr == null) {
              return redirect;
            }

            final date = DateTime.tryParse(dateStr);

            if (date == null) {
              return redirect;
            }

            return null;
          },
          builder: (context, state) {
            final groupTypeStr =
                state.pathParameters[PatientPathParamsName.disciplineGroupType];
            final dateStr =
                state.uri.queryParameters[PatientQueryParamsName.date];

            final groupType = DisciplineGroupType.fromString(groupTypeStr);
            DateTime date = DateTime.parse(dateStr!);

            assert(groupType != null);

            date = switch (groupType) {
              null => throw UnimplementedError(),
              DisciplineGroupType.week => date.roundToFirstDayOfWeek(),
              DisciplineGroupType.month => date.roundToFirstDayOfMonth(),
              DisciplineGroupType.year => date.roundToFirstDayOfYear(),
            };

            return DisciplinePage(groupType: groupType, date: date);
          },
        ),
      ],
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.stimulator,
      name: PatientRoutesName.stimulator,
      builder: (context, state) => StimulatorPage(),
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.medicines,
      name: PatientRoutesName.medicines,
      builder: (context, state) => MedicinesPage(),
      routes: [
        GoRoute(
          path: PatientRoutesName.createMedicines.path,
          name: PatientRoutesName.createMedicines.name,
          pageBuilder: (context, state) =>
              MaterialPage(fullscreenDialog: true, child: CreateDrugsPage()),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    GoRoute(
      path: PatientRoutesName.activity,
      name: PatientRoutesName.activity,
      builder: (context, state) => ActivityPage(),
    ),
  ],
);

=== FILE: apps/patient/navigation/widgets/animated_branch.dart ===
import 'package:animations/animations.dart';
import 'package:collection/collection.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class AnimatedBranch extends StatefulWidget {
  /// Creates a AnimatedBranchContainer
  const AnimatedBranch({
    super.key,
    required this.currentIndex,
    required this.children,
  });

  /// The index (in [children]) of the branch Navigator to display.
  final int currentIndex;

  /// The children (branch Navigators) to display in this container.
  final List<Widget> children;

  @override
  State<AnimatedBranch> createState() => _AnimatedBranchState();
}

class _AnimatedBranchState extends State<AnimatedBranch>
    with TickerProviderStateMixin {
  final List<(AnimationController, AnimationController)> _controllers = [];
  @override
  void initState() {
    for (var i = 0; i < widget.children.length; i++) {
      final controller = AnimationController(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
        vsync: this,
      );
      final controller2 = AnimationController(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 500),
        vsync: this,
      );
      if (i == widget.currentIndex) {
        controller.value = 1;
      }
      _controllers.add((controller, controller2));
    }

    super.initState();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(AnimatedBranch oldWidget) {
    switch (widget.currentIndex.compareTo(oldWidget.currentIndex)) {
      case 1:
        _controllers[oldWidget.currentIndex].$2.forward();

        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$2.value = 0;
        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$1.forward(from: 0);

        break;
      case -1:
        _controllers[oldWidget.currentIndex].$1.reverse();

        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$1.value = 1;
        _controllers[widget.currentIndex].$2.reverse(from: 1);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // return PageTransitionSwitcher(
    //   transitionBuilder: (child, primaryAnimation, secondaryAnimation) {
    //     return SharedAxisTransition(
    //       animation: primaryAnimation,
    //       secondaryAnimation: secondaryAnimation,
    //       transitionType: SharedAxisTransitionType.horizontal,
    //       fillColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.surface,
    //       child: child,
    //     );
    //   },
    //   child: _branchNavigatorWrapper(
    //     widget.currentIndex,
    //     widget.children[widget.currentIndex],
    //   ),
    // );

    return Stack(
      children: widget.children.mapIndexed((int index, Widget navigator) {
        return _branchNavigatorWrapper(
          index,
          RepaintBoundary(
            child: SharedAxisTransition(
              animation: _controllers[index].$1,
              secondaryAnimation: _controllers[index].$2,
              transitionType: SharedAxisTransitionType.horizontal,
              // fillColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
              fillColor: Colors.transparent,
              child: navigator,
            ),
          ),
        );
      }).toList(),
    );
  }

  Widget _branchNavigatorWrapper(int index, Widget navigator) => IgnorePointer(
    ignoring: index != widget.currentIndex,
    child: TickerMode(enabled: index == widget.currentIndex, child: navigator),
  );
}

=== FILE: apps/patient/navigation/widgets/scaffold.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/navigation.dart';
import '../navigator.dart';
import '../routes_name.dart';

class PatientNavigationScaffold extends StatelessWidget {
  final GoRouterState state;
  final Widget child;

  const PatientNavigationScaffold({
    super.key,
    required this.state,
    required this.child,
  });

  int get _selectedIndex {
    final fullPath = state.fullPath ?? "";

    if (fullPath.contains(PatientRoutesName.home)) return 0;
    if (fullPath.contains(PatientRoutesName.medicalCard.path)) return 1;
    // if (fullPath.contains(PatientRoutesName.chats)) return 2;
    if (fullPath.contains(PatientRoutesName.profile)) return 2;
    // if (fullPath.contains(PatientRoutesName.settings)) return 3;

    return -1;
  }

  bool get _needNavbar {
    final fullPath = state.fullPath ?? "";

    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.home)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.medicalCard.path)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.chats)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.appointment)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.services)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.settings)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(PatientRoutesName.profile)) return true;

    return false;
  }

  void _onItemTap(int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        PatientNavigator.openHome();
        break;
      case 1:
        PatientNavigator.openMedicalCard();
        break;
      case 2:
        PatientNavigator.openProfile();
        break;
      // case 3:
      //   PatientNavigator.openProfile();
      //   break;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return PNNavigationScaffold(
      selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
      needNavbar: _needNavbar,
      onItemTap: _onItemTap,
      items: [
        'assets/icons/navbar/home.svg',
        'assets/icons/navbar/medical_card.svg',
        // 'assets/icons/navbar/chats.svg',
        // 'assets/icons/navbar/settings.svg',
        'assets/icons/navbar/profile.svg',
      ],
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../features/chat/header/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../features/chat/input/widget.dart';
import '../../features/chat/messages/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../provider/bloc.dart';

class ChatPage extends HookConsumerWidget {
  final String chatId;
  final String? referral;

  const ChatPage({super.key, required this.chatId, this.referral});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final chatLisBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.chatsList);

    final headerBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.chat.header);
    final messagesBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.chat.messages);
    final inputBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.chat.input);

    useEffect(() {
      headerBloc.refresh(chatId);
      messagesBloc.refresh(chatId);
      inputBloc.refresh(chatId);
      return null;
    }, []);

    return PopScope(
      onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, result) {
        chatLisBloc.refresh();
      },
      child: Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
        appBar: AppBar(
          backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
          forceMaterialTransparency: true,
          toolbarHeight: 0,
        ),
        body: Column(
          children: [
            SizedBox(height: 24),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
              child: ChatHeaderWidget(referral: referral),
            ),
            SizedBox(height: 24),
            Expanded(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 24),
                child: ChatMessagesWidget(),
              ),
            ),

            SizedBox(height: 24),
            ChatInputWidget(),
            SizedBox(height: 24),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/eventbase/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/secondary.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../features/event_add/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../features/event_add/modules/eventbase_selector/widget.dart';
import '../../features/event_add/modules/preview/widget.dart';
import '../../features/event_add/modules/type_selector/widget.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';

class AddEventFromCatalogPage extends HookConsumerWidget
    with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  final String? currentStageValue;
  final EventType? selectedTypeValue;
  final EventBaseModel? selectedEventBaseValue;

  const AddEventFromCatalogPage({
    super.key,
    required this.currentStageValue,
    required this.selectedTypeValue,
    required this.selectedEventBaseValue,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final eventRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.event);
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final bloc = useMemoized(
      () => EventAddFromCatalogBloc(eventRepository),
      [],
    );

    useEffect(() {
      bloc.refresh();
      return null;
    }, []);

    final currentStage = useState(switch (currentStageValue) {
      "eventType" => 0,
      "eventBase" => 1,
      "preview" => 2,
      _ => 0,
    });
    final selectedType = useState<EventType?>(selectedTypeValue);
    final selectedEventBase = useState<EventBaseModel?>(selectedEventBaseValue);

    final scrollPadding = contentMargin(context) + contentPadding(context);

    return PNSecondaryScaffold(
      // title: strings.eventsCatalog.toUpperCase(),
      title: switch (currentStage.value) {
        0 => strings.eventsCatalog.toUpperCase(),
        1 => selectedType.value?.name ?? "",
        2 => strings.event,
        _ => "",
      },
      onBack: () {
        if (context.canPop()) {
          context.pop();
          return;
        }

        PatientNavigator.openEvents();
      },
      content: switch (currentStage.value) {
        0 => SingleChildScrollView(
          primary: false,
          padding: scrollPadding,
          child: EventAddFromCatalogEvenTypeSelector(
            bloc: bloc,
            onEventTypeSelect: (eventType) {
              // selectedType.value = eventType;
              // currentStage.value = 1;
              PatientNavigator.openAddEvent(
                currentStage: "eventBase",
                eventType: eventType,
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
        1 => EventAddFromCatalogEvenBaseSelector(
          contentPadding: scrollPadding,
          bloc: bloc,
          selectedType: selectedType.value!,
          onEventBaseSelect: (eventBase) {
            PatientNavigator.openAddEvent(
              currentStage: "preview",
              eventType: selectedTypeValue,
              eventBase: eventBase,
            );
          },
        ),
        2 => EventAddFromCatalogEventBasePreview(
          contentPadding: scrollPadding,
          eventBase: selectedEventBase.value!,
          addEvent: bloc.addEvent,
          onBack: () {
            currentStage.value = 1;
          },
          onClose: PatientNavigator.openEvents,
        ),
        _ => SizedBox.shrink(),
      },
    );
  }
}

class EventAIPage extends HookConsumerWidget {

  const EventAIPage({super.key, required this.event});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final aiRepository = ref.watch(ProviderRepository.patient.ai);

    final bloc = useMemoized<PhotoFormBloc>(() => PhotoFormBloc(aiRepository), [
      event.id,
    ]);

          return;

=== FILE: apps/patient/pages/event/subpages/form.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/test_info/answer.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/test_info/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/data/test_info/result.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../../features/event/preview/widget.dart';
import '../../../features/event/test/questions_bar/widget.dart';
import '../../../features/event/test/result/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../features/event/test/result/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../features/event/test/stage/widget.dart';
import '../../../navigation/navigator.dart';

class EventFormPage extends HookConsumerWidget {
  final EventModel event;
  final EventTestDataModel data;
  final EventTestResultModel? result;

  const EventFormPage({
    super.key,
    required this.event,
    required this.data,
    this.result,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final questions = data.questions;

    final currentQuestionIndex = useState(0);
    final pageController = usePageController();

    final testState = useState(_FormState.preview);
    final answers = useState<List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>>([]);

    final resultBloc = useMemoized(
      () => EventTestResultBloc(ref.read(ProviderRepository.patient.events)),
      [],
    );

    useEffect(() {
      if (result != null) {
        resultBloc.setResult(result!);
        testState.value = _FormState.result;
      }
      return;
    }, [event]);

    // TODO: use PNStateSwitcher here
    return AnimatedSwitcher(
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
      child: switch (testState.value) {
        _FormState.preview => EventPreviewWidget(
          key: const ValueKey('preview'),
          eventModel: event,
          onNextStep: () {
            testState.value = _FormState.test;
          },
        ),
        _FormState.result => EventTestResultWidget(
          key: const ValueKey('result'),
          bloc: resultBloc,
          onComplete: () {
            if (context.canPop()) {
              context.pop();
              return;
            }

            PatientNavigator.openHome();
          },
        ),
        _FormState.test => Column(
          key: const ValueKey('test'),
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            TestQuestionsBar(
              current: currentQuestionIndex.value + 1,
              total: questions.length,
            ),
            Expanded(
              child: PageView.builder(
                controller: pageController,
                itemCount: questions.length,
                itemBuilder: (context, index) => EventQuestionWidget(
                  isLastPage: index == questions.length - 1,
                  questionIndex: index,
                  question: questions[index],
                  onPrevStep: index == 0
                      ? null
                      : () {
                          currentQuestionIndex.value =
                              currentQuestionIndex.value - 1;
                          pageController.previousPage(
                            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                            curve: Curves.easeIn,
                          );
                        },
                  onNextStep: (stageAnswers) {
                    final newAnswers = List<EventQuestionAnswerModel>.from(
                      answers.value,
                    );
                    newAnswers.addAll(stageAnswers);

                    answers.value = newAnswers;

                    if (index == questions.length - 1) {
                      testState.value = _FormState.result;
                      resultBloc.refresh(
                        eventId: event.id,
                        answers: answers.value,
                      );
                      return;
                    }

                    currentQuestionIndex.value = currentQuestionIndex.value + 1;
                    pageController.nextPage(
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
                      curve: Curves.easeIn,
                    );
                  },
                  contentPadding:
                      AppUISettings.padding +
                      EdgeInsets.only(
                        bottom: MediaQuery.viewPaddingOf(context).bottom,
                      ),
                ),
                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      },
    );
  }
}

enum _FormState { preview, test, result }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:flutter_svg/svg.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/bottomsheet/service.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/cropscroll/listview.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/secondary.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/date_picker/widget.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/pass_events/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/pass_events/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/statistics/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/statistics/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/summary/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../features/discipline/summary/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';
import '../../navigation/path_params/discipline.dart';

class DisciplinePage extends HookConsumerWidget with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  final DisciplineGroupType groupType;
  final DateTime date;

  const DisciplinePage({
    super.key,
    required this.groupType,
    required this.date,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    final disciplineRepository = ref.watch(
      ProviderRepository.common.discipline,
    );

    final summaryBloc = useMemoized<DisciplineSummaryBloc>(
      () => DisciplineSummaryBloc(disciplineRepository),
      [],
    );
    final passEventsBloc = useMemoized<DisciplinePassEventsBloc>(
      () => DisciplinePassEventsBloc(disciplineRepository),
      [],
    );
    final statisticsBloc = useMemoized<DisciplineStatisticsBloc>(
      () => DisciplineStatisticsBloc(disciplineRepository),
      [],
    );

    final refresh = useCallback((
      DisciplineGroupType groupType,
      DateTime date,
    ) async {
      final request = disciplineRepository.getDiscipline(
        groupType: groupType,
        date: date,
      );

      await Future.value([
        summaryBloc.refresh(
          groupType: groupType,
          date: date,
          cacheRequest: request,
        ),
        passEventsBloc.refresh(
          groupType: groupType,
          date: date,
          cacheRequest: request,
        ),
        statisticsBloc.refresh(
          groupType: groupType,
          date: date,
          cacheRequest: request,
        ),
      ]);
    });

    useEffect(() {
      refresh(groupType, date);
      return null;
    }, [groupType, date]);

    return PNSecondaryScaffold(
      title: t.strings.discipline.toUpperCase(),
      actions: [
        (
          SvgPicture.asset(
            'assets/icons/info.svg',
            width: 32,
            height: 32,
            colorFilter: ColorFilter.mode(
              theme.primaryControl,
              BlendMode.srcIn,
            ),
          ),
          () => PNBottomSheet.showInfo(
            data: strings.helpInformationData.discipline,
          ),
        ),
      ],
      onBack: PatientNavigator.openHome,
      content: RefreshCropScroll(
        borderRadius: clipItemsBorderRadius,
        margin: contentMargin(context),
        contentPadding: contentPadding(context),
        onRefresh: () => refresh(groupType, date),
        children: [
          DisciplineDatePicker(

=== FILE: apps/patient/pages/home/medicines.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:schedule_builder/widgets/builder.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/data/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/common/event/repository.dart';
import '../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/secondary.dart';
import '../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../features/medicines/builders/loaded.dart';
import '../../features/medicines/builders/loading.dart';
import '../../features/medicines/builders/week.dart';
import '../../features/medicines/builders/week_page.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';
import '../../provider/bloc.dart';

class MedicinesPage extends HookConsumerWidget with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  const MedicinesPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final eventRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.event);
    final controller = ref.read(
      PatientProviderBloc.medicines.scheduleController,
    );

    final loadingMedicinesIds = useState<List<int>>([]);

    return PNSecondaryScaffold(
      title: strings.medicinesTake.toUpperCase(),
      onBack: PatientNavigator.openHome,
      content: ScheduleBuilder<EventModel>(
        controller: controller,
        weekBuilder: PNMedicinesScheduleWeekBuilder,
        weekPagesBuilder: PNMedicinesScheduleWeekPageBuilder,
        loadingBuilder: PNMedicinesScheduleLoadingBuilder,
        loadedBuilder: (context, data, date, selectedDate) {
          final medicines = data
              .where(
                (e) =>
                    e.data?.mapOrNull(medicine: (value) => value.data) != null,
              )
              .map(
                (e) => (e, e.data!.mapOrNull(medicine: (value) => value.data)!),
              )
              .toList();

          return PNMedicinesScheduleLoadedBuilder(
            context,
            medicines,
            loadingMedicinesIds.value,
            date,
            selectedDate,
            margin: horizontalPadding,
            contentPadding: EdgeInsets.only(
              bottom:
                  AppUISettings.largePaddingValue +
                  MediaQuery.viewPaddingOf(context).bottom,
            ),
            onMedicinesTap: (id, medicine) async {
              if (loadingMedicinesIds.value.contains(id)) {
                return;
              }

              final newLoadingIds1 = List<int>.from(loadingMedicinesIds.value);
              newLoadingIds1.add(id);
              loadingMedicinesIds.value = newLoadingIds1;

              final response = await eventRepository.toggleEvent(
                eventId: id,
                done: !medicine.done,
              );

              response.map(
                success: (data) {
                  controller.updateValue(
                    id,
                    medicine.copyWith(done: !medicine.done),
                  );
                },
                error: (data) {
                  PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
                },
              );
              final newLoadingIds2 = List<int>.from(loadingMedicinesIds.value);
              newLoadingIds2.remove(id);
              loadingMedicinesIds.value = newLoadingIds2;
            },
            onRefresh: () => controller.selectDate(date, ignoreCache: true),
          );
        },
        errorBuilder: (context, e, date, selectedDate) {
          return SizedBox.shrink();
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:infinite_scroll_pagination/infinite_scroll_pagination.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/notification/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/common/notifications/repository.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/secondary.dart';
import '../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../features/notifications_list/controller.dart';
import '../../features/notifications_list/widget.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';
import '../../provider/bloc.dart';

class NotificationsPage extends HookConsumerWidget
    with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  const NotificationsPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    final homeNotificationsBloc = ref.read(
      PatientProviderBloc.home.notifications,
    );

    final notificationsRepository = ref.read(
      ProviderRepository.common.notifications,
    );



    final pagingController = useRef<PagingController<int, NotificationModel>>(
      PagingController<int, NotificationModel>(
        getNextPageKey: (state) =>
            state.lastPageIsEmpty ? null : state.nextIntPageKey,
        fetchPage: (int pageKey) async {
          final response = await notificationsRepository.getNotificationPage(
            pageKey - 1,
          );

          return response.map(
            success: (data) {
              return data.data;
            },
            error: (data) {
              PNSnack.show(text: data.message);
              return [];
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    final markController = useRef<NotificationsMarkController>(
      NotificationsMarkController(notificationsRepository),
    );

    useEffect(() {
      return () {
        homeNotificationsBloc.refresh();
        markController.value.dispose();
      };
    }, []);

    return PNSecondaryScaffold(
      title: strings.notifications,
      onBack: PatientNavigator.openHome,
      content: NotificationListWidget(
        pagingController: pagingController.value,
        onNotificationShow: (notificationId, model) {
          if (model.read) {
            return;
          }

          markController.value.addNotificationMark(notificationId);
        },
        itemVerticalSpacing: itemVerticalPadding,
        // TODO: fix
        contentPadding: contentPadding(context) + contentMargin(context),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class HomePage extends HookConsumerWidget with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  const HomePage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final t = Translations.of(context);

    final disciplineRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.discipline);
    final eventRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.event);

    final notificationsBloc = ref.read(PatientProviderBloc.home.notifications);
    final conditionBloc = ref.read(PatientProviderBloc.home.condition);
    final eventsBloc = ref.read(PatientProviderBloc.home.todayEvents);
    final disciplineBloc = useMemoized<PatientDisciplineBloc>(
      () => PatientDisciplineBloc(disciplineRepository),
      [],
    );
    final stimulatorBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.home.stimulator);
    final medicinesBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.home.medicines);
    final activityBloc = ref.watch(PatientProviderBloc.home.activity);

    final loadingMedicinesIds = useState<List<int>>([]);

    Future<void> refresh() => Future.wait([
      notificationsBloc.refresh(),
      disciplineBloc.refresh(),
      eventsBloc.refresh(),
      conditionBloc.refresh(),
      stimulatorBloc.refresh(),
      medicinesBloc.refresh(),
      activityBloc.refresh(),
    ]);

    useEffect(() {
      refresh();
      return null;
    }, []);

    return PNPrimaryScaffold(
      title: t.strings.summary,
      subtitle: DateFormat(
        "/ d MMMM",
        LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode,
      ).format(DateTime.now()),
      actions: [
        (
          HomeNotificationButtonWidget(bloc: notificationsBloc),
          PatientNavigator.openNotifications,
        ),
      ],
      appBarHorizontalPadding: horizontalPadding,
      content: RefreshCropScroll(
        borderRadius: clipItemsBorderRadius,
        margin: contentMargin(context),
        contentPadding: contentPaddingWithNavbar(context),
        onRefresh: () async {
          await refresh();
        },
        children: [
          PatientDisciplineWidget(
            bloc: disciplineBloc,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
            onTap: PatientNavigator.openDiscipline,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          PatientDayEventsWidget(
            bloc: eventsBloc,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
            onTap: PatientNavigator.openEvents,
            onEventTap: (id) {
              PatientNavigator.openEvent(id).then((_) {
                eventsBloc.refresh();
              });
            },
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          PatientDayMedicinesWidget(
            bloc: medicinesBloc,
            loadingIds: loadingMedicinesIds.value,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
            onTap: PatientNavigator.openMedicines,
            onMedicineTap: (id, event) async {
              if (loadingMedicinesIds.value.contains(id)) {
                return;
              }

              final newLoadingIds = List<int>.from(loadingMedicinesIds.value);
              newLoadingIds.add(id);
              loadingMedicinesIds.value = newLoadingIds;

              final response = await eventRepository.toggleEvent(
                eventId: id,
                done: !event.done,
              );

              response.map(
                success: (data) {
                  medicinesBloc.updateMedicineTake(id, !event.done);
                },
                error: (data) {
                  PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
                },
              );
              final newLoadingIds2 = List<int>.from(loadingMedicinesIds.value);
              newLoadingIds2.remove(id);
              loadingMedicinesIds.value = newLoadingIds2;
            },
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          // PatientConditionWidget(
          //   bloc: conditionBloc,
          //   borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
          //   // onTap: PatientNavigator.openCondition,
          // ),
          // SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          // ActivityWidget(),
          // SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          // StimulatorWidget(),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

                profileDataBloc.refresh(preloadData: newData);
                profileEditBloc.refresh(preloadData: newData);
              },
            ),
          );
        },
        onProfileEdit: (value) => profileDataBloc.refresh(preloadData: value),

        // TODO: fix

=== FILE: apps/patient/pages/settings/notification.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/common/notifications/repository.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/cropscroll/listview.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/secondary.dart';
import '../../../../features/notification_devices/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../../features/notification_devices/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../../features/notification_toggle/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../../features/notification_toggle/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';

class NotificationPage extends HookConsumerWidget
    with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  const NotificationPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final notificationsRepository = ref.read(
      ProviderRepository.common.notifications,
    );

    final strings = context.t.strings;

    // final settingsBloc = ref.read(ProviderBloc.settings);
    final notificationToggleBloc = useRef(
      NotificationToggleBloc(notificationsRepository),
    );
    final notificationDevicesBloc = useRef(
      NotificationDevicesBloc(notificationsRepository),
    );

    final disableDevicesIds = useState<List<int>>([]);

    Future<void> refresh() {

      if (!context.mounted){
        return Future.value();
      }

      final cacheRequest = notificationsRepository.getDevices();

      return Future.wait([
      notificationToggleBloc.value.refresh(cacheRequest: cacheRequest),
      notificationDevicesBloc.value.refresh(cacheRequest: cacheRequest),
    ]);
    }

    useEffect(() {
      refresh();

      return null;
    }, []);

    return PNSecondaryScaffold(
      title: strings.notifications,
      onBack: PatientNavigator.openProfile,
      content: RefreshCropScroll(
        onRefresh: refresh,
        contentPadding: contentPadding(context),
        margin: contentMargin(context),
        borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
        children: [
          // SettingsNotificationsSection(bloc: settingsBloc),
          NotificationToggleWidget(
            bloc: notificationToggleBloc.value,
            sendTestNotification:
                notificationToggleBloc.value.sendTestNotification,
            changePush: (currentDeviceId, token, currentStatus) async {
              final newStatus = !currentStatus;

              final response = await notificationToggleBloc.value
                  .changePushNotification(currentDeviceId, token, newStatus);

              if (!response) {
                return;
              }

              await notificationToggleBloc.value.updatePushStatus(newStatus);

              notificationDevicesBloc.value.changeDeviceStatus(
                currentDeviceId,
                newStatus,
              );
            },
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          NotificationDevicesWidget(
            bloc: notificationDevicesBloc.value,
            disableIds: disableDevicesIds.value,
            onDeviceDelete: (id, currentDeviceId) async {
              if (disableDevicesIds.value.contains(id)) {
                return;
              }

              final newDisableDevicesIds = List<int>.from(
                disableDevicesIds.value,
              );
              newDisableDevicesIds.add(id);
              disableDevicesIds.value = newDisableDevicesIds;

              final response = await notificationsRepository.deleteDevices(id);

              response.map(
                success: (data) {
                  notificationDevicesBloc.value.changeDeviceStatus(id, false);

                  if (id == currentDeviceId) {
                    notificationToggleBloc.value.updatePushStatus(false);
                  }
                },
                error: (data) {
                  PNSnack.show(
                    text: data.message,
                    type: PNSnackType.error,
                    errorValue: data.errorValue,
                  );
                },
              );
              final newDisableDevicesIds2 = List<int>.from(
                disableDevicesIds.value,
              );
              newDisableDevicesIds2.remove(id);
              disableDevicesIds.value = newDisableDevicesIds2;
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _EventsProvider {
  final scheduleController = Provider<ScheduleController<EventModel>>((ref) {
    final eventsRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.events);

    return ScheduleController<EventModel>(
      dataLoader: (begin, end) async {
        final response = await eventsRepository.getEvents(
          begin: begin,
          end: end,
          eventTypes: [
            EventType.audio,
            // EventType.drug,
            EventType.file,
            EventType.form,
            EventType.photo,
            EventType.task,
            EventType.test,
            EventType.video,
          ],
        );

        return response.map(
          success: (data) => data.data,
          error: (data) => throw Exception(data.message),
        );
      },

      initialSelectedDate: DateTime.now(),
    );
  });

  final counter = Provider<EventsCounterBloc>(
    (ref) => EventsCounterBloc(ref.watch(ProviderRepository.patient.events)),
  );

  final items = Provider<EventsItemsBloc>(
    (ref) => EventsItemsBloc(ref.watch(ProviderRepository.patient.events)),
  );
}

class _MedicinesProvider {
  final scheduleController = Provider<ScheduleController<EventModel>>((ref) {
    final eventsRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.events);

    return ScheduleController<EventModel>(
      dataLoader: (begin, end) async {
        final response = await eventsRepository.getEvents(
          begin: begin,
          end: end,
          eventTypes: [
            // EventType.audio,
            EventType.drug,
            // EventType.file,
            // EventType.form,
            // EventType.photo,
            // EventType.task,
            // EventType.test,
            // EventType.video,
          ],
          withData: true,
          withSource: true,
        );

        return response.map(
          success: (data) {
            final mapped = data.data.map(
              (date, events) => MapEntry(date, events),
            );

            return mapped;
          },
          error: (data) => throw Exception(data.message),
        );
      },

      initialSelectedDate: DateTime.now(),
    );
  });

  final counter = Provider<DrugsCounterBloc>(
    (ref) => DrugsCounterBloc(ref.watch(ProviderRepository.patient.drugs)),
  );

  final items = Provider<DrugsItemsBloc>(
    (ref) => DrugsItemsBloc(ref.watch(ProviderRepository.patient.drugs)),
  );
}

=== FILE: apps/relative/features/settings/actions/widgets/logout.dart ===
part of '../widgets.dart';

class _Logout extends ConsumerWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  const _Logout({
    this.borderRadius = const BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(12)),
  });

  Future<void> _showLogoutDialog(
    BuildContext context,
    VoidCallback onConfirm,
  ) => Navigator.of(context).push(
    CupertinoModalPopupRoute(
      barrierColor: const Color(0xFF000000).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
      builder: (_) => BackdropFilter(
        filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 3, sigmaY: 3),
        child: Stack(
          alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          children: [
            PNConfirmDialog(
              title: context.t.strings.areYouSureLogout,
              onConfirm: onConfirm,
              confirmText: context.t.strings.yes,
              cancelText: context.t.strings.no,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tokenRepository = ref.watch(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    return CupertinoButton(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12),
      sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
      color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
      onPressed: () => _showLogoutDialog(rootNavigatorKey.currentContext!, () {
        tokenRepository.logout();
        PNSnack.show(text: context.t.strings.successfullyLoggedOut);
        AppNavigator.openAuthorizationPage();
      }),
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Container(
        constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(24 * 2)),

        width: double.infinity,
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            PNText(
              context.t.strings.logoutFromAccount,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              fontSize: context.au(14),
            ),
            SizedBox(width: 8),
            Icon(
              Icons.logout_outlined,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
              size: context.au(16),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

part 'widgets/switch.dart';

class RelativeSettingsAction extends ConsumerWidget {
  const RelativeSettingsAction({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final tokenRepository = ref.watch(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    final canSwitchApp =
        tokenRepository.currentUserType == UserType.administrator;

    return Column(
      children: [
        if (canSwitchApp)
          _SwitchApp(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
              topLeft: Radius.circular(12),
              topRight: Radius.circular(12),
            ),
          ),
        _Logout(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
            topLeft: canSwitchApp ? Radius.zero : Radius.circular(12),
            topRight: canSwitchApp ? Radius.zero : Radius.circular(12),
            bottomLeft: Radius.circular(12),
            bottomRight: Radius.circular(12),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/repositories/common/client/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../../../.gen/apps/relative/features/ward/data/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class WardDataBloc extends Cubit<WardDataState> {
  final ClientRepository _clientRepository;

  WardDataBloc(this._clientRepository) : super(WardDataState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh(int wardId, {ClientModel? preloadData}) async {
    if (AppFeaturesSettings.blocRefreshForceLoadingState) {
      emit(WardDataState.loading());
    }

    if (preloadData != null) {
      emit(WardDataState.loaded(data: preloadData));
      return;
    }

    final response = await _clientRepository.getClientData(userId: wardId);

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(WardDataState.loaded(data: data.data));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(WardDataState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }
}
