=== FILE: apps/relative/features/ward/data/ui/states/loaded.dart ===
part of '../widget.dart';

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final ClientModel data;
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;

  const _Loaded({
    this.data = ClientModel.mock,
    this.borderRadius = AppUISettings.borderRadius,
  });

  int? _calculateAge(DateTime? birthDate) {
    if (birthDate == null) {
      return null;
    }

    final age = DateTime.now().difference(birthDate).inDays ~/ 365;

    return age;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;
    // final theme = context.pNTheme;

    final age = _calculateAge(data.birthDate);

    return PNCard(
      constraints: BoxConstraints.tightFor(width: double.infinity),
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          AvatarWidget(
            resourceId: data.avatarResourceId,
            backgroundColor: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
            size: 64,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          PNText(
            [
              data.lastName,
              data.firstName,
              if (data.additionalName != null) data.additionalName,
            ].join(" "),
            fontSize: context.au(16),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          ),
          PNText(
            [
              if (age != null) strings.yearsOld(n: age),
              if (data.cityName != null) data.cityName,
            ].join(", "),
            fontSize: context.au(14),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
          ),
          if (data.phone != null)
            PNText(
              data.phone!,
              fontSize: context.au(14),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
            ),

          PNText(
            data.email,
            fontSize: context.au(14),
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
            color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/clients/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../../features/ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../../.gen/apps/relative/features/wards_list/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class RelativeWardsListBloc extends Cubit<RelativeWardsListState> {
  final ClientsRepository _clientsRepository;

  RelativeWardsListBloc(this._clientsRepository)
    : super(RelativeWardsListState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    if (AppFeaturesSettings.blocRefreshForceLoadingState) {
      final data = state is _Loaded ? state as _Loaded : null;

      emit(
        RelativeWardsListState.loading(
          loadingItemCount: data?.wards.length ?? 3,
        ),
      );
    }

    final response = await _clientsRepository.getWards();
    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(RelativeWardsListState.loaded(wards: data.data));
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);

        emit(RelativeWardsListState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final void Function(int id, ClientModel client)? onWardTap;
  final double itemVerticalSpacing;
  final List<ClientModel> wards;

  const _Loaded({
    this.onWardTap,
    this.itemVerticalSpacing = AppUISettings.paddingValue,
    this.wards = const [],
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    if (wards.isEmpty) {
      return PNCard.error(strings.youHaveNoAttachedWards);
    }

    return Column(
      spacing: itemVerticalSpacing,
      children: List.generate(
        wards.length,
        (index) => ClientCard(
          title: strings.ward,
          subtitle: strings.statusInfo,
          onTap: () => onWardTap?.call(wards[index].id, wards[index]),
          client: wards[index],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

final class RelativeNavigator {
  RelativeNavigator._();

  static void openWards() => router.goNamed(RelativeRoutesName.wards.name);

  static void openWard(int wardId, {ClientModel? preloadData}) =>
      router.pushNamed(
        RelativeRoutesName.ward.name,
        pathParameters: {RelativePathsName.id: wardId.toString()},
        extra: preloadData,
      );

  static void openSettings() =>
      router.pushNamed(RelativeRoutesName.settings.name);

import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../core/repositories/common/token/repository.dart';

import '../../../navigation/fade_transition.dart';
import '../../../navigation/routes_name.dart';
import '../../../provider/repository.dart';

import 'routers_name.dart';
import 'routes/settings.dart';
import 'routes/wards.dart';
import 'widgets/scaffold.dart';

GoRoute relativeRouter = GoRoute(
  path: RelativeRoutesName.base,
  name: RelativeRoutesName.base,
  redirect: (context, state) {
    final tokenRepository = ProviderScope.containerOf(
      context,
    ).read<TokenRepository>(ProviderRepository.common.token);

    if (!tokenRepository.haveValidToken()) {
      // PNSnack.show(
      //   text: context.t.strings.pleasLoginToContinue,
      //   type: PNSnackType.error,
      // );
      return RoutesName.auth;
    }

    if (!tokenRepository.canAccessRelativeApp()) {
      // PNSnack.show(
      //   text: context.t.strings.enterDoctorAccount,
      //   type: PNSnackType.error,
      // );
      return RoutesName.auth;
    }

    if (state.fullPath == RelativeRoutesName.base) {
      return "${RelativeRoutesName.base}/${RelativeRoutesName.wards.path}";
    }

    return null;
  },
  routes: [
    ShellRoute(
      pageBuilder: (context, state, child) => FadeTransitionPage(
        child: RelativeNavigationScaffold(state: state, child: child),
      ),
      routes: [wardsRoutes, settingsRoutes],
    ),
  ],
);

import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../../navigation/fade_transition.dart';
import '../../pages/wards/page.dart';

import '../routers_name.dart';

final wardsRoutes = GoRoute(
  path: RelativeRoutesName.wards.path,
  name: RelativeRoutesName.wards.name,
  pageBuilder: (context, state) =>
      FadeTransitionPage(key: state.pageKey, child: WardsPage()),
  routes: [
    GoRoute(
      path: ":${RelativePathsName.id}",
      name: RelativeRoutesName.ward.name,
      redirect: (context, state) {
        final redirectPath =
            "${RelativeRoutesName.base}/${RelativeRoutesName.wards.path}";

        final id = state.pathParameters[RelativePathsName.id];

        if (id == null) {
          return redirectPath;
        }

        if (int.tryParse(id) == null) {
          return redirectPath;
        }

        return null;
      },
      builder: (context, state) {
        ClientModel? preloadData;

        if (state.extra is ClientModel) {
          preloadData = state.extra as ClientModel;
        }

        return WardPage(
          wardId: int.parse(state.pathParameters[RelativePathsName.id]!),
          preloadData: preloadData,
        );
      },
    ),
  ],
);

=== FILE: apps/relative/navigation/widgets/scaffold.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/navigation.dart';
import '../navigator.dart';
import '../routers_name.dart';

class RelativeNavigationScaffold extends StatelessWidget {
  final GoRouterState state;
  final Widget child;

  const RelativeNavigationScaffold({
    super.key,
    required this.state,
    required this.child,
  });

  int get _selectedIndex {
    final fullPath = state.fullPath ?? "";

    if (fullPath.contains(RelativeRoutesName.wards.path)) return 0;
    if (fullPath.contains(RelativeRoutesName.settings.path)) return 1;

    return -1;
  }

  bool get _needNavbar {
    final fullPath = state.fullPath ?? "";

    if (fullPath.endsWith(RelativeRoutesName.wards.path)) return true;
    if (fullPath.endsWith(RelativeRoutesName.settings.path)) return true;

    return false;
  }

  void _onItemTap(int index) {
    switch (index) {
      case 0:
        RelativeNavigator.openWards();
        break;
      case 1:
        RelativeNavigator.openSettings();
        break;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return PNNavigationScaffold(
      selectedIndex: _selectedIndex,
      needNavbar: _needNavbar,
      onItemTap: _onItemTap,
      items: [
        'assets/icons/navbar/home.svg',
        // 'assets/icons/navbar/profile.svg',
        'assets/icons/navbar/settings.svg',
        // 'assets/icons/navbar/medical_card.svg',
        // 'assets/icons/navbar/chats.svg',
      ],
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: apps/relative/pages/wards/page.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/cropscroll/listview.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/primary.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../features/wards_list/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../features/wards_list/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';

class WardsPage extends HookConsumerWidget with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  const WardsPage({super.key});
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final clientsRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.clients);

    final wardsBloc = useRef<RelativeWardsListBloc>(
      RelativeWardsListBloc(clientsRepository),
    );

    Future<void> refresh() {
      if (!context.mounted) {
        return Future.value();
      }

      return Future.wait([wardsBloc.value.refresh()]);
    }

    useEffect(() {
      refresh();
      return null;
    }, []);

    return PNPrimaryScaffold(
      title: strings.wards,
      content: RefreshCropScroll(
        onRefresh: refresh,
        margin: contentMargin(context),
        contentPadding: contentPaddingWithNavbar(context),
        children: [
          RelativeWardsList(
            bloc: wardsBloc.value,
            onWardTap: (id, client) =>
                RelativeNavigator.openWard(id, preloadData: client),
            itemVerticalSpacing: itemVerticalPadding,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_hooks/flutter_hooks.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/client/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/cropscroll/listview.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/properties.dart';
import '../../../../core/ui/widgets/scaffold/secondary.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/condition/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/condition/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/day_events/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/day_events/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/day_medicines/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/day_medicines/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/discipline/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../../../features/patient/discipline/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../../../provider/repository.dart';
import '../../features/ward/data/bloc/bloc.dart';
import '../../features/ward/data/ui/widget.dart';
import '../../navigation/navigator.dart';

class WardPage extends HookConsumerWidget with PNScaffoldBaseProperties {
  final int wardId;
  final ClientModel? preloadData;

  const WardPage({super.key, required this.wardId, this.preloadData});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final clientRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.client);
    final disciplineRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.discipline);
    final overviewRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.overview);
    final patientEventsRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.patient.events);
    final eventsRepository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.events);

    final dataBloc = useMemoized<WardDataBloc>(
      () => WardDataBloc(clientRepository),
      [wardId],
    );
    final disciplineBloc = useMemoized<PatientDisciplineBloc>(
      () => PatientDisciplineBloc(disciplineRepository),
      [wardId],
    );
    final conditionBloc = useMemoized<PatientConditionBloc>(
      () => PatientConditionBloc(overviewRepository),
      [wardId],
    );
    final eventsBloc = useMemoized<PatientDayEventsBloc>(
      () => PatientDayEventsBloc(patientEventsRepository),
      [wardId],
    );
    final medicinesBloc = useMemoized<PatientDayMedicinesBloc>(
      () => PatientDayMedicinesBloc(eventsRepository),
      [wardId],
    );

    Future<void> refresh() {
      if (!context.mounted) {
        return Future.value();
      }

      return Future.wait([
        dataBloc.refresh(wardId, preloadData: preloadData),
        disciplineBloc.refresh(wardId),
        eventsBloc.refresh(wardId),
        conditionBloc.refresh(wardId),
        medicinesBloc.refresh(wardId),
      ]);
    }

    useEffect(() {
      refresh();
      return null;
    }, [wardId]);

    return PNSecondaryScaffold(
      title: strings.ward,
      onBack: RelativeNavigator.openWards,
      appBarHorizontalPadding: horizontalPadding,
      content: RefreshCropScroll(
        borderRadius: clipItemsBorderRadius,
        margin: contentMargin(context),
        contentPadding: contentPadding(context),
        onRefresh: () async {
          await refresh();
        },
        children: [
          WardDataWidget(bloc: dataBloc, borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          PatientDisciplineWidget(
            bloc: disciplineBloc,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          PatientDayEventsWidget(
            bloc: eventsBloc,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          PatientDayMedicinesWidget(
            bloc: medicinesBloc,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: itemVerticalPadding),
          PatientConditionWidget(
            bloc: conditionBloc,
            borderRadius: itemsBorderRadius,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// ignore_for_file: empty_catches

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:chopper/chopper.dart';

import '../../../../utils/error.dart';

class ErrorInterceptor implements Interceptor {
  ErrorInterceptor();

  @override
  FutureOr<Response<BodyType>> intercept<BodyType>(
    Chain<BodyType> chain,
  ) async {
    final request = chain.request;

    final response = await chain.proceed(request);

    final errorMessage = ErrorHandler.tryToExtractError(response);

    if (errorMessage != null) {
      throw PNException(response.statusCode, errorMessage);
    }

    return response;
  }
}

=== FILE: core/api/v1/interceptors/locale.dart ===
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:chopper/chopper.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';

class LocaleInterceptor implements Interceptor {
  LocaleInterceptor();

  @override
  FutureOr<Response<BodyType>> intercept<BodyType>(
    Chain<BodyType> chain,
  ) async {
    final language = LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode;

    final request = chain.request;
    final updatedRequest = request.copyWith(
      parameters: request.parameters..addAll({'lang': language}),
      headers: request.headers..addAll({'lang': language}),
    );

    final response = await chain.proceed(updatedRequest);

    return response;
  }
}

=== FILE: core/api/v1/interceptors/logger.dart ===
// ignore_for_file: empty_catches

import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:chopper/chopper.dart';

import '../../../../logger/event.dart';
import '../../../../logger/logger.dart';

class LoggerInterceptor implements Interceptor {
  LoggerInterceptor();

  @override
  FutureOr<Response<BodyType>> intercept<BodyType>(
    Chain<BodyType> chain,
  ) async {
    final request = chain.request;

    try {
      final LoggerEvent message = LoggerEvent(request.url.toString(), {
        "method": request.method,
        "headers": request.headers.toString(),
        "body": request.body.toString(),
        "query": request.parameters.toString(),
      });

      PNLogger.api(message);
    } catch (e) {}

    final response = await chain.proceed(request);

    try {
      final body = response.bodyString;
      final decodeBody = utf8.decode(body.codeUnits);

      final LoggerEvent message =
          LoggerEvent(response.base.request?.url.toString() ?? "", {
            "method": response.base.request?.method ?? "",
            "body": decodeBody,
            "statusCode": response.statusCode.toString(),
          });

      PNLogger.api(message);
    } catch (e) {}

    return response;
  }
}

=== FILE: core/api/v1/interceptors/token.dart ===
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:chopper/chopper.dart' as chopper;
import 'package:dio/dio.dart' as dio;

import '../../../repositories/common/token/repository.dart';

class TokenInterceptor implements chopper.Interceptor {
  final TokenRepository _tokenRepository;

  TokenInterceptor(this._tokenRepository);

  @override
  FutureOr<chopper.Response<BodyType>> intercept<BodyType>(
    chopper.Chain<BodyType> chain,
  ) async {
    final token = _tokenRepository.getToken();

    final request = chain.request;

    final updatedRequest = request.copyWith(
      headers: request.headers..addAll({'auth': token ?? ""}),
    );

    final response = await chain.proceed(updatedRequest);

    return response;
  }
}

class DioTokenInterceptor extends dio.Interceptor {
  final TokenRepository _tokenRepository;

  DioTokenInterceptor(this._tokenRepository);

  @override
  void onRequest(
    dio.RequestOptions options,
    dio.RequestInterceptorHandler handler,
  ) async {
    final token = _tokenRepository.getToken();
    options.headers['auth'] = token ?? "";
    handler.next(options);
  }
}

import 'package:chopper/chopper.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/api/v1/service/auth.chopper.dart';

@ChopperApi(baseUrl: '/v1/auth')
abstract class AuthServiceV1 extends ChopperService {
  @POST(path: '/change_password')
  Future<Response> changePassword(
    @Field('email') String email,
    @Field('password') String password,
    @Field('code') String code,
  );

  @GET(path: '/is_email_taken')
  Future<Response> isEmailTaken(@Query('email') String email);

  @POST(path: '/login')
  Future<Response> login(
    @Field('email') String email,
    @Field('password') String password,
  );

  @POST(path: '/signup')
  Future<Response> register(
    @Field('fname') String firstName,
    @Field('lname') String lastName,
    @Field('email') String email,
    @Field('password') String password,
    @Field('city_id') int cityId, {
    @Field('aname') String? anotherName,
    @Field('phone') String? phone,
    @Field('gender') String? gender,
    @Field('birthdate') String? birthdate,
  });

  @POST(path: '/refresh')
  Future<Response> refresh(@Field('r_token') String refreshToken);

  @POST(path: '/verify_email')
  Future<Response> sendCode({@Field('email') required String email});

  @POST(path: '/verify_email')
  Future<Response> checkCode({
    @Field('email') required String email,
    @Field('code') required String code,
  });

  @POST(path: '/verify_email')
  Future<Response> verifyEmail({
    @Field('email') required String email,
    @Field('code') required String code,
    @Field('verify') required bool verify,
  });

  static AuthServiceV1 create([ChopperClient? client]) =>
      _$AuthServiceV1(client);
}

=== FILE: core/models/chat/message.dart ===
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

part '../../../.gen/core/models/chat/message.freezed.dart';
part '../../../.gen/core/models/chat/message.g.dart';

@freezed
abstract class ChatMessageModel with _$ChatMessageModel {
  factory ChatMessageModel.info({
    @Default('info') String type,
    required String id,
    required String text,
  }) = ChatMessageInfoModel;

  factory ChatMessageModel.text({
    @Default('text') String type,
    required String id,
    required String text,
    required String authorId,
    required DateTime time,
  }) = ChatMessageTextModel;

  factory ChatMessageModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$ChatMessageModelFromJson(json);

  factory ChatMessageModel.fromJsonTyped(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    switch (json['type'] as String?) {
      case 'info':
        return _$ChatMessageInfoModelFromJson(json);
      case 'text':
        return _$ChatMessageTextModelFromJson(json);
      default:
        throw CheckedFromJsonException(
          json,
          'runtimeType',
          'ChatMessageModel',
          'Invalid union type "${json['type']}"!',
        );
    }
  }
}

import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

import 'role.dart';

part '../../../.gen/core/models/client/model.freezed.dart';

@freezed
abstract class ClientModel with _$ClientModel {
  const ClientModel._();

  const factory ClientModel({
    required int id,
    required ClientRole role,

    /// Имя
    required String firstName,

    /// Фамилия
    required String lastName,

    /// Отчество
    String? additionalName,

    required String email,
    int? avatarResourceId,
    String? phone,
    DateTime? birthDate,
    String? cityName,
  }) = _ClientModel;

  static const ClientModel mock = ClientModel(
    id: -1,
    role: ClientRole.patient,
    firstName: 'firstName',
    lastName: 'lastName',
    email: 'client@email.ru',
  );

  factory ClientModel.fromSchema(api_client.ClientSchema schema) => ClientModel(
    id: schema.id,
    role: ClientRole.fromApiValue(schema.role),
    firstName: schema.fname,
    lastName: schema.lname,
    additionalName: schema.aname,
    email: schema.email,
    avatarResourceId: schema.avatarId,
    phone: schema.phone,
    birthDate: schema.birthdate,
    cityName: schema.cityName,
  );

  api_client.ClientUpdateSchema get toUpdateSchema =>
      api_client.ClientUpdateSchema(
        role: role.toApiValue(),
        fname: firstName,
        lname: lastName,
        aname: additionalName,
        phone: phone,
        birthdate: birthDate,
      );

  String get formattedName => [
                    lastName,
                    firstName,
                    if (additionalName != null) additionalName,
                  ].join(" ");
}

=== FILE: core/models/client/role.dart ===
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

enum ClientRole {
  patient,
  relative,
  expert,
  admin,
  moderator;

  api_client.ClientRoles toApiValue() => switch (this) {
    ClientRole.patient => api_client.ClientRoles.patient,
    ClientRole.relative => api_client.ClientRoles.relative,
    ClientRole.expert => api_client.ClientRoles.expert,
    ClientRole.admin => api_client.ClientRoles.admin,
    ClientRole.moderator => api_client.ClientRoles.moderator,
  };

  factory ClientRole.fromApiValue(api_client.ClientRoles value) =>
      switch (value) {
        api_client.ClientRoles.patient => ClientRole.patient,
        api_client.ClientRoles.relative => ClientRole.relative,
        api_client.ClientRoles.expert => ClientRole.expert,
        api_client.ClientRoles.admin => ClientRole.admin,
        api_client.ClientRoles.moderator => ClientRole.moderator,
        api_client.ClientRoles.$unknown => throw UnimplementedError(),
      };
}

@freezed
abstract class EventQuestionAnswerModel with _$EventQuestionAnswerModel {
  const EventQuestionAnswerModel._();

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.text({
    int? questionId,
    required String value,
  }) = _Text;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.number({
    int? questionId,
    required int value,
  }) = _Number;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.time({
    int? questionId,
    required TimeOfDay value,
  }) = _Time;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.date({
    int? questionId,
    required DateTime value,
  }) = _Date;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.dateTime({
    int? questionId,
    required DateTime value,
  }) = _DateTime;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.file({int? questionId}) = _File;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.select({
    int? questionId,
    required List<int> values,
  }) = _Select;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.radio({
    int? questionId,
    required int value,
  }) = _Radio;

  const factory EventQuestionAnswerModel.radioOrText({
    int? questionId,
    required int? value,
    required String? textValue,
  }) = _RadioOrText;

  api_client.AnswerInfo get toSchema => api_client.AnswerInfo(
    qId: questionId!,
    type: map(
      text: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.text,
      number: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.number,
      time: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.time,
      date: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.date,
      dateTime: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.dt,
      file: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.file,
      select: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.select,
      radio: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.radio,
      radioOrText: (_) => api_client.QuestionType.radioOrText,
    ),
    optionIds: maybeMap(
      radio: (data) => [data.value],
      radioOrText: (data) => data.value != null ? [data.value!] : [],
      select: (data) => data.values,
      orElse: () => [],
    ),
    text: mapOrNull(
      text: (data) => data.value,
      radioOrText: (data) => data.textValue,
    ),
    number: mapOrNull(number: (data) => data.value),
    d: mapOrNull(date: (data) => data.value.roundToDayStart()),
    t: mapOrNull(time: (data) => data.value.toString()),
    dt: mapOrNull(dateTime: (data) => data.value),
  );
}

=== FILE: core/models/event/data/test_info/model.dart ===
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

part 'question.dart';

part '../../../../../.gen/core/models/event/data/test_info/model.freezed.dart';
part '../../../../../.gen/core/models/event/data/test_info/model.g.dart';

@freezed
abstract class EventTestDataModel with _$EventTestDataModel {
  const factory EventTestDataModel({
    required List<EventQuestionDataModel> questions,
  }) = _EventTestDataModel;

  factory EventTestDataModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$EventTestDataModelFromJson(json);

  factory EventTestDataModel.fromSchema(api_client.TestInfo schema) {
    final conditions = schema.condition ?? [];

    // Создаем карту связей: option_id -> [question_ids]
    final Map<int, List<int>> optionToQuestions = {};
    for (final condition in conditions) {
      final optionId = condition.oId;
      final questionId = condition.qId;
      if (optionId != null && questionId != null) {
        optionToQuestions.putIfAbsent(optionId, () => []).add(questionId);
      }
    }

    // Собираем ID всех вопросов, которые станут вложенными
    final Set<int> nestedQuestionIds = {};
    for (final questionIds in optionToQuestions.values) {
      nestedQuestionIds.addAll(questionIds);
    }

    // Создаем карту вопросов по ID для быстрого поиска
    final Map<int, api_client.QuestionSchema> questionsById = {};
    for (final question in schema.questions) {
      if (question.id != null) {
        questionsById[question.id!] = question;
      }
    }

    // Обрабатываем каждый вопрос и добавляем вложенные вопросы к опциям
    final List<EventQuestionDataModel> processedQuestions = [];

    for (final question in schema.questions) {
      // Пропускаем вопросы, которые станут вложенными
      if (question.id != null && nestedQuestionIds.contains(question.id)) {
        continue;
      }

      // Если у вопроса есть опции, проверяем, нужно ли добавить вложенные вопросы
      if (question.data?.options != null &&
          question.data!.options!.isNotEmpty) {
        final List<(int, String, List<EventQuestionDataModel>)>
        processedOptions = [];

        for (final option in question.data!.options!) {
          final nestedQuestions = <EventQuestionDataModel>[];

          // Проверяем, есть ли вложенные вопросы для этой опции
          if (optionToQuestions.containsKey(option.id)) {
            for (final nestedQuestionId in optionToQuestions[option.id]!) {
              final nestedQuestion = questionsById[nestedQuestionId];
              if (nestedQuestion != null) {
                nestedQuestions.add(
                  EventQuestionDataModel.fromSchema(nestedQuestion),
                );
              }
            }
          }

          // Добавляем все вложенные вопросы
          processedOptions.add((option.id, option.text, nestedQuestions));
        }

        // Создаем вопрос с обработанными опциями
        final processedQuestion = switch (question.type) {
          api_client.QuestionType.radio => EventQuestionDataModel.radio(
            id: question.id,
            text: question.text,
            options: processedOptions,
          ),
          api_client.QuestionType.select => EventQuestionDataModel.select(
            id: question.id,
            text: question.text,
            options: processedOptions,
          ),
          api_client.QuestionType.radioOrText =>
            EventQuestionDataModel.radioOrText(
              id: question.id,
              text: question.text,
              options: processedOptions,
              insideHint: question.hint,
            ),
          _ => EventQuestionDataModel.fromSchema(question),
        };

        processedQuestions.add(processedQuestion);
      } else {
        // Для вопросов без опций просто конвертируем как обычно
        processedQuestions.add(EventQuestionDataModel.fromSchema(question));
      }
    }

    return _EventTestDataModel(questions: processedQuestions);
  }
}

@freezed
abstract class EventQuestionDataModel with _$EventQuestionDataModel {
  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.text({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    String? insideHint,
  }) = _Text;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.number({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    String? insideHint,
  }) = _Number;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.time({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    String? insideHint,
  }) = _Time;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.date({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    String? insideHint,
  }) = _Date;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.dateTime({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    String? insideHint,
  }) = _DateTime;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.file({int? id}) = _File;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.select({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    required List<(int, String, List<EventQuestionDataModel>)> options,
  }) = _Select;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.radio({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    required List<(int, String, List<EventQuestionDataModel>)> options,
  }) = _Radio;

  const factory EventQuestionDataModel.radioOrText({
    int? id,
    required String text,
    required List<(int, String, List<EventQuestionDataModel>)> options,
    String? insideHint,
  }) = _RadioOrText;

  factory EventQuestionDataModel.fromSchema(api_client.QuestionSchema schema) {
    return switch (schema.type) {
      api_client.QuestionType.text => _Text(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        insideHint: schema.hint,
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.number => _Number(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        insideHint: schema.hint,
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.time => _Time(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        insideHint: schema.hint,
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.date => _Date(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        insideHint: schema.hint,
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.dt => _DateTime(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        insideHint: schema.hint,
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.file => _File(id: schema.id),
      api_client.QuestionType.radio => _Radio(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        options:
            schema.data?.options
                ?.map((e) => (e.id, e.text, <EventQuestionDataModel>[]))
                .toList() ??
            [],
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.select => _Select(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        options:
            schema.data?.options
                ?.map((e) => (e.id, e.text, <EventQuestionDataModel>[]))
                .toList() ??
            [],
      ),
      api_client.QuestionType.radioOrText => _RadioOrText(
        id: schema.id,
        text: schema.text,
        options:
            schema.data?.options
                ?.map((e) => (e.id, e.text, <EventQuestionDataModel>[]))
                .toList() ??
            [],
        insideHint: schema.hint,
      ),

      api_client.QuestionType.$unknown => throw UnimplementedError(),
    };
  }

  factory EventQuestionDataModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$EventQuestionDataModelFromJson(json);
}

import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;
import 'package:schedule_builder/controller/controller.dart';

import 'data/drug_info/model.dart';
import 'data/model.dart';
import 'data/test_info/model.dart';
import 'data/test_info/result.dart';
import 'type.dart';

part '../../../.gen/core/models/event/model.freezed.dart';
part '../../../.gen/core/models/event/model.g.dart';

@freezed
abstract class EventModel with _$EventModel implements Identifiable {
  const EventModel._();

  @override
  int get scheduleId => id;

  const factory EventModel({
    required int id,
    @Default("EMPTY_NAME") String name,
    @Default("EMPTY_DESCRIPTION") String description,
    DateTime? date,
    required EventType eventType,
    required TaskType taskType,
    @Default(false) bool done,
    @Default(false) bool canChange,
    EventData? data,
  }) = _EventModel;

  factory EventModel.fromSchema(api_client.EventSchema schema) {
    final testInfo = schema.data?.source?.testInfo;
    final testData = testInfo != null
        ? EventTestDataModel.fromSchema(testInfo)
        : null;

    final testResultInfo = schema.data?.result?.testInfo;
    final testResult = testResultInfo != null
        ? EventTestResultModel.fromSchema(schema, testResultInfo)
        : null;

    final medicinesInfo = schema.data?.source?.drugInfo;
    final medicinesData = medicinesInfo != null
        ? MedicineInfoModel.fromSchema(medicinesInfo)
        : null;

    return _EventModel(
      id: schema.id,
      name: schema.name,
      description: schema.description ?? "EMPTY_DESCRIPTION",
      date: schema.dt,
      eventType: switch (schema.eventType) {
        api_client.EventType.drug => EventType.drug,
        api_client.EventType.form => EventType.form,
        api_client.EventType.test => EventType.test,
        api_client.EventType.audio => EventType.audio,
        api_client.EventType.photo => EventType.photo,
        api_client.EventType.file => EventType.file,
        api_client.EventType.task => EventType.task,
        api_client.EventType.video => EventType.video,
        api_client.EventType.$unknown => throw UnimplementedError(),
      },
      taskType: switch (schema.taskType) {
        api_client.TaskType.mandatory => TaskType.mandatory,
        api_client.TaskType.optional => TaskType.optional,
        api_client.TaskType.$unknown => throw UnimplementedError(),
      },
      data: switch (schema.eventType) {
        api_client.EventType.test =>
          testData != null
              ? EventData.test(
                  data: testData,
                  result: schema.done ? testResult : null,
                )
              : null,
        api_client.EventType.form =>
          testData != null
              ? EventData.test(
                  data: testData,
                  result: schema.done ? testResult : null,
                )
              : null,

        api_client.EventType.drug =>
          medicinesData != null
              ? EventData.medicine(data: medicinesData)
              : null,
        _ => null,
      },

      done: schema.done,
      canChange: schema.canChange,
    );
  }

  static const EventModel mock = EventModel(
    id: -1,
    eventType: EventType.task,
    taskType: TaskType.optional,
  );

  factory EventModel.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>
      _$EventModelFromJson(json);
}

@freezed
class EventOftenModel with _$EventOftenModel {
  const factory EventOftenModel.day() = _EventOftenModelDay;

  const factory EventOftenModel.month() = _EventOftenModelWeek;

  const factory EventOftenModel.xDays({int? days}) = _EventOftenModelXDays;

  const factory EventOftenModel.weekDays({@Default([]) List<int> days}) =
      _EventOftenModelWeekDays;

  factory EventOftenModel.fromSchema(api_client.EbrSchema schema) {
    return switch (schema.interval) {
      EbrSchemaInterval.day => switch (schema.dayTimes) {
        0 => EventOftenModel.day(),
        null => throw UnimplementedError(),
        _ => EventOftenModel.xDays(days: schema.dayTimes),
      },
      EbrSchemaInterval.week => EventOftenModel.weekDays(
        days: schema.weekDays.map((e) => e.index).toList(),
      ),
      EbrSchemaInterval.month => EventOftenModel.month(),
      EbrSchemaInterval.year => throw UnimplementedError(),
      EbrSchemaInterval.$unknown => throw UnimplementedError(),
    };
  }
}

    bad => 'assets/icons/patient_status/bad.svg',
    veryBad => 'assets/icons/patient_status/very_bad.svg',
    offline => 'assets/icons/patient_status/offline.svg',
  };

  String get title => switch (this) {
    good => t.strings.goodPatientStatus,
    bad => t.strings.badPatientStatus,
    veryBad => t.strings.veryBadPatientStatus,
    offline => t.strings.offlinePatientStatus,
  };

final class ClientsRepository {

  final api_client.MedcardClient _medcardClient;

  ClientsRepository(this._relativeClient, this._medcardClient);

  Future<GetClientsListResponse> getWards([int? relativeId]) async {
    try {
      final response = await _relativeClient
          .relativeControllerRelativeGetConnectionsRelativeApiV1RelativeGetConnectionsRelativeGet(
            clientId: relativeId,
          );

      final data = response.patients
          .map((e) => ClientModel.fromSchema(e.client))
          .toList();

      return GetClientsListResponse.success(data: data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return GetClientsListResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return GetClientsListResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<ContactsResponse> getPatientContacts([int? patientId]) async {
    try {
      final response = await _medcardClient
          .medcardControllerMedcardContactsApiV1MedcardContactsGet(
            clientId: patientId,
          );

      final relatives = response.relatives
          .map((e) => ClientModel.fromSchema(e))
          .toList();

      return ContactsResponse.success(
        relatives: relatives,
        experts: [
          if (response.expert != null) ClientModel.fromSchema(response.expert!),
        ],
        clinic: response.clinic?.name,
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return ContactsResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.response?.toString(),
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return ContactsResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/common/discipline/repository.dart ===
import 'package:pn_api_client/event_stat/event_stat_client.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/models/group_by.dart';

import '../../../../apps/patient/navigation/path_params/discipline.dart';
import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'response.dart';

class DisciplineRepository {
  final EventStatClient _eventStatClient;

  DisciplineRepository(this._eventStatClient);

  Future<GetDisciplineResponse> getDiscipline({
    DateTime? date,
    int? userId,
    DisciplineGroupType groupType = DisciplineGroupType.week,
  }) async {
    try {
      final endValue = (date ?? DateTime.now()).roundToDayEnd();

      final beginValue = endValue.subtract(
        Duration(
          // -1 потому что сегодняшний день тоже считается
          days: switch (groupType) {
            DisciplineGroupType.week => 7 - 1,
            DisciplineGroupType.month => 30 - 1,
            DisciplineGroupType.year => 365 - 1,
          },
        ),
      );

      final response = await _eventStatClient
          .eventControllerDisciplineViewApiV1EventDisciplineGet(
            begin: beginValue,
            end: endValue,
            clientId: userId,
            groupBy: switch (groupType) {
              DisciplineGroupType.week => GroupBy.week,
              DisciplineGroupType.month => GroupBy.month,
              DisciplineGroupType.year => GroupBy.year,
            },
          );

      return GetDisciplineResponse.success(
        doneCount: response.total.done,
        lateCount: response.total.lateValue,
        skippedCount: response.total.notDone,
        passReasons:
            response.reasons?.map((e) => (e.reason, e.count)).toList() ?? [],
        bestDate: response.subgroups.extreme.best,
        worstDate: response.subgroups.extreme.worst,
        groups: response.subgroups.groups.map((e) {
          final total = e.done + e.lateValue + e.notDone;

          if (total <= 0) {
            return (e.period, [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]);
          }

          return (
            e.period,
            [e.done / total, e.lateValue / total, e.notDone / total],
          );
        }).toList(),
        notEnoughData:
            response.subgroups.extreme.best == null ||
            response.subgroups.extreme.worst == null,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      return GetDisciplineResponse.error(error: e.toString());
    }
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/common/event/repository.dart ===
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../../../../utils/debug_print.dart';
import '../../../../utils/error.dart';
import '../../../api/v1/service/event.dart';
import '../../../models/event/data/drug_info/model.dart';
import '../../../models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../models/event/often.dart';
import '../../../models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../models/eventbase/model.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/repositories/common/event/repository.freezed.dart';
part 'response.dart';

class EventRepository {
  final EventServiceV1 _eventService;
  final api_client.EventClient _eventClient;
  final api_client.EbClient _ebClient;

  EventRepository(this._eventService, this._eventClient, this._ebClient);

  Future<EventResponse> getEvent({required int eventId}) async {
    try {
      final response = await _eventClient.eventControllerEventViewApiV1EventGetGet(
        eventId: eventId,
      );

      final event = response.events.first;

      return EventResponse.success(event: EventModel.fromSchema(event));
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return EventResponse.error(message: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return EventResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<ToggleResponse> toggleEvent({
    required int eventId,
    bool done = true,
  }) async {
    try {
      final _ = await _eventClient.eventControllerEventMarkApiV1EventUpdatePut(
        body: api_client.EventMarkSchema(
          id: eventId,
          done: done,
          tz: PNApiTimeZoneDurationFormatter(DateTime.now().timeZoneOffset),
        ),
      );

      return ToggleResponse.success();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return ToggleResponse.error(message: message ?? t.strings.serverError);
    } catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return ToggleResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<AddEventResponse> addEvent({
    required String name,
    String? description,
    required EventType eventType,
    required DateTime beginDate,
    required DateTime endDate,
    required EventOftenModel often,
    required List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays,

    MedicineInfoModel? drugInfo,
  }) async {
    try {
      final Map<String, dynamic> requestBody = {
        'name': name,
        'description': description,
        'event_type': eventType.apiName,
        'start': PNApiDateFormatter(beginDate),
        'end': PNApiDateFormatter(endDate),
        'times': timeOfDays
            .map((e) => PNApiTimeFormatter(e))
            .toList(growable: false),
        'day_times': often.map(
          day: (_) => 0,
          month: (_) => null,
          xDays: (xDays) => xDays.days,
          weekDays: (_) => null,
        ),
        'week_days': often.map(
          day: (_) => null,
          month: (_) => null,
          xDays: (_) => null,
          weekDays: (weekDays) => weekDays.days,
        ),
        'interval': often.map(
          day: (_) => 'day',
          month: (_) => 'month',
          xDays: (_) => 'day',
          weekDays: (_) => 'week',
        ),
        'data': {
          if (eventType == EventType.drug) 'drug_info': drugInfo?.toJson(),
        },
      };
      requestBody.removeWhere((key, value) => value == null);

      await _eventService.addEvent(body: requestBody);
      return AddEventResponse.success();
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return AddEventResponse.error(message: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return AddEventResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<AddEventResponse> addEventByBaseEvent({
    required EventBaseModel eventBase,
    required DateTime beginDate,
    required DateTime endDate,
    required EventOftenModel often,
    required List<TimeOfDay> timeOfDays,

    MedicineInfoModel? drugInfo,
  }) async {
    try {
      final _ = await _eventClient.eventControllerEventAddApiV1EventAddPost(
        body: api_client.EventInpSchema(
          ebId: eventBase.id,
          start: beginDate,
          end: endDate,
          interval: often.map(
            day: (_) => api_client.EventInpSchemaInterval.day,
            month: (_) => api_client.EventInpSchemaInterval.month,
            xDays: (_) => api_client.EventInpSchemaInterval.day,
            weekDays: (_) => api_client.EventInpSchemaInterval.week,
          ),
          times: timeOfDays
              .map((e) => PNApiTimeFormatter(e))
              .toList(growable: false),
          dayTimes: often.map(
            day: (_) => 0,
            month: (_) => null,
            xDays: (xDays) => xDays.days,
            weekDays: (_) => null,
          ),
          weekDays: often.map(
            day: (_) => [],
            month: (_) => [],
            xDays: (_) => [],
            weekDays: (weekDays) => weekDays.days
                .map((e) => api_client.EventInpSchemaWeekDays.fromJson(e))
                .toList(),
          ),
        ),
      );

      return AddEventResponse.success();
    } catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return AddEventResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<EventBaseListResponse> getEventBaseList() async {
    try {
      final response = await _ebClient.eventControllerEbViewApiV1EventEbGetGet();

      final eventBaseList = response.ebs
          .map((e) => EventBaseModel.fromSchema(e))
          .toList();

      return EventBaseListResponse.success(eventBaseList: eventBaseList);
    } catch (e) {
      return EventBaseListResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../models/eventbase/model.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/repositories/common/eventbase/repository.freezed.dart';
part 'response.dart';

final class EventBaseRepository {
  final api_client.EbClient _ebClient;

  EventBaseRepository(this._ebClient);

  Future<EventBaseListResponse> getEventBaseList() async {
    try {
      final response = await _ebClient.eventControllerEbViewApiV1EventEbGetGet();

      final eventBaseList = response.ebs
          .map((e) => EventBaseModel.fromSchema(e))
          .toList();

      return EventBaseListResponse.success(data: eventBaseList);
    } on Exception catch (_) {
      return EventBaseListResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../utils/debug_print.dart';
import '../../../models/eventbase_instance/model.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/repositories/common/eventbase_instance/repository.freezed.dart';
part 'response.dart';

final class EventBaseInstanceRepository {
  final api_client.EbrClient _ebrClient;

  EventBaseInstanceRepository(this._ebrClient);

  Future<EventBaseInstanceListResponse> getEventBaseInstanceList({
    bool withData = false,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await _ebrClient.eventControllerEbrViewApiV1EventEbrGetGet(
        withData: withData,
      );

      final eventBaseList = response.ebrs
          .map((e) => EventBaseInstanceModel.fromSchema(e))
          .toList();

      return EventBaseInstanceListResponse.success(data: eventBaseList);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return EventBaseInstanceListResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return EventBaseInstanceListResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
      );
    }
  }

  Future<EventBaseInstanceRemoveResponse> deleteEventBaseInstance(
    List<int> ids,
  ) async {
    try {
      final _ = await _ebrClient.eventControllerEbrDeleteApiV1EventEbrDeleteDelete(
        ebrIds: ids.join(","),
      );

      return EventBaseInstanceRemoveResponse.success();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return EventBaseInstanceRemoveResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return EventBaseInstanceRemoveResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
      );
    }
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/common/events/repository.dart ===
import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../../../../utils/debug_print.dart';
import '../../../models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../models/event/type.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/repositories/common/events/repository.freezed.dart';
part 'response.dart';

class EventsRepository {
  final api_client.EventClient _eventClient;

  EventsRepository(this._eventClient);

  Future<EventsResponse> getEvents({
    required DateTime begin,
    required DateTime end,
    List<EventType> eventTypes = EventType.values,

    bool withData = false,

    bool withSource = false,
    bool withResult = false,
    int? userId,
  }) async {
    try {
      begin = begin.roundToDayStart();
      end = end.roundToDayEnd();

      final response = await _eventClient.eventControllerEventViewApiV1EventGetGet(
        begin: begin,
        end: end,
        clientId: userId,
        eventTypes: eventTypes.map((e) => e.apiValue).toList(),
        withData: withData,
        withSource: withSource,
        withResult: withResult,
      );

      final days = List<DateTime>.generate(
        end.difference(begin).inDays,
        (index) => begin.add(Duration(days: index)),
      );

      return EventsResponse.success(
        data: Map<DateTime, List<EventModel>>.fromIterable(
          days,
          value: (key) => response.events
              .where((e) => e.dt.isSameDay(key))
              .map((e) => EventModel.fromSchema(e))
              .toList(),
        ),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return EventsResponse.error(message: message ?? t.strings.serverError);
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return EventsResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<EventsDayResponse> getDayEvents({
    required DateTime date,
    List<EventType> eventTypes = EventType.values,

    bool withData = false,

    bool withSource = false,
    bool withResult = false,
    int? userId,
  }) async {
    try {
      final begin = date.roundToDayStart();
      final end = date.roundToDayEnd();

      final response = await _eventClient.eventControllerEventViewApiV1EventGetGet(
        begin: begin,
        end: end,
        clientId: userId,
        eventTypes: eventTypes.map((e) => e.apiValue).toList(),
        withData: withData,
        withSource: withSource,
        withResult: withResult,
      );

      return EventsDayResponse.success(
        data: response.events.map((e) => EventModel.fromSchema(e)).toList(),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return EventsDayResponse.error(message: message ?? t.strings.serverError);
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return EventsDayResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }
}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../utils/debug_print.dart';
import '../../../models/eventbase_instance/model.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/repositories/common/medcard/repository.freezed.dart';
part 'response.dart';

final class MedcardRepository {
  final api_client.MedcardClient _medcardClient;

  MedcardRepository(this._medcardClient);

  Future<TreatmentPlanResponse> getTreatmentPlan([int? relativeId]) async {
    try {
      final response = await _medcardClient
          .medcardControllerMedcardPlanApiV1MedcardPlanGet(
            clientId: relativeId,
          );

      final data = response.periods
          .map(
            (e) => (
              e.startDate,
              e.endDate,
              e.ebrs
                      ?.map((e) => EventBaseInstanceModel.fromSchema(e))
                      .toList() ??
                  [],
            ),
          )
          .toList();

      return TreatmentPlanResponse.success(data: data);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return TreatmentPlanResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.response?.toString(),
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return TreatmentPlanResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }
}

import '../../../../utils/debug_print.dart';
import '../../../models/notification/model.dart';
import '../../../models/notification/type.dart';
import 'repository.dart';

final class MockNotificationsRepository extends NotificationsRepository {
  MockNotificationsRepository(
    super._messagingService,
    super._deviceNameService,
    super.notificationClient,
  );

  @override
  Future<NotificationsPageResponse> getNotificationPage([int page = 0]) async {
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 600));

    if (page > 2) {
      return NotificationsPageResponse.success(data: []);
    }

    final mockNotifications = List.generate(10, (index) {
      final notificationIndex = (page * 10) + index + 1;
      return NotificationModel(
        id: notificationIndex,
        type: NotificationType.push,
        title: 'Уведомление $notificationIndex',
        body:
            'Это тестовое уведомление номер $notificationIndex. Здесь находится основной текст уведомления.',
        date: DateTime.now().subtract(Duration(days: notificationIndex * 10)),
        read: notificationIndex > 7,
      );
    });

    return NotificationsPageResponse.success(data: mockNotifications);
  }

  @override
  Future<MarkAsReadResponse> markAsRead(List<int> notificationIds) async {
    pnDebugPrint("Read notifications: ${notificationIds.join(", ")}");
    return MarkAsReadResponse.success();
  }
}

import 'package:dio/dio.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';
import 'package:pn_api_client/export.dart' as api_client;
import 'package:string_capitalize/string_capitalize.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../../../../utils/debug_print.dart';
import '../../../models/device/model.dart';
import '../../../models/notification/model.dart';
import '../../../service/device_name.dart';
import '../../../service/messaging.dart';
import '../../../settings.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/core/repositories/common/notifications/repository.freezed.dart';
part 'response.dart';

class NotificationsRepository {
  final MessagingService _messagingService;
  final DeviceNameService _deviceNameService;
  final api_client.NotificationClient _notificationClient;

  String? _token;

  NotificationsRepository(
    this._messagingService,
    this._deviceNameService,
    this._notificationClient,
  );
  String? getToken() => _token;

  Future<void> registerDevice({bool initService = false}) async {
    try {
      if (initService) {
        await _messagingService.init();
      }

      final token = await _messagingService.getToken();
      final deviceName = await _deviceNameService.getDeviceName();

      if (token == null) {
        return;
      }

      await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerRegisterApiV1NotificationRegisterPost(
            body: api_client.NotificationRegisterSchema(
              token: token,
              name: deviceName,
            ),
          );
      _token = token;
    } catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
    }
  }

  Future<NotificationsPageResponse> getNotificationPage([int page = 0]) async {
    try {
      final response = await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerNotificationViewApiV1NotificationGetGet(
            page: page,
            quantity: AppSettings.pageQuantity,
          );

      final notifications = response.result
          .map((e) => NotificationModel.fromSchema(e))
          .toList();

      return NotificationsPageResponse.success(data: notifications);
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return NotificationsPageResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return NotificationsPageResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<UnreadNotificationsResponse> getUnreadNotificationsCount() async {
    try {
      final response = await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerNotificationCheckApiV1NotificationCheckGet();

      return UnreadNotificationsResponse.success(
        unreadNotificationsCount: response,
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return UnreadNotificationsResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return UnreadNotificationsResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<MarkAsReadResponse> markAsRead(List<int> notificationIds) async {
    try {
      final _ = await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerMarkAsReadApiV1NotificationMarkAsReadPost(
            notificationIds: notificationIds.join(","),
          );

      return MarkAsReadResponse.success();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return MarkAsReadResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return MarkAsReadResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<SendTestNotificationResponse> sendTestNotification() async {
    try {
      final _ = await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerSendApiV1NotificationSendPost(
            titleSrc: t.strings.testNotificationTitle.capitalize(),
            bodySrc: t.strings.testNotificationBody(
              date: PNDateFormatter(
                DateTime.now(),
                format: "dd MMMM yyyy HH:mm",
              ).capitalize(),
            ),
          );

      return SendTestNotificationResponse.success();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return SendTestNotificationResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.response?.toString(),
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return SendTestNotificationResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<SendTestNotificationResponse> changePushNotification(
    int deviceId,
    String token,
    bool newStatus,
  ) async {
    try {
      final _ = await (newStatus
          ? _notificationClient
                .notificationControllerRegisterApiV1NotificationRegisterPost(
                  body: api_client.NotificationRegisterSchema(token: token),
                )
          : _notificationClient
                .notificationControllerTokenDeleteApiV1NotificationTokenDelete(
                  tokenId: deviceId,
                ));

      return SendTestNotificationResponse.success();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return SendTestNotificationResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.response?.toString(),
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return SendTestNotificationResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<NotificationDevicesResponse> getDevices() async {
    try {
      final response = await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerTokenGetApiV1NotificationTokenGet();

      return NotificationDevicesResponse.success(
        data: response.result.map((e) => DeviceModel.fromSchema(e)).toList(),
      );
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return NotificationDevicesResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.response?.toString(),
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return NotificationDevicesResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<DeleteDeviceResponse> deleteDevices(int deviceId) async {
    try {
      final _ = await _notificationClient
          .notificationControllerTokenDeleteApiV1NotificationTokenDelete(
            tokenId: deviceId,
          );

      return DeleteDeviceResponse.success();
    } on DioException catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      final message = e.response?.data["detail"];
      return DeleteDeviceResponse.error(
        message: message ?? t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.response?.toString(),
      );
    } on Exception catch (e) {
      pnDebugPrint(e.toString());
      return DeleteDeviceResponse.error(
        message: t.strings.serverError,
        errorValue: e.toString(),
      );
    }
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/common/overview/mock.dart ===
import 'dart:math';

import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import 'repository.dart';
import 'response.dart';

final class MockPatientOverviewRepository extends PatientOverviewRepository {
  MockPatientOverviewRepository(super.eventStatClient, super.eventClient);

  @override
  Future<DayConditionResponse> getCondition(
    DateTime date, {
    int? patientId,
  }) async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    final random = Random(date.millisecondsSinceEpoch + (patientId ?? 0));

    final weekScores = List.generate(7, (_) => random.nextInt(60) + 40);

    final diff =
        weekScores[weekScores.length - 1] - weekScores[weekScores.length - 2];

    return DayConditionResponse.success(
      score: weekScores.last,
      comparePercents: ((diff / weekScores[weekScores.length - 1]) * 100)
          .toInt(),
      weekScores: weekScores,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<DayDisciplineResponse> getDiscipline(
    DateTime date, {
    int? patientId,
  }) async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    final random = Random(date.millisecondsSinceEpoch + (patientId ?? 0));

    final weekScores = List.generate(7, (_) => random.nextDouble());

    return DayDisciplineResponse.success(
      score: weekScores.last,

      weekScores: weekScores,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<StimulatorChargeResponse> getStimulatorCharge(
    DateTime date, {
    int? patientId,
  }) async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    final random = Random(patientId ?? 0);

    return StimulatorChargeResponse.success(
      chargePercent: random.nextInt(80) + 20,
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/common/registration/repository.dart ===
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import '../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../utils/error.dart';
import '../../../api/v1/service/auth.dart';
import '../../../models/user/gender.dart';
import '../../../models/user/type.dart';
import 'response.dart';

final class RegistrationRepository {
  final AuthServiceV1 _authService;

  RegistrationRepository(this._authService);

  Future<EmailTakenResponse> isEmailTaken(String email) async {
    try {
      // ignore: unused_local_variable
      final response = await _authService.isEmailTaken(email);

      return EmailTakenResponse.emailTaken();
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      if (e.code == 404) {
        return EmailTakenResponse.emailFree();
      }

      return EmailTakenResponse.error(error: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      return EmailTakenResponse.error(error: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<EmailCodeCheckResponse> checkCode(
    String email,
    String code, [
    bool onlyCodeCheck = true,
  ]) async {
    try {
      // ignore: unused_local_variable
      final response = await (onlyCodeCheck
          ? _authService.checkCode(email: email, code: code)
          : _authService.verifyEmail(email: email, code: code, verify: true));

      return EmailCodeCheckResponse.success();
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      return EmailCodeCheckResponse.error(error: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      return EmailCodeCheckResponse.error(error: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<ResendEmaCodeResponse> resendCode(String email) async {
    try {
      // ignore: unused_local_variable
      final response = await _authService.sendCode(email: email);

      return ResendEmaCodeResponse.success();
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      return ResendEmaCodeResponse.error(error: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      return ResendEmaCodeResponse.error(error: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<RegistrationResponse> register({
    required String lastName,
    required String firstName,
    required String email,
    required String password,
    required int cityId,
    String? additionalName,
    String? phone,
    UserGender? gender,
    DateTime? birthDate,
  }) async {
    try {
      final response = await _authService.register(
        firstName,
        lastName,
        email,
        password,
        cityId,
        anotherName: additionalName,
        phone: phone,
        gender: gender?.toString(),
        birthdate: birthDate != null
            ? DateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").format(birthDate)
            : null,
      );

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response.body);

      return RegistrationResponse.success(
        token: data['token'],
        refreshToken: data['rt_token'],
        userType: UserType.fromString(data['role']),
      );
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      return RegistrationResponse.error(error: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      return RegistrationResponse.error(error: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/common/token/repository.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../logger/event.dart';
import '../../../../logger/logger.dart';
import '../../../api/v1/service/auth.dart';
import '../../../models/user/type.dart';
import '../../../storage/token.dart';

final class TokenRepository {
  final AuthServiceV1 _authService;
  final TokenStorage _tokenStorage;

  String? _token;
  String? _refreshToken;
  UserType? _userType;

  bool haveSuccessRefresh = false;
  bool triedToRestoreToken = false;

  TokenRepository(this._authService, this._tokenStorage);

  String? getToken() => _token;

  bool haveValidToken() => _token != null;

  UserType? get currentUserType => _userType;

  bool canAccessRelativeApp() =>
      _userType == UserType.relative || _userType == UserType.moderator;

  bool canAccessDoctorApp() =>
      _userType == UserType.expert ||
      _userType == UserType.administrator ||
      _userType == UserType.moderator;

  bool canAccessPatientApp() =>
      _userType == UserType.patient ||
      _userType == UserType.relative ||
      _userType == UserType.administrator ||
      _userType == UserType.moderator;

  Future<void> updateTokens(String token, String refreshToken) async {
    _token = token;
    _refreshToken = refreshToken;

    _updateTokenStorage();
  }

  Future<void> updateUserType(UserType userType) async {
    _userType = userType;
  }

  Future<void> logout() async {
    _token = null;
    _refreshToken = null;
    _deleteToken();
  }

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    if (haveSuccessRefresh) {
      return;
    }

    if (!triedToRestoreToken) {
      await _restoreToken();
      triedToRestoreToken = true;
    }

    if (_refreshToken == null) {
      _token = null;
      return;
    }

    try {
      final response = await _authService.refresh(_refreshToken!);

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response.body);

      _token = data['token'];
      _refreshToken = data['rt_token'];
      _userType = UserType.fromString(data["role"]);

      haveSuccessRefresh = true;

      _updateTokenStorage();
    } catch (e) {
      _token = null;
      _refreshToken = null;
    }
  }

  Future<void> forceRefresh(VoidCallback onFailedRefresh) async {
    await _restoreToken();

    try {
      final response = await _authService.refresh(_refreshToken!);

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response.body);

      _token = data['token'];
      _refreshToken = data['rt_token'];

      _updateTokenStorage();
    } catch (e) {
      _token = null;
      _refreshToken = null;

      onFailedRefresh();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _updateTokenStorage() async {
    if (_token != null) {
      _tokenStorage.token.saveToken(_token!);
    }
    if (_refreshToken != null) {
      _tokenStorage.refreshToken.saveToken(_refreshToken!);
    }
    PNLogger.repository(
      LoggerEvent("Update token", {
        "token": _token,
        "refreshToken": _refreshToken,
      }),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _restoreToken() async {
    _token = await _tokenStorage.token.getToken();
    _refreshToken = await _tokenStorage.refreshToken.getToken();

    PNLogger.repository(
      LoggerEvent("Restore token", {
        "token": _token,
        "refreshToken": _refreshToken,
      }),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _deleteToken() async {
    _tokenStorage.token.deleteToken();
    _tokenStorage.refreshToken.deleteToken();
  }
}

=== FILE: core/repositories/doctor/patients/mock.dart ===
import 'dart:math';

import 'package:faker/faker.dart';

import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../../../../utils/list.dart';
import '../../../models/patient/model.dart';
import '../../../models/patient/status.dart';
import '../../../settings.dart';
import 'repository.dart';
import 'response.dart';

final class MockPatientsRepository extends PatientsRepository {
  @override
  Future<PatientsCountResponse> getPatientsCount(DateTime date) async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));

    date = date.roundToDayStart();

    final random = Random(date.millisecondsSinceEpoch);

    final totalCount = 75;

    final goodPatients = random.nextInt(50);

    final badPatients = random.nextInt(totalCount - goodPatients);

    final veryBadPatients = random.nextInt(
      totalCount - goodPatients - badPatients,
    );

    final offlinePatients =
        totalCount - goodPatients - badPatients - veryBadPatients;

    return PatientsCountResponse.success(
      totalCount: totalCount,
      goodPatients: goodPatients,
      badPatients: badPatients,
      veryBadPatients: veryBadPatients,
      offlinePatients: offlinePatients,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<WaitingsChatsCountResponse> getWaitingChatsCount() async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));

    return WaitingsChatsCountResponse.success(waitingChatsCount: 3);
  }

  @override
  Future<OnlineConsultationCountResponse> getOnlineConsultationCount() async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));

    return OnlineConsultationCountResponse.success(
      totalConsultations: 2,
      waitingDistribution: 2,
      planned: 12,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<PatientsResponse> getPatients(int page, {String? searchQuery}) async {
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));

    page = page - 1;
    page = page.clamp(0, 100);

    final faker = Faker.withGenerator(RandomGenerator(seed: 42));

    final patients = List.generate(
      75,
      (index) => PatientModel(
        id: index.toString(),
        firstName: faker.person.firstName(),
        lastName: faker.person.lastName(),
        middleName: faker.person.lastName(),
        status:
            PatientStatus.values[faker.randomGenerator.integer(
              PatientStatus.values.length - 1,
            )],
      ),
    );

    final filterPatients = patients.where((patient) {
      if (searchQuery == null) {
        return true;
      }

      final search = searchQuery.toLowerCase();

      return patient.firstName.toLowerCase().contains(search) ||
          patient.lastName.toLowerCase().contains(search) ||
          patient.middleName.toLowerCase().contains(search);
    }).toList();

    final isLastPage =
        page >= filterPatients.length ~/ AppSettings.pageQuantity;

    final pages = filterPatients.splitByPage(AppSettings.pageQuantity);
    final pagePatients = page >= 0 && page < pages.length
        ? pages[page]
        : <PatientModel>[];

    return PatientsResponse.success(
      patients: pagePatients,
      isLastPage: isLastPage,
    );
  }
}

final class AIRepository {
  final EventServiceV1 _eventServiceV1;
  final AIServiceV1 _aiServiceV1;

  AIRepository(this._eventServiceV1, this._aiServiceV1);

  Future<AIGetUploadLinkResponse> getUploadLink(
    int id,
    String fileExtension,
    Duration timeConsume,
  ) async {
    try {
      final response = await _eventServiceV1.toggleEvent(
        body: {
          'id': id,
          // "done": false,
          "data": {
            "ai_info": {
              "extension": fileExtension,
              "time_consumed": timeConsume.inMilliseconds,
            },
          },
          "tz": PNApiTimeZoneDurationFormatter(DateTime.now().timeZoneOffset),
        },
      );

      final data = Map<String, dynamic>.from(response.body);
      return AIGetUploadLinkResponse.success(
        urlLink: data['ai_info']['url'] as String,
        guid: data['ai_info']['guid'] as String,
      );
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      return AIGetUploadLinkResponse.error(message: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      return AIGetUploadLinkResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }

  Future<AIToggleTaskResponse> toggleAITask(String guid) async {
    try {
      final _ = await _aiServiceV1.initOrder(
        body: {
          "guid": guid,
          "tz": PNApiTimeZoneDurationFormatter(DateTime.now().timeZoneOffset),
        },
      );

      return AIToggleTaskResponse.success();
    } on PNException catch (e) {
      return AIToggleTaskResponse.error(message: e.message);
    } catch (e) {
      return AIToggleTaskResponse.error(message: t.strings.serverError);
    }
  }
}
