class _Loaded extends HookWidget {
  final int currentDeviceId;
  final String token;
  final bool notificationsReceive;

  final Future<void> Function(
    int currentDeviceId,
    String token,
    bool currentStatus,
  )?
  changePush;
  final Future<void> Function()? sendTestNotification;

  const _Loaded({
    this.currentDeviceId = -1,
    this.token = "",
    this.notificationsReceive = false,
    this.changePush,
    this.sendTestNotification,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final pushChanging = useState<bool>(false);

    final testNotificationSending = useState<bool>(false);

    return SettingsSectionWidget(
      items: [
        SettingsItem.toggle(
          title: strings.receiveNotifications,
          value: notificationsReceive,
          isEnable: true,
          isLoading: pushChanging.value,
          onChanged: (bool value) async {
            pushChanging.value = true;

            await changePush?.call(
              currentDeviceId,
              token,
              notificationsReceive,
            );

            pushChanging.value = false;
          },
        ),
        if (AppSettings.mode.isDev)
          SettingsItem.button(
            title: strings.sendTestNotification,
            isEnable: !testNotificationSending.value,
            onTap: () async {
              testNotificationSending.value = true;

              await sendTestNotification?.call();

              testNotificationSending.value = false;
            },

            icon: Icons.notification_add_outlined,
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _TodayScore extends StatelessWidget {
  final int score;
  final int comparePercents;

  const _TodayScore({required this.score, required this.comparePercents});

  Color _scoreColor(BuildContext context) =>
      switch (comparePercents.compareTo(0)) {
        1 => context.pNTheme.goodColor,
        -1 => context.pNTheme.badColor,
        0 => context.pNTheme.neutralColor,
        _ => context.pNTheme.neutralColor,
      };

  IconData get _scoreIcon => switch (comparePercents.compareTo(0)) {
    1 => Icons.arrow_upward,
    -1 => Icons.arrow_downward,
    0 => Icons.minimize,
    _ => Icons.minimize,
  };

  String _compareText(BuildContext context) => switch (comparePercents
      .compareTo(0)) {
    1 => context.t.strings.betterThenYesterday(percent: comparePercents.abs()),
    -1 => context.t.strings.worseThenYesterday(percent: comparePercents.abs()),
    0 => context.t.strings.noChanges,
    _ => context.t.strings.noChanges,
  };

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(40)),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          AutoSizeText(
            score.toString(),
            style: PNTextStyle(
              fontSize: context.au(46),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              color: _scoreColor(context),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox.square(
            dimension: context.au(40),
            child: Icon(
              _scoreIcon,
              size: context.au(25),
              color: _scoreColor(context),
            ),
          ),
          AutoSizeText(
            _compareText(context),
            maxLines: 2,
            style: PNTextStyle(
              fontSize: context.au(16),
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
              height: 18 / 16,
              color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

part of '../widget.dart';

class _WeekChart extends StatelessWidget {
  final List<int> weekScores;

  const _WeekChart({required this.weekScores});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(54)),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: List.generate(
                weekScores.length,
                (index) => PNText(
                  weekScores[index].toString(),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.left,
                  fontWeight: index == weekScores.length - 1
                      ? FontWeight.w600
                      : FontWeight.w300,
                  fontSize: context.au(13),
                  color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          Container(
            height: context.au(16),
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16),
            child: CustomPaint(
              painter: _LineChartPainter(
                dataPoints: weekScores,
                lineColor: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                lineWidth: context.au(1),
                pointRadius: context.au(4),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _LineChartPainter extends CustomPainter {
  final List<int> dataPoints;
  final double pointRadius;
  final double lineWidth;
  final Color lineColor;

  _LineChartPainter({
    required this.dataPoints,
    required this.lineColor,
    this.lineWidth = 1.0,
    this.pointRadius = 4.0,
  });

  @override
  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
    final Paint linePaint = Paint()
      ..color = lineColor
      ..strokeWidth = lineWidth
      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke;

    final Paint pointPaint = Paint()..style = PaintingStyle.fill;

    final double spacing = size.width / (dataPoints.length - 1);
    final double maxValue = dataPoints.max.toDouble();
    final double minValue = dataPoints.min.toDouble();
    final double verticalScale = (maxValue - minValue) == 0
        ? 1
        : size.height / (maxValue - minValue);

    List<Offset> points = [];

    for (int i = 0; i < dataPoints.length; i++) {
      double x = i * spacing;
      double y = size.height - (dataPoints[i] - minValue) * verticalScale;
      points.add(Offset(x, y));
    }

    // Draw the line
    for (int i = 0; i < points.length - 1; i++) {
      canvas.drawLine(points[i], points[i + 1], linePaint);
    }

    // Draw the points
    for (int i = 0; i < points.length; i++) {
      pointPaint.color = _getPointColor(dataPoints[i]);
      canvas.drawCircle(points[i], pointRadius, pointPaint);
    }
  }

  Color _getPointColor(int value) {
    if (value < 65) return PNCommonColors.badColor;
    if (value < 75) return PNCommonColors.neutralColor;
    return PNCommonColors.goodColor;
  }

  @override
  bool shouldRepaint(CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
}

=== FILE: features/patient/day_events/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/repository.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/patient/events/response.dart';
import '../../../../utils/date.dart';
import '../../../ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/features/patient/day_events/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class PatientDayEventsBloc extends Cubit<PatientDayEventsState> {
  final PatientEventsRepository _eventsRepository;

  PatientDayEventsBloc(this._eventsRepository)
    : super(const PatientDayEventsState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh([int? patineId]) async {
    emit(const PatientDayEventsState.loading());

    final response = await _eventsRepository.getDayEvents(
      DateTime.now().roundToDayStart(),
      forceNoCache: true,
      userId: patineId,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final events = data.events;

        final totalEvents = events.length;
        final completedEvents = events.where((e) => e.done).length;

        final mandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory)
            .length;

        final completedMandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory && e.done)
            .length;

        final optionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional)
            .length;

        final completedOptionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional && e.done)
            .length;

        final filteredOptionalEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.optional && !e.done)
            .toList();

        final filteredMandatoryEvents = events
            .where((e) => e.taskType == TaskType.mandatory && !e.done)
            .toList();

        final eventForPreview =
            filteredMandatoryEvents + filteredOptionalEvents;

        emit(
          PatientDayEventsState.loaded(
            totalEvents: totalEvents,
            completedEvents: completedEvents,
            totalMandatoryEvents: mandatoryEvents,
            completedMandatoryEvents: completedMandatoryEvents,
            totalOptionalEvents: optionalEvents,
            completedOptionalEvents: completedOptionalEvents,
            previewEvents: eventForPreview.take(3).toList(),
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(PatientDayEventsState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> update(EventModel event, bool newStatus) async {
    if (state is! _Loaded) return;

    final data = (state as _Loaded);

    final newCompletedEvents =
        data.completedEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => 1,
          false => -1,
        };

    final newCompletedMandatoryEvents =
        data.completedMandatoryEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => event.taskType == TaskType.mandatory ? 1 : 0,
          false => event.taskType == TaskType.mandatory ? -1 : 0,
        };

    final newCompletedOptionalEvents =
        data.completedOptionalEvents +
        switch (newStatus) {
          true => event.taskType == TaskType.optional ? 1 : 0,
          false => event.taskType == TaskType.optional ? -1 : 0,
        };

    final events = data.previewEvents;

    final updateEvents = events
        .map((e) => e.id == event.id ? event.copyWith(done: newStatus) : e)
        .toList();

    emit(
      PatientDayEventsState.loaded(
        totalEvents: data.totalEvents,
        completedEvents: newCompletedEvents,
        totalMandatoryEvents: data.totalMandatoryEvents,
        completedMandatoryEvents: newCompletedMandatoryEvents,
        totalOptionalEvents: data.totalOptionalEvents,
        completedOptionalEvents: newCompletedOptionalEvents,
        previewEvents: updateEvents,
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  final void Function(int id)? onEventTap;

  final int completedEvents;
  final int totalEvents;
  final int completedMandatoryEvents;
  final int totalMandatoryEvents;
  final int completedOptionalEvents;
  final int totalOptionalEvents;

  final List<EventModel> previewEvents;

  const _Loaded({
    required this.borderRadius,
    this.onTap,
    this.onEventTap,

class _EventsCounter extends StatelessWidget {
  final int completedEvents;
  final int totalEvents;
  final int completedMandatoryEvents;
  final int totalMandatoryEvents;
  final int completedOptionalEvents;
  final int totalOptionalEvents;

  const _EventsCounter({
    required this.completedEvents,
    required this.totalEvents,
    required this.completedMandatoryEvents,
    required this.totalMandatoryEvents,
    required this.completedOptionalEvents,
    required this.totalOptionalEvents,
  });

  Color _totalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedEvents == totalEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalEvents - completedEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  Color _mandatoryEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedMandatoryEvents == totalMandatoryEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalMandatoryEvents - completedMandatoryEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  Color _optionalEventsColor(BuildContext context) {
    if (completedOptionalEvents == totalOptionalEvents) {
      return context.pNTheme.goodColor;
    }

    if (totalOptionalEvents - completedOptionalEvents <= 4) {
      return context.pNTheme.neutralColor;
    }

    return context.pNTheme.badColor;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final showSummary = completedEvents != 0 || totalEvents != 0;
    final showMandatory =
        completedMandatoryEvents != 0 || totalMandatoryEvents != 0;
    final showOptional =
        completedOptionalEvents != 0 || totalOptionalEvents != 0;

    return Container(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(minHeight: context.au(44)),
      // height: context.au(44),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 12),
            child: AutoSizeText(
              showSummary ? "$completedEvents/$totalEvents" : "-/-",
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: PNTextStyle(
                color: showSummary
                    ? _totalEventsColor(context)
                    : context.pNTheme.primaryText,
                fontSize: context.au(46),
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
              ),
            ),
          ),
          Flexible(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: BoxConstraints(maxWidth: context.au(156)),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: PNText(
                            "${context.t.strings.mandatory}:",

                            fontSize: context.au(14),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        PNText(
                          showMandatory
                              ? "$completedMandatoryEvents/$totalMandatoryEvents"
                              : "-/-",

                          color: showMandatory
                              ? _mandatoryEventsColor(context)
                              : null,
                          fontSize: context.au(14),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: PNText(
                            "${context.t.strings.optional}:",

                            fontSize: context.au(14),

                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        PNText(
                          showOptional
                              ? "$completedOptionalEvents/$totalOptionalEvents"
                              : "-/-",
                          color: showOptional
                              ? _optionalEventsColor(context)
                              : null,
                          fontSize: context.au(14),
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: features/patient/day_medicines/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../core/models/event/data/drug_info/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/data/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/model.dart';
import '../../../../core/models/event/type.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/common/events/repository.dart';
import '../../../ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/features/patient/day_medicines/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class PatientDayMedicinesBloc extends Cubit<PatientDayMedicinesState> {
  final EventsRepository _eventsRepository;

  PatientDayMedicinesBloc(this._eventsRepository)
    : super(PatientDayMedicinesState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh([int? patineId]) async {
    emit(PatientDayMedicinesState.loading());

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final response = await _eventsRepository.getDayEvents(
      date: now,
      eventTypes: [EventType.drug],
      userId: patineId,
      withData: true,
      withSource: true,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(
          PatientDayMedicinesState.loaded(
            totalMedicinesTakeCount: data.data.length,
            anchorTime: TimeOfDay(hour: now.hour, minute: now.minute),
            untakenMedicines: data.data
                .where(
                  (e) =>
                      !e.done &&
                      e.data?.mapOrNull(medicine: (value) => value.data) !=
                          null,
                )
                .map(
                  (e) =>
                      (e, e.data!.mapOrNull(medicine: (value) => value.data)!),
                )
                .toList(),
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.message, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(PatientDayMedicinesState.error(message: data.message));
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> updateMedicineTake(int id, bool value) async {
    if (state is! _Loaded) {
      return;
    }

    final data = (state as _Loaded);

    final medicines = List<(EventModel, MedicineInfoModel)>.from(
      data.untakenMedicines,
    );

    final index = medicines.indexWhere((element) => element.$1.id == id);

    if (index == -1) {
      return;
    }

    final medicine = medicines[index].$1;
    final drugInfo = medicines[index].$2;
    medicines[index] = (medicine.copyWith(done: value), drugInfo);

    emit(
      data.copyWith(
        untakenMedicines: medicines
            .where((element) => !element.$1.done)
            .toList(),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _Time extends StatelessWidget {
  final TimeOfDay time;

  const _Time({required this.time});

  String _timeDescription(BuildContext context) {
    if (time.hour < 7) {
      return context.t.strings.night;
    }

    if (time.hour < 12) {
      return context.t.strings.morning;
    }

    if (time.hour < 18) {
      return context.t.strings.afternoon;
    }

    return context.t.strings.evening;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        PNText(
          '${time.hour}:${time.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')} ${_timeDescription(context)}',
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
          fontSize: context.au(14),
          color: context.pNTheme.secondaryText,
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: features/patient/discipline/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:freezed_annotation/freezed_annotation.dart';

import '../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/repository.dart';
import '../../../../core/repositories/common/discipline/response.dart';
import '../../../ui/snack.dart';

part '../../../../.gen/features/patient/discipline/bloc/bloc.freezed.dart';
part 'state.dart';

class PatientDisciplineBloc extends Cubit<PatientDisciplineState> {
  final DisciplineRepository _disciplineRepository;

  PatientDisciplineBloc(this._disciplineRepository)
    : super(const PatientDisciplineState.loading());

  Future<void> refresh([int? patineId]) async {
    emit(const PatientDisciplineState.loading());

    final response = await _disciplineRepository.getDiscipline(
      userId: patineId,
    );

    response.map(
      success: (data) {
        final total = (data.doneCount + data.lateCount + data.skippedCount)
            .toDouble();

        if (total <= 0) {
          emit(PatientDisciplineState.notEnoughData());
          return;
        }

        final completedPercent = ((data.doneCount / total).clamp(0, 1) * 100)
            .toInt();

        final latePercent = ((data.lateCount / total).clamp(0, 1) * 100)
            .toInt();
        final skippedPercent = ((data.skippedCount / total).clamp(0, 1) * 100)
            .toInt();

        final reminder =
            (100 - (completedPercent + latePercent + skippedPercent));

        emit(
          PatientDisciplineState.loaded(
            stages: [
              (completedPercent + reminder) / 100,
              latePercent / 100,
              skippedPercent / 100,
            ],
            completedPercent: completedPercent + reminder,
            skippedPercent: latePercent + skippedPercent,
            haveSkippedEvents: false,
          ),
        );
      },
      error: (value) {
        PNSnack.show(text: value.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        emit(PatientDisciplineState.error(message: value.error));
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Loaded extends StatelessWidget {
  final BorderRadius borderRadius;
  final VoidCallback? onTap;

  final List<double> stages;
  final int completedPercent;
  final int skippedPercent;
  final bool haveSkippedEvents;

  const _Loaded({
    required this.borderRadius,
    this.onTap,
    this.stages = const [0.5, 0.25, 0.25],
    this.completedPercent = 50,
    this.skippedPercent = 50,
    this.haveSkippedEvents = false,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final t = Translations.of(context);
    final theme = context.pNTheme;

    final style = PNTextStyle(
      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
      fontSize: context.au(16),
      height: 18 / 16,
      color: theme.primaryText,
    );

    return PNContentCardWithBasement(
      title: t.strings.discipline,
      subtitle: t.strings.lastNDays(n: 7),
      onTap: onTap,
      borderRadius: borderRadius,
      content: Column(
        children: [
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          ProgressBar(
            borderRadius: AppUISettings.smallBorderRadius,
            stages: stages,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.smallPaddingValue),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Flexible(
                child: RichText(
                  text: TextSpan(
                    children: [
                      TextSpan(
                        text: "$completedPercent% ",
                        style: style.copyWith(color: theme.goodColor),
                      ),
                      TextSpan(text: t.strings.completed, style: style),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              Flexible(

class PincodeInputWidget extends HookWidget {
  final EdgeInsets contentPadding;

  final EdgeInsets margin;

  const PincodeInputWidget({
    super.key,
    this.contentPadding = AppUISettings.padding,
    this.margin = AppUISettings.padding,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final pin = useState<String>('');
    final isLoading = useState<bool>(false);

    return ScrollLayoutWithBottomButton(
      // contentPadding: contentPadding,
      // margin: margin,
      // primary: false,
      content: Column(
        children: [
          _PinText(
            currentLength: pin.value.length,
            maxLength: 4,
            isLoading: isLoading.value,
          ),
          SizedBox(height: AppUISettings.paddingValue),
          _PinPad(
            onNumberPressed: (int value) {
              pin.value += value.toString();

              if (pin.value.length < 4) return;
              isLoading.value = true;
              Future.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 2), () {
                isLoading.value = false;
                pin.value = '';
              });
            },
            onBackspacePressed: () {
              if (pin.value.isNotEmpty) {
                pin.value = pin.value.substring(0, pin.value.length - 1);
              }
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      buttonText: strings.logout,
      onButtonPressed: () {},
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: features/registration_form/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../core/models/user/gender.dart';
import '../../../core/models/user/type.dart';
import '../../../core/repositories/common/registration/repository.dart';
import '../../../core/repositories/common/registration/response.dart';
import '../../../core/repositories/common/token/repository.dart';

import 'state.dart';

class RegistrationFormBloc extends Cubit<RegistrationFormState> {
  final RegistrationRepository _repository;
  final TokenRepository _tokenRepository;

  RegistrationFormBloc(this._repository, this._tokenRepository)
    : super(RegistrationFormState());

  void reset() {
    emit(RegistrationFormState());
  }

  void updateIsAgreementAccepted(bool isAgreementAccepted) {
    emit(state.copyWith(isAgreementAccepted: isAgreementAccepted));
  }

  void updateLastName(String lastName) {
    emit(state.copyWith(lastName: lastName));
  }

  void updateFirstName(String firstName) {
    emit(state.copyWith(firstName: firstName));
  }

  void updateMiddleName(String? additionalName) {
    emit(state.copyWith(additionalName: additionalName));
  }

  void updatePhone(String? phone) {
    emit(state.copyWith(phone: phone));
  }

  void updateGender(UserGender? gender) {
    emit(state.copyWith(gender: gender));
  }

  void updateCityId(int cityId) {
    emit(state.copyWith(cityId: cityId));
  }

  void updateBirthDate(DateTime? birthDate) {
    emit(state.copyWith(birthDate: birthDate));
  }

  void updateEmail(String email) {
    emit(state.copyWith(email: email));
  }

  void updatePassword(String password) {
    emit(state.copyWith(password: password));
  }

  void updateEmailCode(String emailCode) {
    emit(state.copyWith(emailCode: emailCode));
  }

  Future<(bool, UserType?)> register() async {
    final lastName = state.lastName;
    final firstName = state.firstName;
    final additionalName = state.additionalName;
    final phone = state.phone;
    final gender = state.gender;
    final cityId = state.cityId;
    final birthDate = state.birthDate;
    final email = state.email;
    final password = state.password;
    final emailCode = state.emailCode;

    if (lastName == "" ||
        lastName == null ||
        firstName == "" ||
        firstName == null ||
        email == "" ||
        email == null ||
        password == "" ||
        password == null ||
        emailCode == "" ||
        emailCode == null ||
        cityId == null) {
      return (false, null);
    }

    final response = await _repository.register(
      lastName: lastName,
      firstName: firstName,
      additionalName: additionalName,
      phone: phone,
      gender: gender,
      cityId: cityId,
      birthDate: birthDate,
      email: email,
      password: password,
    );

    if (response.maybeMap(success: (value) => false, orElse: () => true)) {
      return (false, null);
    }

    final verifyResponse = await _repository.checkCode(email, emailCode, false);

    if (verifyResponse.maybeMap(
      success: (value) => false,
      orElse: () => true,
    )) {
      return (false, null);
    }

    final token = response.mapOrNull(
      success: (value) => value.token,
      error: (_) => null,
    );

    final refreshToken = response.mapOrNull(
      success: (value) => value.refreshToken,
      error: (_) => null,
    );

    final userType = response.mapOrNull(
      success: (value) => value.userType,
      error: (_) => null,
    );

    if (token == null || refreshToken == null || userType == null) {
      return (false, null);
    }

    _tokenRepository.updateTokens(token, refreshToken);

    _tokenRepository.updateUserType(userType);

    return (true, userType);
  }
}

=== FILE: features/registration_form/modules/account_data/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';

import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/response.dart';
// import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/response.dart';
import '../../../../ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class AccountDataFormBloc extends Cubit<AccountDataFormState> {
  final RegistrationFormBloc _registrationBloc;
  final RegistrationRepository _registrationRepository;

  AccountDataFormBloc(this._registrationBloc, this._registrationRepository)
    : super(AccountDataFormState.waiting());

  int get emailLength => "1@aa.aa".length;
  int get passwordLength => 8;

  Future<bool> checkAccountData(String email, String password) async {
    emit(AccountDataFormState.loading());

    if (email.isEmpty || email.length < emailLength) {
      emit(AccountDataFormState.error(emailError: t.strings.fillField));
      return false;
    }

    if (password.isEmpty || password.length < passwordLength) {
      emit(
        AccountDataFormState.error(passwordError: t.strings.passwordMinLength),
      );
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _registrationRepository.isEmailTaken(email);

    return response.map(
      emailFree: (data) {
        emit(AccountDataFormState.waiting());
        return true;
      },
      emailTaken: (data) {
        emit(AccountDataFormState.error(emailError: t.strings.emailTaken));
        return false;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(AccountDataFormState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> sendEmailCode(String email, String password) async {
    emit(AccountDataFormState.loading());

    final response = await _registrationRepository.resendCode(email);

    return response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(AccountDataFormState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.codeSendToEmail);
        _registrationBloc.updateEmail(email);
        _registrationBloc.updatePassword(password);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(AccountDataFormState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    emit(AccountDataFormState.waiting());
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
import 'package:hooks_riverpod/hooks_riverpod.dart';

class AccountDataForm extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback nextStep;
  final VoidCallback previousStep;
  final double bottomPadding;

  const AccountDataForm({
    super.key,
    required this.nextStep,
    required this.previousStep,
    required this.bottomPadding,
  });

  @override
  ConsumerState<AccountDataForm> createState() => _AccountDataFormState();
}

class _AccountDataFormState extends ConsumerState<AccountDataForm> {
  final TextEditingController _emailController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _passwordController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(ProviderBloc.registration.actonData);

    return AutofillGroup(
      child: Column(
        children: [
          BlocBuilder<AccountDataFormBloc, AccountDataFormState>(
            bloc: bloc,
            builder: (context, state) => PNTextField(
              controller: _emailController,
              hint: context.t.strings.email,
              keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
              insideHint: "patient@mail.ru",
              onChange: (value) => bloc.clear(),
              errorText: state.mapOrNull(error: (error) => error.emailError),
              textInputAction: TextInputAction.go,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          BlocBuilder<AccountDataFormBloc, AccountDataFormState>(
            bloc: bloc,
            builder: (context, state) => PNTextField(
              controller: _passwordController,
              hint: context.t.strings.password,
              isObscure: true,
              insideHint: "******",
              errorText: state.mapOrNull(error: (error) => error.passwordError),
              keyboardType: TextInputType.visiblePassword,
              onChange: (value) => bloc.clear(),
              onSubmitted: (_) async {
                final checkResult = await bloc.checkAccountData(
                  _emailController.text,
                  _passwordController.text,
                );

                if (checkResult) {
                  widget.nextStep();
                }
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 28),
          BlocBuilder<AccountDataFormBloc, AccountDataFormState>(
            bloc: bloc,
            builder: (context, state) => PNButton(
              title: context.t.strings.goNext,
              isLoading: state.maybeWhen(
                loading: () => true,
                orElse: () => false,
              ),
              onPressed: () async {
                final checkResult = await bloc.checkAccountData(
                  _emailController.text,
                  _passwordController.text,
                );

                if (!checkResult) {
                  return;
                }

                final codeResult = await bloc.sendEmailCode(
                  _emailController.text,
                  _passwordController.text,
                );

                if (!codeResult) {
                  return;
                }

                widget.nextStep();
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _emailController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

=== FILE: features/registration_form/modules/code/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/user/type.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/response.dart';
import '../../../../ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class EmailCodeFormBloc extends Cubit<EmailCodeFormState> {
  final RegistrationFormBloc _registrationBloc;
  final RegistrationRepository _repository;

  EmailCodeFormBloc(this._registrationBloc, this._repository)
    : super(EmailCodeFormState.waiting());

  int get _codeLength => 4;

  Future<bool> checkCode(String code) async {
    emit(EmailCodeFormState.loading());

    final email = _registrationBloc.state.email;

    if (email == null) {
      emit(EmailCodeFormState.waiting());
      return false;
    }

    if (code.length != _codeLength) {
      emit(EmailCodeFormState.error(codeError: t.strings.fillField));
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _repository.checkCode(email, code);

    return response.map(
      success: (_) {
        emit(EmailCodeFormState.waiting());
        _registrationBloc.updateEmailCode(code);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(EmailCodeFormState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> resendCode() async {
    final email = _registrationBloc.state.email;

    if (email == null) {
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _repository.resendCode(email);

    return response.map(
      success: (_) {
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.codeResend, type: PNSnackType.success);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<(bool, UserType?)> register() async {
    emit(EmailCodeFormState.loading());

    final response = await _registrationBloc.register();

    if (response.$1) {
      PNSnack.show(
        text: t.strings.successfulRegistration,
        type: PNSnackType.success,
      );
    }

    emit(EmailCodeFormState.waiting());

    return response;
  }
}

part of '../form.dart';

const _resendCodeDuration = Duration(seconds: 90);

class _ResendButton extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _ResendButton();

  @override
  ConsumerState<_ResendButton> createState() => _ResendButtonState();
}

class _ResendButtonState extends ConsumerState<_ResendButton> {
  bool _isLoading = false;
  bool _canResend = false;
  Duration _duration = _resendCodeDuration;

  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    _canResend = false;
    _restartTimer();
    super.initState();
  }

  Future<void> _restartTimer() async {
    _isLoading = false;
    _canResend = false;
    _duration = _resendCodeDuration;
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {
      if (_duration.inSeconds == 0) {
        _timer?.cancel();
        _canResend = true;
        setState(() {});
        return;
      }

      _duration -= const Duration(seconds: 1);
      setState(() {});
    });
    setState(() {});
  }

  Color _textColor(BuildContext context) => _canResend
      ? context.pNTheme.primaryControl
      : context.pNTheme.secondaryText;

  Color _borderColor(BuildContext context) => _canResend
      ? context.pNTheme.primaryControl
      : context.pNTheme.secondaryText;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(ProviderBloc.restorePassword.confirmEmail);

    final minutes = (_duration.inSeconds ~/ 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final seconds = (_duration.inSeconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    return IgnorePointer(
      ignoring: _isLoading,
      child: MaterialButton(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(_isLoading ? 4 : 14),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          side: BorderSide(color: _borderColor(context)),
        ),
        elevation: 0,
        hoverElevation: 0,
        focusElevation: 0,
        highlightElevation: 0,
        onPressed: _canResend
            ? () async {
                _isLoading = true;
                setState(() {});
                final response = await bloc.resendCode();

                if (response) {
                  _restartTimer();
                  return;
                }

                _isLoading = false;
                setState(() {});
              }
            : null,
        color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
        height: context.au(48),
        child: Center(
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            child: _isLoading
                ? LoadingAnimationWidget.waveDots(
                    color: _textColor(context),
                    size: context.au(22 + 20),
                  )
                : Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          context.t.strings.sendCodeAgain,
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: _textColor(context),
                            fontSize: context.au(18),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            height: 22 / 18,
                          ),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (!_canResend) const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      if (!_canResend)
                        AutoSizeText(
                          "$minutes:$seconds",
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: _textColor(context),
                            fontSize: context.au(18),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            height: 22 / 18,
                          ),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          maxLines: 1,
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

=== FILE: features/registration_form/modules/personal_data/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/user/gender.dart';
import '../../../bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class PersonalDataFormBloc extends Cubit<PersonalDataFormState> {
  final RegistrationFormBloc _registrationBloc;

  PersonalDataFormBloc(this._registrationBloc)
    : super(PersonalDataFormState.waiting());

  Future<bool> checkData(
    String? lastName,
    String? firstName,
    String? additionalName,
    UserGender? gender,
    int? cityId,
    String? phone,
    DateTime? birthDate,
  ) async {
    if (lastName == null || lastName.isEmpty) {
      emit(PersonalDataFormState.error(lastNameError: t.strings.fillField));
      return false;
    }

    if (firstName == null || firstName.isEmpty) {
      emit(PersonalDataFormState.error(firstNameError: t.strings.fillField));
      return false;
    }

    if (cityId == null) {
      emit(PersonalDataFormState.error(cityError: t.strings.fillField));
      return false;
    }

    _registrationBloc.updateLastName(lastName);
    _registrationBloc.updateFirstName(firstName);
    _registrationBloc.updateMiddleName(
      additionalName == "" ? null : additionalName,
    );
    _registrationBloc.updateGender(gender);
    _registrationBloc.updateCityId(cityId);
    _registrationBloc.updatePhone(phone == "" ? null : phone);
    _registrationBloc.updateBirthDate(birthDate);

    return true;
  }

  void clear() {
    emit(PersonalDataFormState.waiting());
  }
}

class PersonalDataFormButton extends ConsumerWidget {
  final TextEditingController firstNameController;
  final TextEditingController lastNameController;
  final TextEditingController additionalNameController;
  final MaskedTextController phoneController;

  final ValueNotifier<UserGender?> userGender;
  final ValueNotifier<DateTime?> birthDate;
  final ValueNotifier<int?> cityId;

  final VoidCallback nextStep;

  const PersonalDataFormButton({
    super.key,
    required this.firstNameController,
    required this.lastNameController,
    required this.additionalNameController,
    required this.phoneController,
    required this.userGender,
    required this.birthDate,
    required this.cityId,
    required this.nextStep,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(ProviderBloc.registration.personalData);

    return BlocBuilder<PersonalDataFormBloc, PersonalDataFormState>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => PNButton(
        title: context.t.strings.goNext,
        onPressed: () async {
          String phone = phoneController.text;

          phone = phone.replaceAll("(", "");
          phone = phone.replaceAll(")", "");
          phone = phone.replaceAll("-", "");
          phone = phone.replaceAll(" ", "");

          final checkResult = await bloc.checkData(
            firstNameController.text,
            lastNameController.text,
            additionalNameController.text,
            userGender.value,
            cityId.value,
            phone,
            birthDate.value,
          );

          if (checkResult) {
            nextStep();
          }
        },
        isLoading: state.maybeWhen(loading: () => true, orElse: () => false),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _CitySelector extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final int? selectedCityId;
  final Function(int) onCitySelected;

  const _CitySelector({this.selectedCityId, required this.onCitySelected});

  @override
  ConsumerState<_CitySelector> createState() => __CitySelectorState();
}

class __CitySelectorState extends ConsumerState<_CitySelector> {
  List<CityModel> _cities = [];

  Future<void> _fetchCities() async {
    final repository = ref.read(ProviderRepository.common.city);
    final response = await repository.getAllCities();

    response.mapOrNull(
      success: (data) {
        _cities = data.cities;
        setState(() {});
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _fetchCities();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return PNDropDown(
      selectedIndex: widget.selectedCityId,
      hint: context.t.strings.livingCity,
      insideHint: context.t.strings.notSelected,
      isRequired: true,
      onChanged: (optionIndex) {
        if (optionIndex == null) {
          return;
        }
        if (optionIndex >= 0 && optionIndex < _cities.length) {
          widget.onCitySelected(_cities[optionIndex].id);
        }
      },
      options: _cities.map((city) => city.name).toList(),
    );
  }
}

class _DatePickerState extends State<_DatePicker> {

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/models/user/type.dart';
import '../../../../../core/ui/widgets/button/button.dart';
import '../../../../ui/expansion_tile.dart';

class RoleSelectionForm extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback nextStep;
  final double bottomPadding;

  const RoleSelectionForm({
    super.key,
    required this.nextStep,
    required this.bottomPadding,
  });

  @override
  State<RoleSelectionForm> createState() => _RoleSelectionFormState();
}

class _RoleSelectionFormState extends State<RoleSelectionForm> {
  final List<GlobalKey> expansionTileKeys = List.generate(
    4,
    (_) => GlobalKey(),
  );

  int? expandedTileIndex;
  Timer? scrollTimer;

  UserType? selectedRole;

  void changeExpandedTile(int index) async {
    if (expandedTileIndex == index) {
      expandedTileIndex = null;
      return setState(() {});
    }

    scrollTimer?.cancel();

    expandedTileIndex = index;
    setState(() {});

    scrollTimer = Timer(Durations.medium2, () {
      final context = expansionTileKeys[index].currentContext;
      if (context == null || !context.mounted) return;
      WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        Scrollable.ensureVisible(
          context,
          duration: Durations.medium2,
          curve: Curves.easeInOut,
          alignment: 0.0,
        );
      });
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: ListView(
            primary: false,
            children: [
              PNExpansionTile(
                key: expansionTileKeys[0],
                isExpanded: expandedTileIndex == 0,
                onExpansionChanged: (v) => changeExpandedTile(0),
                title: context.t.strings.patient.toUpperCase(),
                description: context.t.strings.patientDescription,
                isSelected: selectedRole == UserType.patient,
                onChanged: (newValue) {
                  if (!newValue) return;
                  selectedRole = UserType.patient;
                  setState(() {});
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 18),
              PNExpansionTile(
                key: expansionTileKeys[1],
                isExpanded: expandedTileIndex == 1,
                onExpansionChanged: (v) => changeExpandedTile(1),
                title: context.t.strings.relativeOrGuardian.toUpperCase(),
                maxTitleLines: 1,
                description: context.t.strings.relativeDescription,
                isSelected: selectedRole == UserType.relative,
                onChanged: (newValue) {
                  if (!newValue) return;
                  selectedRole = UserType.relative;
                  setState(() {});
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 18),
              PNExpansionTile(
                key: expansionTileKeys[2],
                isExpanded: expandedTileIndex == 2,
                onExpansionChanged: (v) => changeExpandedTile(2),
                title: context.t.strings.expert.toUpperCase(),
                maxTitleLines: 1,
                description: context.t.strings.expertDescription,
                isSelected: selectedRole == UserType.expert,
                onChanged: (newValue) {
                  if (!newValue) return;
                  selectedRole = UserType.expert;
                  setState(() {});
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 18),
              PNExpansionTile(
                key: expansionTileKeys[3],
                isExpanded: expandedTileIndex == 3,
                onExpansionChanged: (v) => changeExpandedTile(3),
                title: context.t.strings.administrator.toUpperCase(),
                maxTitleLines: 2,

=== FILE: features/restore_form/modules/confirm_email/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/response.dart';
import '../../../../ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class RestorePasswordConfirmEmailBloc
    extends Cubit<RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState> {
  final RestoreFormBloc _restoreFormBloc;
  final RegistrationRepository _registrationRepository;

  RestorePasswordConfirmEmailBloc(
    this._restoreFormBloc,
    this._registrationRepository,
  ) : super(RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState.waiting());

  int get _codeLength => 4;

  Future<bool> checkCode(String code) async {
    emit(RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState.loading());

    final email = _restoreFormBloc.state.email;

    if (email == null) {
      emit(RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState.waiting());
      return false;
    }

    if (code.length != _codeLength) {
      emit(
        RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState.error(codeError: t.strings.fillField),
      );
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _registrationRepository.checkCode(email, code);

    return response.map(
      success: (_) {
        emit(RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState.waiting());
        _restoreFormBloc.updateEmailCode(code);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(RestorePasswordConfirmEmailState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> resendCode() async {
    final email = _restoreFormBloc.state.email;

    if (email == null) {
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _registrationRepository.resendCode(email);

    return response.map(
      success: (_) {
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.codeResend, type: PNSnackType.success);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: features/restore_form/modules/confirm_email/ui/widgets/resend_button.dart ===
part of '../form.dart';

const _resendCodeDuration = Duration(seconds: 90);

class _ResendButton extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _ResendButton();

  @override
  ConsumerState<_ResendButton> createState() => _ResendButtonState();
}

class _ResendButtonState extends ConsumerState<_ResendButton> {
  bool _isLoading = false;
  bool _canResend = false;
  Duration _duration = _resendCodeDuration;

  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    _canResend = false;
    _restartTimer();
    super.initState();
  }

  Future<void> _restartTimer() async {
    _isLoading = false;
    _canResend = false;
    _duration = _resendCodeDuration;
    _timer?.cancel();
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (_) {
      if (_duration.inSeconds == 0) {
        _timer?.cancel();
        _canResend = true;
        setState(() {});
        return;
      }

      _duration -= const Duration(seconds: 1);
      setState(() {});
    });
    setState(() {});
  }

  Color _textColor(BuildContext context) => _canResend
      ? context.pNTheme.primaryControl
      : context.pNTheme.secondaryText;

  Color _borderColor(BuildContext context) => _canResend
      ? context.pNTheme.primaryControl
      : context.pNTheme.secondaryText;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(ProviderBloc.restorePassword.confirmEmail);

    final minutes = (_duration.inSeconds ~/ 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final seconds = (_duration.inSeconds % 60).toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    return IgnorePointer(
      ignoring: _isLoading,
      child: MaterialButton(
        padding: EdgeInsets.all(_isLoading ? 4 : 14),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          side: BorderSide(color: _borderColor(context)),
        ),
        elevation: 0,
        hoverElevation: 0,
        focusElevation: 0,
        highlightElevation: 0,
        onPressed: _canResend
            ? () async {
                _isLoading = true;
                setState(() {});
                final response = await bloc.resendCode();

                if (response) {
                  _restartTimer();
                  return;
                }

                _isLoading = false;
                setState(() {});
              }
            : null,
        color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
        height: context.au(48),
        child: Center(
          child: AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            child: _isLoading
                ? LoadingAnimationWidget.waveDots(
                    color: _textColor(context),
                    size: context.au(22 + 20),
                  )
                : Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                    children: [
                      Flexible(
                        child: Text(
                          context.t.strings.sendCodeAgain,
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: _textColor(context),
                            fontSize: context.au(18),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            height: 22 / 18,
                          ),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                        ),
                      ),
                      if (!_canResend) const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      if (!_canResend)
                        AutoSizeText(
                          "$minutes:$seconds",
                          style: PNTextStyle(
                            color: _textColor(context),
                            fontSize: context.au(18),
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                            height: 22 / 18,
                          ),
                          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          maxLines: 1,
                        ),
                    ],
                  ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

=== FILE: features/restore_form/modules/email/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/registration/response.dart';
import '../../../../ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class RestorePasswordEmailBloc extends Cubit<RestorePasswordEmailState> {
  final RestoreFormBloc _restoreFormBloc;
  final RegistrationRepository _registrationRepository;

  RestorePasswordEmailBloc(this._restoreFormBloc, this._registrationRepository)
    : super(RestorePasswordEmailState.waiting());

  int get _emailLength => "1@aa.aa".length;

  Future<bool> checkEmail(String email) async {
    emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.loading());

    if (email.isEmpty || email.length < _emailLength) {
      emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.error(emailError: t.strings.fillField));
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _registrationRepository.isEmailTaken(email);

    return response.map(
      emailFree: (data) {
        emit(
          RestorePasswordEmailState.error(
            emailError: t.strings.emailNoAssociated,
          ),
        );
        return false;
      },
      emailTaken: (data) {
        emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.waiting());
        _restoreFormBloc.updateEmail(email);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<bool> sendEmailCode(String email) async {
    emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.loading());

    final response = await _registrationRepository.resendCode(email);

    return response.map(
      success: (data) {
        emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: t.strings.codeSendToEmail);
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  Future<void> clear() async {
    emit(RestorePasswordEmailState.waiting());
  }
}

=== FILE: features/restore_form/modules/new_password/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/restore_password/repository.dart';
import '../../../../../core/repositories/common/restore_password/response.dart';
import '../../../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../../ui/snack.dart';
import '../../../bloc/bloc.dart';
import 'state.dart';

class NewPasswordFormBloc extends Cubit<NewPasswordFormState> {
  final RestoreFormBloc _restoreFormBloc;
  final RestorePasswordRepository _passwordRepository;

  NewPasswordFormBloc(this._restoreFormBloc, this._passwordRepository)
    : super(NewPasswordFormState.waiting());

  Future<bool> changePassword(String password, String repeatPassword) async {
    emit(NewPasswordFormState.loading());

    if (password.length < AppSettings.passwordMinLength) {
      emit(
        NewPasswordFormState.error(passwordError: t.strings.passwordMinLength),
      );
      return false;
    }

    if (password != repeatPassword) {
      emit(
        NewPasswordFormState.error(
          repeatPasswordError: t.strings.passwordMustMatch,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }

    final email = _restoreFormBloc.state.email;
    final code = _restoreFormBloc.state.emailCode;

    if (email == null || code == null) {
      emit(NewPasswordFormState.waiting());
      return false;
    }

    final response = await _passwordRepository.restorePassword(
      email,
      password,
      code,
    );

    return response.map(
      success: (_) {
        emit(NewPasswordFormState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(
          text: t.strings.passwordSuccessChange,
          type: PNSnackType.success,
        );
        return true;
      },
      error: (data) {
        emit(NewPasswordFormState.waiting());
        PNSnack.show(text: data.error, type: PNSnackType.error);
        return false;
      },
    );
  }

  void clear() {
    emit(NewPasswordFormState.waiting());
  }
}

=== FILE: features/settings/bloc/bloc.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../../core/models/settings/app_settings.dart';
import '../../../core/repositories/common/notifications/repository.dart';
import '../../../core/settings.dart';
import '../../../core/storage/settings.dart';
import '../../ui/snack.dart';

class SettingsBloc extends Cubit<AppSettingsModel> {
  final SettingsStorage _storage;
  final NotificationsRepository _notificationsRepository;

  SettingsBloc(this._storage, this._notificationsRepository)
    : super(const AppSettingsModel());

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    final data = await _storage.appSettings.get();
    emit(data ?? AppSettingsModel());
    final locale = state.locale;

    if (locale != null) {
      LocaleSettings.setLocale(locale);
    }
    if (locale == null) {
      LocaleSettings.useDeviceLocaleSync();
    }
  }

  Future<void> save() async {
    _storage.appSettings.save(state);
  }

  Future<void> setPushNotifications(bool newValue) async {
    emit(state.copyWith(pushNotifications: newValue));
    save();
  }

  Future<void> setEmailNotifications(bool newValue) async {
    emit(state.copyWith(emailNotifications: newValue));
    save();
  }

  Future<void> setTheme(ThemeMode newTheme) async {
    emit(state.copyWith(themeMode: newTheme));
    save();
  }

  Future<void> setLocale(AppLocale? newLocale) async {
    if (newLocale != null) LocaleSettings.setLocale(newLocale);
    if (newLocale == null) LocaleSettings.useDeviceLocaleSync();

    emit(state.copyWith(locale: newLocale));
    save();
  }

  Future<void> setTextStyleToggle(bool newValue) async {
    emit(state.copyWith(systemTextScale: newValue));
    save();
  }

  Future<void> setTextStyle(double newValue) async {
    emit(
      state.copyWith(
        textScale: newValue.clamp(
          AppUISettings.minTextStyle,
          AppUISettings.maxTextStyle,
        ),
      ),
    );
    save();
  }

  Future<void> sendTestNotification() async {
    final response = await _notificationsRepository.sendTestNotification();

    response.map(
      success: (data) {},
      error: (data) {
        PNSnack.show(
          text: data.message,
          type: PNSnackType.error,
          errorValue: data.errorValue,
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';

import '../../ui/text.dart';
import '../../ui/units/extension.dart';
import '../bloc/bloc.dart';

class SettingsAppearanceSection extends ConsumerWidget {
  const SettingsAppearanceSection({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final bloc = ref.watch(ProviderBloc.settings);

    return BlocBuilder<SettingsBloc, AppSettingsModel>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => Column(
        children: [
          SettingsSectionWidget(
            items: [
              SettingsItem.select(
                title: context.t.strings.theme,
                dialogTitle: context.t.strings.theme,
                selectedValue: switch (state.themeMode) {
                  ThemeMode.system => context.t.strings.themes.system,
                  ThemeMode.light => context.t.strings.themes.light,
                  ThemeMode.dark => context.t.strings.themes.dark,
                },
                onValueSubmit: (index) {
                  final theme = switch (index) {
                    0 => ThemeMode.system,
                    1 => ThemeMode.light,
                    2 => ThemeMode.dark,
                    _ => ThemeMode.system,
                  };
                  bloc.setTheme(theme);
                },
                values: [
                  context.t.strings.themes.system,
                  context.t.strings.themes.light,
                  context.t.strings.themes.dark,
                ],
              ),
              SettingsItem.select(
                title: context.t.strings.language,
                dialogTitle: context.t.strings.language,
                selectedValue: switch (state.locale) {
                  AppLocale.ru => context.t.strings.languages.ru,
                  AppLocale.en => context.t.strings.languages.en,
                  _ => context.t.strings.languages.system,
                },
                onValueSubmit: (index) {
                  final locale = switch (index) {
                    0 => null,
                    1 => AppLocale.ru,
                    2 => AppLocale.en,
                    _ => null,
                  };
                  bloc.setLocale(locale);
                },
                values: [
                  context.t.strings.languages.system,
                  context.t.strings.languages.ru,
                  context.t.strings.languages.en,
                ],
              ),
              SettingsItem.toggle(
                title: context.t.strings.systemTextSize,
                value: state.systemTextScale,
                isLoading: false,
                isEnable: true,
                onChanged: (newValue) {
                  bloc.setTextStyleToggle(newValue);
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          SizedBox(height: 16),
          AnimatedSwitcher(
            duration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            reverseDuration: Duration(milliseconds: 300),
            child: state.systemTextScale
                ? Container(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    height: 48,
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                      color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
                    ),
                  )
                : _TextScaler(
                    value: state.textScale,
                    onChange: bloc.setTextStyle,
                  ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _TextScaler extends StatelessWidget {
  final double value;
  final void Function(double value) onChange;

  const _TextScaler({required this.value, required this.onChange});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(

        color: context.pNTheme.cardBackground,
      ),
      padding: EdgeInsets.all(12),
      width: double.infinity,
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          PNText(context.t.strings.textScale, fontSize: context.au(14)),
          SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: CupertinoSlider(
              min: 0.8,
              max: 1.5,
              value: value,
              onChanged: onChange,
              activeColor: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
              divisions: 7,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

class SettingsNotificationsSection extends HookWidget {
  final SettingsBloc bloc;

  const SettingsNotificationsSection({super.key, required this.bloc});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = context.t.strings;

    final pushChanging = useState<bool>(false);

    final testNotificationSending = useState<bool>(false);

    return BlocBuilder<SettingsBloc, AppSettingsModel>(
      bloc: bloc,
      builder: (context, state) => SettingsSectionWidget(
        items: [
          SettingsItem.toggle(
            title: strings.receiveNotifications,
            value: state.pushNotifications,
            isLoading: pushChanging.value,
            isEnable: true,

              pushChanging.value = true;

              await bloc.setPushNotifications(value);

              if (context.mounted) pushChanging.value = false;
            },
          ),
          if (AppSettings.mode.isDev)
            SettingsItem.button(
              title: strings.sendTestNotification,
              isEnable: !testNotificationSending.value,
              onTap: () async {
                testNotificationSending.value = true;

                await bloc.sendTestNotification();

                testNotificationSending.value = false;
              },

              icon: 
                Icons.notification_add_outlined,
                
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: features/ui/autocomplete.dart ===
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import 'colors.dart';
import 'text.dart';

class PNAutocomplete extends StatefulWidget {
  const PNAutocomplete({
    super.key,
    required this.optionsBuilder,
    this.hintText,
    this.autofillHints,
    this.optionsMaxHeight,
    this.suffix,
    this.enabled,
    this.validator,
  });

  final FutureOr<Iterable<String>> Function(TextEditingValue value)
  optionsBuilder;

  final String? hintText;
  final List<String>? autofillHints;
  final double? optionsMaxHeight;
  final Widget? suffix;
  final bool? enabled;
  final String? Function(String?)? validator;

  factory PNAutocomplete.fromItems(
    List<String> items, {
    hintText,
    autofillHints,
    optionsMaxHeight,
    suffix,
    enabled,
    validator,
  }) {
    return PNAutocomplete(
      hintText: hintText,
      autofillHints: autofillHints,
      optionsMaxHeight: optionsMaxHeight,
      suffix: suffix,
      enabled: enabled,
      validator: validator,
      optionsBuilder: (value) => items.where((String option) {
        return option.toLowerCase().contains(value.text.toLowerCase());
      }),
    );
  }

  @override
  State<PNAutocomplete> createState() => _PNAutocompleteState();
}

class _PNAutocompleteState extends State<PNAutocomplete> {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Autocomplete(
      optionsBuilder: widget.optionsBuilder,
      fieldViewBuilder:
          (context, textEditingController, focusNode, onFieldSubmitted) {
            final border = OutlineInputBorder(
              borderSide: const BorderSide(color: PNColors.primaryBorder),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            );

            return TextFormField(
              validator: widget.validator,
              autofillHints: widget.autofillHints,
              enabled: widget.enabled ?? true,
              controller: textEditingController,
              focusNode: focusNode,
              style: const PNTextStyle(
                color: PNColors.blackText,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                fontSize: 16,
              ),
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                hintStyle: const PNTextStyle(
                  color: PNColors.blackText,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w200,
                  fontSize: 16,
                ),
                hintText: widget.hintText,
                enabledBorder: border,
                focusedBorder: border,
                focusedErrorBorder: border,
                errorBorder: border,
                suffixIcon: widget.suffix,
              ),
            );
          },
      optionsViewBuilder: (context, onSelected, options) {
        return Material(
          elevation: 0,
          clipBehavior: Clip.antiAlias,
          color: context.pNTheme.primaryBackground,
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            side: const BorderSide(color: PNColors.primaryBorder),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          ),
          child: ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: BoxConstraints(
              maxHeight: widget.optionsMaxHeight ?? 200,
            ),
            child: ListView.builder(
              shrinkWrap: true,
              itemCount: options.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final option = options.elementAt(index);

                return ListTile(
                  title: PNText(
                    option,
                    fontSize: 16,
                    color: PNColors.blackText,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
                  ),
                  onTap: () => onSelected(option),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/cupertino.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

import '../../.gen/i18n/strings.g.dart';
import '../../core/ui/colors/colors_ext.dart';
import 'text.dart';
import 'units/extension.dart';

class PNDatePicker extends StatefulWidget {
  final Function(DateTime value)? onChanged;

  final TextStyle? textStyle;

  final String? hint;
  final TextStyle? hintStyle;
  final TextOverflow? hintTextOverflow;

  final String? insideHint;
  final TextStyle? insideHintStyle;

  final String? errorText;
  final TextStyle? errorTextStyle;

  final bool isRequired;

  final Color? borderColor;
  final Color? errorColor;

  final DateTime? minDate;
  final DateTime? maxDate;

  const PNDatePicker({
    super.key,
    this.onChanged,
    this.textStyle,
    this.hint,
    this.hintStyle,
    this.hintTextOverflow = TextOverflow.ellipsis,
    this.insideHint,
    this.insideHintStyle,
    this.errorText,
    this.errorTextStyle,
    this.isRequired = false,
    this.borderColor,
    this.errorColor,
    this.minDate,
    this.maxDate,
  });

  @override
  State<PNDatePicker> createState() => _DatePickerState();
}

class _DatePickerState extends State<PNDatePicker> {
  DateTime? _selectedDate;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final hintStyle =
        widget.hintStyle ??
        PNTextStyle(
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: context.pNTheme.primaryControl,
        );

    final textStyle =
        widget.textStyle ??
        PNTextStyle(
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: context.pNTheme.primaryText,
          height: 22 / 16,
        );

    final insideHintStyle =
        widget.insideHintStyle ??
        PNTextStyle(
          fontSize: context.au(16),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w200,
          color: context.pNTheme.primaryText.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
          height: 22 / 16,
        );

    final errorTextStyle =
        widget.errorTextStyle ??
        PNTextStyle(
          fontSize: context.au(14),
          fontWeight: FontWeight.w400,
          color: widget.errorColor ?? context.pNTheme.error,
        );

    final borderColor = widget.borderColor ?? context.pNTheme.primaryControl;
    // ignore: unused_local_variable
    final errorColor = widget.errorColor ?? context.pNTheme.error;

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        if (widget.hint != null)
          Row(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              if (widget.hint != null)
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    widget.hint! + (widget.isRequired ? ' *' : ''),
                    style: hintStyle,
                    overflow: widget.hintTextOverflow,
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        if (widget.hint != null) const SizedBox(height: 12),
        CupertinoButton(
          sizeStyle: CupertinoButtonSize.small,
          padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
          onPressed: () {
            showDatePicker(
              context: context,
              initialDate: _selectedDate ?? DateTime.now(),
              firstDate: widget.minDate ?? DateTime(1900),
              lastDate: widget.maxDate ?? DateTime.now(),
            ).then((value) {
              if (value == null) {
                return;
              }
              _selectedDate = value;
              widget.onChanged?.call(_selectedDate!);
              setState(() {});
            });
          },
          child: Container(
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              border: Border.all(color: borderColor, width: 1),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              vertical: 6 * 2.5,
              horizontal: 6 * 2,
            ),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Text(
                  _selectedDate == null
                      ? widget.insideHint ?? ''
                      : DateFormat.yMMMMd(
                          LocaleSettings.currentLocale.languageCode,
                        ).format(_selectedDate!),
                  style: _selectedDate == null ? insideHintStyle : textStyle,
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                Icon(Icons.calendar_month_rounded, color: borderColor),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        AnimatedSize(
          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 300),
          alignment: Alignment.topLeft,
          child: widget.errorText == null
              ? SizedBox(width: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width)
              : Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                  child: Text(widget.errorText!, style: errorTextStyle),
                ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
